attorneys.name: Loren M. Brown
attorneys.practice_type: Wrongful Death Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
Loren M. Brown is a founding shareholder and managing shareholder with Ciancio Ciancio Brown, P.C. His practice is focused 100% on litigation, providing representation along the Front Range, and throughout the State of Colorado. He focuses on Wrongful Death and Personal Injury, Criminal Defense (ranging from traffic violations to homicide), Liquor Licensing, and Commercial Litigation.

Loren is also actively involved in the Colorado Bar Association, serving as the President from 2015 – 2016. During his term, Mr. Brown was able to travel throughout the State of Colorado meeting lawyers, legal professionals, and judges across the Eastern Plains, Western Slope, and along the Front Range. Aside from making great contacts with people in those places, he was also able to help shape the bar association and legal profession moving forward, focusing on issues such as diversity and inclusion, attorney health and wellness, access to justice, and formation of the CBA strategic plan.

Loren’s liquor license practice involves matters related to liquor licensing, including new licenses and defense of clients related to liquor license violations. His clients in this area range in size from small family businesses to large national corporations, including retail outlet liquor stores, taverns and restaurants, and theaters.

Loren started his career as a law clerk with Gene and Cyndy Ciancio while in law school and remained with the firm after becoming an attorney in 2003. He received his undergraduate degree from the University of Colorado at Boulder in 1999, with a B. A. in History. While at University of Colorado, Loren was a member of the Track and Field Team (High Jump and 400 Meter Hurdles), and selected to the Big XII Commissioner’s Honor Roll, 1997 and 1998. Loren was also a recipient of the Justice Byron R. White Memorial Award.

After graduating from University of Colorado, Loren attended the University of Denver Sturm College of Law, and earned his Juris Doctor in 2003. While at DU, Loren was the President of the student chapter of the Association of Trial Lawyers of America (ATLA), now AAJ, and was also a member of the Moot Court Board.

Loren has always been passionate about trial practice, even while in law school. He was on the University of Denver’s ATLA traveling trial team, and in 2003 the team went on to be National Champions.

In 2007 and 2008, before opening his own practice, Damon worked as a contract attorney for two experienced attorneys in Littleton whose combined practice areas include Family Law, Estate Planning. Damon continues to work closely with both of those attorneys, in addition to working with his own clients.

In 2006, Damon worked at the United States Bankruptcy Court, District of Colorado, as a judicial intern. His experience there working on Chapter 11 Bankruptcy cases, in addition to the work described below as a researcher on Chapter 13 cases, has been invaluable in understanding both Bankruptcy law and the many and complicated reasons people seek bankruptcy relief.

Research Projects

Prior to starting his practice, Damon trained and supervised a number of other researchers who labored to collect and manage data from hundreds of Chapter 13 Bankruptcy cases before and after the effective date of the 2005 Bankruptcy Abuse Prevention and Consumer Protection Act (BAPCPA). This data was eventually used by Professors Bruce M. Price, of the University of San Francisco School of Law, and Terry Dalton, of the University of Denver Graduate School of International Studies and Daniels College of Business. Their article From Downhill to Slalom: An Empirical Analysis of the Effectiveness of BAPCPA (and Some Unintended Consequences) was published in the Yale Law & Policy Review, Vol. 26, 2007.

attorneys.name: Thomas J. Burke Jr.
attorneys.practice_type: Administrative Law Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
Tom's practice concentrates in the areas of commercial litigation, transportation, employment and civil rights litigation, and litigation-related real estate work. Tom has long appeared before the various local and regional trial and appellate courts including the Eighth and Tenth Circuit Courts of Appeal, the United States District Court for the District of Colorado, the Colorado Supreme Court, the Colorado Court of Appeals, and nearly all of the Colorado state and federal agencies.

Tom also serves regularly on the National Panel of Neutrals of the American Arbitration Association, Inc. and International Centre for Dispute Resolution, Inc, where he has acted as sole arbitrator, panel arbitrator and chairperson in numerous domestic and international commercial arbitration proceedings in the areas of transportation, employment and real estate law in Colorado, New York and Texas, involving claims of over 15 million.

Experience

Tom has extensive experience before the Colorado Public Utilities Commission, the Interstate Commerce Commission, the United States Surface Transportation Board, the United States Board of Contract Appeals, the National Labor Relations Board, the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission and the Colorado Division of Civil Rights of the Department of Regulatory Agencies.

Significant Representations

Representing two Texas-based dealers for a Fortune 500 satellite telecommunications provider, Tom recovered unpaid commissions and attorneys fees of approximately $1,000,000 as the result of a two week arbitration proceeding before the American Arbitration Association in Denver.

Tom successfully obtained a permanent injunction in the United States District Court for the District of Colorado preventing a state regulatory agency's attempt to regulate and sanction against doing business under preemptive provisions of federal law. Tom also obtained a declaratory judgment holding the state agency's related enforcement proceeding to be beyond its jurisdiction. In addition to injunctive and declaratory relief directed to the state agency, Tom also secured an award of state-paid attorneys' fees and costs of $175,000.

Tom successfully challenged a will under which a mother had mistakenly provided only a life estate in valuable real estate when she had clearly indicated to third persons that she intended to leave the property to her son outright. After a thirteen-month legal challenge, Tom was able to settle the son's dispute with the personal representatives. The son is achieving ownership of real property valued at over $1,000,000.

attorneys.practice_type: Professional Liability Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
Ariana Busby is a litigation and regulatory partner at Coombe, Curry, Rich, and Jarvis. Ariana represents clients as an advisor and in litigation and regulatory matters involving professional liability, products liability, premises liability, construction defects, employment disputes (including EEOC investigations), government relations, and complex commercial matters. Ariana has extensive experience working with highly regulated industries, including businesses and professionals in healthcare, finance, transportation, liquor, and marijuana businesses.

Prior to entering private practice, Ariana worked in government for a decade, including serving as the Director of the Mental Health Boards with the Colorado Department of Regulatory Agencies. She utilizes this experience to help clients navigate regulatory complaints, investigations, audits, and other compliance matters at the local, state, and federal levels.

Ariana has been recognized as a Super Lawyers Rising Star since 2022 and Best Lawyers: Ones to Watch® in America since 2024. She regularly testifies before the state legislature on matters of interest to her clients and was featured in Law Week Colorado and Law360 for her work on legislation to restructure the judicial investigation and disciplinary process.

Ariana graduated from the University of Denver Sturm College of Law as a member of the Phi Delta Phi Legal Honor Society and with an Environmental & Natural Resources law certificate. She earned a Bachelor of Arts degree in Public Policy and Government with a minor in Law Studies from the University of Colorado – Denver.

Ariana serves in leadership positions with the Colorado Bar Association and Colorado Women’s Bar Association. She is a member of the Colorado Defense Lawyer Association (CDLA), Colorado Counseling Association (CCA), Metro Denver Interdisciplinary Committee (MDIC), Colorado Association of Family and Conciliation Courts (COAFCC), and the Colorado Healthcare Associated Risk Managers Association (CHARM).

attorneys.name: Tom Byrnes Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Greenwood Village, CO
attorneys.bio:
Tom Byrnes is a trial lawyer with over 20 years of experience specializing in complex trials and investigations. His dedication to each case and confidence in the courtroom achieves winning results for clients. His practice focuses on representing victims and their families in civil litigation and injury law, including catastrophic injury and wrongful death cases.

As a trial prosecutor he developed expertise in handling a wide variety of criminal cases including homicides, sexual assaults, drug trafficking, and financial crimes. He worked closely with victims impacted by serious injuries, and admired the courage and resilience they showed to fight for justice in the criminal justice system. As the Assistant District Attorney for the 18th Judicial District Attorney’s Office, he led trial teams and managed day-to-day operations for the office of over 250 employees in Colorado’s largest district.

Tom is a U.S. Navy and Iraq War veteran who served on active duty in the JAG Corps as a Staff Judge Advocate, defense counsel, Special Assistant United States Attorney, and prosecutor. He continues to serve as a Captain in the U.S. Navy Reserves, where he worked in litigation and investigative roles, international and operational law positions, and he is currently a certified military judge.

Tom earned his bachelor’s degree in Political Science and Spanish from Franciscan University in Steubenville, OH, and his law degree from the Ave Maria School of Law in Ann Arbor, MI. Tom and his wife Darci live with their family in Lakewood, CO.

attorneys.name: Jonny Campbell
attorneys.practice_type: Discrimination Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
Mr. Campbell joined the firm in 2025. He is licensed to practice law in state and federal courts in Colorado. He has experience with the Colorado Anti-Discrimination Act, the POWR Act, and the Colorado Wage Claim Act. He also brings well-rounded experience in the contract and insurance spaces, having worked as a plaintiff-side personal injury attorney and a defense attorney in workers’ compensation. More recently, Mr. Campbell helped rebuild an employment law group at his previous firm, where he counseled Colorado employers on handbook and official policy reviews, as well as compliance issues, employment terminations, and human resources matters.

Prior to law school, Mr. Campbell enjoyed a six-year career in the baseball industry – working in the front offices of the Boston Red Sox and Colorado Rockies. His experiences in professional sports fueled a keen interest in contracts, employment law, antitrust issues and collective bargaining. As a 1L at the University of Denver Sturm College of Law, Mr. Campbell was a team alternate with the law school’s baseball arbitration team and traveled to Tulane University to argue moot baseball salary cases at the International Baseball Arbitration Competition. He also later earned a certificate in alternative dispute resolution by mediating various civil disputes with the Denver small claims court and the local chapter of the Better Business Bureau.

Outside of the law, Mr. Campbell is a lifelong musician. He currently serves on the board of directors with the Denver Philharmonic Orchestra: a nonprofit community orchestra dedicated to making classical music accessible and welcoming for people of diverse backgrounds. The DPO offers programming for underserved populations including the deaf and blind, as well as formerly incarcerated individuals. Patrons aged 18 and under are always free, and no one is ever turned away at the door.

Originally from New Hampshire, Mr. Campbell has called Colorado home since 2008. He graduated from the University of Colorado Boulder with his BA in 2012. He earned his JD at the University of Denver in 2020.

attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Fort Collins, CO
attorneys.bio:
I'm a trial lawyer who wants to help my clients recover. I represent individuals who've been injured by somone else or who have been the victim of wrongdoing at work. I'm driven to help those I represent by the knowledge that the odds are stacked against individuals in the legal system. The legal system is designed to help corporations' bottom lines at the expense of the little guy. I want to help my clients fight back against that. I use my knowledge and experience to make the insurance companies sit up and take notice.

I work with my partners, staff, and clients to form a unique plan for each case. First we sit down with our client to make sure we fully understand the client's goals. Once we have the goal, me and my staff use our knowledge and experience to develop and execute a strategy to reach those goals. We keep our case loads down so we can treat each case as unique. We don't apply a one-size-fits-all gameplan to every case that comes to us because every case and every client is different.

If you want a lawyer who will work with you to get you back on your feet, contact me today.

attorneys.name: Dan Caplis Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Catastrophic Injury Lawyers in Greenwood Village, CO
attorneys.bio:
Dan Caplis is the founding partner of Dan Caplis Law. Dan graduated with honors from the University of Colorado, where he also served as student body President, and was named The National Evans Scholar of the Year. Dan was then awarded a Juris Doctor degree from the University of Colorado School of Law.

Dan has been litigating catastrophic injury cases since he began practicing law in 1983. In fact, during his first year out of law school Dan was selected to serve as the lead trial attorney in a complex, three week medical malpractice case involving catastrophic birth injuries to a set of triplets.

That extraordinary trial experience convinced Dan that he wanted to spend his life helping good people whose lives had been shattered by the carelessness of others.

For over 30 years, Dan Caplis has served as lead counsel in many successful trials and arbitrations. His proven willingness and ability to take cases to trial has also helped Dan to successfully settle thousands of important cases prior to trial. Dan has served as counsel in numerous cases which have resulted in seven figure settlements, and is frequently called on to handle cases which are the subject of extensive local and/or national interest. Among the many notable cases in which Dan has served as counsel are the following:

• Young father struck by bus in crosswalk (largest PI jury verdict in Colorado in 2015).

• Young woman paralyzed in mass transit accident.

• Young father catastrophically brain injured by semi-truck driver negligence.

• Young woman seriously injured and husband killed by underinsured motorist.

• Teenager severely injured by nursing error (wrong medication).

• Baby injured at birth by medical negligence.

• Teenage girl paralyzed in a vehicle roll-over.

• Baby injured at birth by medical negligence.

• Woman paralyzed when attacked by dangerous employee.

• Family seriously injured in Coors Field escalator accident.

• Woman brain damaged by dangerous drug.

• Baby injured at birth by medical negligence.

• 6 year old boy killed by car at school crosswalk.

• Baby died because of 911 system failures (paramedics sent to wrong address).

• Young man loses leg in an on the job accident.

• Drunk driver kills wonderful young woman.

• Drunk driver catastrophically injures a hard working young man.

Dan is also a respected legal analyst. His legal analysis has been quoted by many prominent media outlets, including the Washington Post, New York Times, Los Angeles Times, Chicago Tribune, Boston Globe, Associated Press, Time Magazine, U.S. News and World Report, CNN, and NBC News. Dan has also been a regular guest on national interview shows such as Larry King Live and The O'Reilly Factor. Dan is frequently invited to speak to professional groups, Church organizations, and schools. His work on behalf of the disadvantaged has been recognized by numerous organizations, and honors include the Humanitarian of The Year Award from the Ancient Order of Hibernians and the Pro Vitae Award from the Archdiocese of Denver. In connection with his media work, 5280 magazine named Dan among the "25 Most Powerful" people in Denver, and a Rocky Mountain News columnist labeled Dan "A Colorado Treasure." Dan is married to Aimee Sporer Caplis. They are the proud parents of two wonderful children, 18 year old Joe and 15 year old Caroline.

attorneys.name: Stephen Carbonneau
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Lakewood, CO
attorneys.bio:
Stephen joined Pearson & Paris, P.C. in 2021. He practices in the areas of divorce, family law, and civil litigation.

Stephen has extensive experience in all aspects of divorce matters. He represents clients in high asset divorces, spousal maintenance (alimony) litigation, cases involving complex assets, cases involving marital business interest, allocation of parental responsibilities (custody), child support disputes, grandparent’s rights, and common law marriage claims. Stephen also handles post-decree litigation and drafting of prenuptial agreements. He is a strong negotiator when representing clients in mediation. Having been a trial attorney for all his career, Stephen has represented numerous clients in court and prides himself on his trial advocacy skills when cases are unable to settle.

Stephen began his career working as a Deputy District Attorney in the 14th Judicial District where he honed his trial skills while also gaining valuable insight about police and prosecutors. As a defense attorney, Stephen now advocates for the rights of those who are wrongfully accused or unfairly prosecuted by law enforcement. He represents clients in misdemeanor and felony matters, and often those that involve driving under the influence (DUI), domestic violence (DV), violent crimes, and traffic offenses.

Stephen represents clients in civil litigation matters including cases that landlord-tenant disputes (evictions), tort claims, breach of contract cases, and civil protection order matters. He uses his skills as a trial attorney to zealously advocate for his clients.

Regarding his background, Stephen attended the University of Miami for his undergraduate studies where he graduated Cum Laude with a Bachelor of Arts in 2015. Stephen then attended the University of Colorado Law School where he graduated in 2018. He was admitted to the bar as a licensed attorney the same year.

Outside of work, Stephen is an avid skier and mountain biker. He also volunteers his time to give back to the community.

attorneys.name: Craig R. Carver
attorneys.firm_name: Carver Schwarz McNab Kamper & Forbes, LLC
attorneys.practice_type: Natural Resources Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
Craig's practice focuses on representing companies involved in extraction, transportation and marketing of oil and gas and other natural resources. It involves both transactional and litigation components.

Examples include, on the transactional side, negotiation and drafting of natural gas marketing, gathering and transportation agreements, major oil and gas property acquisitions and dispositions, farm-out agreements, joint operating and unitization agreements, project financings, and negotiations with federal and state authorities concerning access rights, permits, royalties and environmental compliance issues.

On the litigation side, Craig has extensive lead counsel trial experience in complex cases in federal and state courts and in arbitration, covering the gamut from take-or-pay and natural gas purchase and transportation issues to operational, royalty and other leasehold disputes, valuation, tax, and environmental issues.

He also has experience in dealing with a wide variety of administrative agencies, including the Bureau of Land Management, the Minerals Management Service, the United States Forest Service, the Environmental Protection Agency, the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission and state oil and gas and public utility commissions. He has also served as an arbitrator in disputes involving oil and gas and surface use disputes. He also provides advice and assistance to land tenants concerning the relationships between mineral development and conservation easements.

Craig served as president of the Rocky Mountain Mineral Law Foundation in 2007-2008. He is consistently honored as one of the Best Lawyers in America and Colorado Super Lawyers in the fields of Energy and Natural Resources Law.

He is a frequent lecturer on natural resource subjects, particularly those involving the leasing of federal oil and gas interests. He has authored numerous articles in the natural resources area, such as: The New Standing and Ripeness Doctrines: Who Can Challenge Public Lands Decisions, and When? 45 Rocky Mtn. Min. L. Inst. (1999) and Natural Gas Price Indices: Do They Provide a Sound Basis for Sales and Royalty Payments? 42 Rocky Mtn. Min. L. Inst. (1996).

Prior to the merger of Carver & Kirchhoff into Schwarz McNab & Bailey in 2004, he served as a partner of: Carver & Kirchhoff (2002-2003); Alfers & Carver (1996-2002); Gibson, Dunn & Crutcher (1982 1996) and Head, Moye, Carver & Ray (1976-1982).

He has practiced in Denver since 1974. He is a graduate of Stanford University (A.B., with distinction, 1970) and the University of Denver (J.D., order of St. Ives, 1974).

attorneys.name: Shari D. Caton
attorneys.practice_type: Estate Litigation Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
Ms. Caton practices in the areas of estate litigation, estate planning, elder law, disability planning, public benefits, planning, protective proceedings, and probate.

Ms. Caton began her career as an assistant district attorney. In that role, she tried numerous misdemeanor and felony cases to judge and jury. After leaving the District Attorneys Office, Ms. Caton distinguished herself in both public service and private practice of law.

Public Service

Ms. Caton continually strives to serve the public. She currently serves on the Executive Council of the Colorado Bar Association Elder Law Section and recently completed her term as the elected Chair. As an executive officer and section member, Ms. Caton served a term as the Legislative Policy Liaison and participated in the Achieving a Better Life Experience "ABLE" Committee, Medicaid Regulatory Reform / Legislation Committee, Death with Dignity Committee, Elder Abuse / Mandatory Reporting Committee, Power of Attorney Abuse Committee, and the 1st Annual Elder Law Retreat Committee. In addition, Ms. Caton was recently elected by her peers to serve on the newly created Colorado Supreme Court Probate Rules Committee. In recognition of her professional, public, and private career and outstanding dedication to the welfare of the community, the traditions of the profession, and the maintenance and advancement of the objectives of the Colorado Bar Association, Ms. Caton was invited by the Board of Trustees of the Colorado Bar Foundation to become a Fellow of the Foundation.

Ms. Caton has also provided service to the community through the Denver Probate Court pro se clinic, Alzheimer's Association, Metro Volunteer Lawyers, and Habitat for Humanity. She has also served on the Board of Directors of Big Brothers/Big Sisters and Youth Opportunities Unlimited.

Ms. Caton is a member of the National Academy of Elder Law Attorneys, American Bar Association, Colorado Bar Association, New Mexico Bar Association, Douglas County Bar Association and Phi Delta Phi.

Private Practice

Ms. Caton is proud to represent people of all ages, needs, and asset ranges in contested and uncontested matters. Her private practice experience includes representation of trustees, personal representatives, beneficiaries, conservators, guardians, agents / attorneys-in-fact, and family members in disputes involving all aspects of probate, trust, and estate litigation, including removal proceedings, contested accountings, breach of fiduciary duty claims, will and trust contests, and contested conservatorship and guardianship proceedings. She has represented clients before state courts and administrative bodies in a broad range of trust and estate litigation and public benefits matters. She also assists families with estate planning, including preparation of wills, trusts, powers of attorney, living wills and related documents; estate and trust administration; problems of incapacity; and qualifying for public benefits.

Ms. Caton is licensed to practice in the State of Colorado, the United States District Court for the District of Colorado, the State of New Mexico and the United States District Court for the District of New Mexico.

attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
Alexis's approach to family law matters, such as divorce and child custody, is settlement oriented and focuses on putting the family first. Alexis is trained in both collaborative law, as well as traditional litigation, and uses her blended experience to minimize conflict and produce client-centered resolutions. In the event settlement is not possible, Alexis is prepared to advocate for her client's rights in the courtroom.

Alexis has a passion for family law and takes pride in helping her clients navigate complex family law matters with personalized representation, compassion, and unwavering dedication. She understands the challenges her clients face when presented with family law issues and strives to instill confidence in her clients with honesty, transparency, and a thorough walkthrough of every step of the process.

In addition to her legal practice, Alexis is actively involved in the legal community as an adjunct professor of family law and a member of Bridge to Justice, which is a non-profit organization that provides legal representation for victims of domestic violence.

attorneys.name: Marco D. Chayet
attorneys.practice_type: Elder Law Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
During law school, Marco D. Chayet’s grandmother, Letty Milstein, was the principal party in one of the most controversial and public elder law cases in the state of Colorado. Estate of Milstein v. Ayers, 955 P.2d 78 (Colo. App. 1998), is a landmark probate case that upholds and protects the right to counsel and due process of incapacitated adults in Colorado and has been codified into the Colorado Uniform Protective Proceedings Act. This experience was the impetus for Mr. Chayet’s career-long practice commitment to the fields of elder law, special needs law, fiduciary law and probate litigation.

Mr. Chayet is the founder and managing partner of Chayet & Danzo, LLC. and ColoradoElderLaw.com. Mr. Chayet is also the Public Administrator of the 18th Judicial District, serving as a fiduciary for the counties of Arapahoe, Douglas, Elbert, and Lincoln. Mr. Chayet is the past chairman of the Elder Law Section of the Colorado Bar Association and the current Elder Law Section delegate to the Colorado Bar Association Board of Governors. Mr. Chayet is a 2020-2021 Colorado Super Lawyer in Elder Law, a 2020 and 2021 Top 100 Super Lawyer in Colorado, Law Week Colorado’s 2020 and 2017 Barristers Best Trusts/Estates lawyer and is a dual award winner by 5280 Magazine as both a top elder law attorney and probate litigator for 2021.

Mr. Chayet’s experience in his areas of practice have been demonstrated through frequent CLE lectures in Colorado and around the country and publishing, including his book, “How to Protect Your Family’s Assets from Devastating Nursing Home Costs – Colorado Edition,” and the chapter on “Estate Planning for the Child with Special Needs” in the 4th Edition of Elder Law in Colorado by CBA-CLE.

In 2017 Colorado Governor (now Senator) John Hickenlooper appointed Mr. Chayet as the gubernatorial attorney Commissioner for the Colorado Office of Public Guardian. Mr. Chayet is an Adjunct Professor of Law at the University of Colorado School of Law and teaches Elder Law. Mr. Chayet is a member of the Academy of Special Needs Planners and the National Academy of Elder Law Attorneys, where the Academy asked Mr. Chayet to serve on various committees as well as serving as the president of the Colorado Chapter of NAELA. Mr. Chayet continues to be an active member of the Colorado Bar Association assisting with drafting various rules and statutes for Colorado probate practice as well as being a Colorado Supreme Court appointee to the Attorney Disciplinary Hearing Board.

Mr. Chayet, born and raised in Denver, Colorado, is continuing in the footsteps of his family in assisting the philanthropic and civic community of Colorado by serving as the first Board Chair of The NextFifty Initiative, a $200million dollar foundation funded in 2016 that will fund grants for aging issues as well as having served on the board and committees of many not-for-profit organizations, including the Rose Community Foundation, Innovage Foundation, Jewish Family Services, Allied Jewish Apartments, Jewish Senior Recreation Network, the Foundation for Hope, and the Life Source Services Hospice.

Mr. Chayet received his Juris Doctor from the University of Colorado School of Law. Mr. Chayet’s undergraduate training was at the University of California at Berkeley and at the University of Colorado at Boulder, where he received his Bachelor of Arts.

attorneys.name: Eric Chenoweth
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal & Traffic Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
When seeking representation for criminal charges or pursuant of damages from a car accident, it is very important that you find an attorney who is confident, knowledgeable, experienced, and aggressive.

Eric Chenoweth, the senior criminal defense associate at Shazam Kianpour & Associates, is that attorney. Raised in Colorado and a home grown product, Eric attended the University of Colorado at Boulder for his undergraduate degree and earned his Juris Doctorate degree from the University of Denver. During his time at the University of Denver, Eric excelled in torts (personal injury), criminal procedure, and trial practice (where he earned the highest grade of his class). Eric Chenoweth also participated in many trial competitions and consistently placed first in nearly every category.

Criminal & Traffic: Eric Chenoweth has successfully defended countless cases from driving under the influence (DUI), driving while ability impaired (DWAI), driving under restraint (DUR), assaults, menacing, criminal mischief, economic crimes, sex crimes, drug charges, gun charges, domestic violence, escape, and many more. In every case, Eric would attack the issues with a fighters' mentality and would never shy away from going to trial and he fights, tooth and nail, to defend his clients' rights.

In addition to his prowess in the courtroom and his experience with criminal matters, Eric is a father and appreciates the value and importance of family in every day life. You can rest assured that he will take the time to focus on your needs and goals in your case. He will sit down with you and familiarize himself with your priorities and make sure that your voice is heard and the government and the judge understand your angle on how things happened and why you should get the breaks you need.

Personal Injury: Eric brings an exciting new approach to the law firm as he also specializes in personal injury cases and has a thriving practice. On accident, slip and fall, and injury cases, Eric focuses his considerable drive and ability to making sure the negligent drivers and business owners that harm his clients pay the full amount his clients deserve. He has successfully represented an incredible amount of injured victims of others negligence behind the wheel or in businesses and has received substantial recoveries on their behalf. Eric Chenoweth has represented everything from rear-end to T-bone style car crashes and slip and falls in businesses and has earned large amounts of money for many of his clients.

Eric is feverishly passionate about protecting all his clients' rights! Whether the State is trying to take your freedom away or someone injured you in a car crash, no one will fight harder for you, and nobody will sympathize more with you and understand your concerns than Eric Chenoweth! Whether you are injured, or charged with a crime or traffic case, call Eric and understand why at the law firm we say "Why Eric? Because when you need him, he is there for you".

attorneys.name: Kevin Cheney
attorneys.practice_type: Injury and Accident Law Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
Kevin is CGH's Managing Partner, helping other team members in a variety of ways.

Kevin wanted to be an attorney for as long as he can remember. Whether it was debating his bedtime or helping his brother negotiate for extra dessert, Kevin always advocated for positions he believed in. As Kevin grew up, those positions included social justice and fighting for the little guy. Now, he fights for the injured and the accused.

Kevin was born and raised in Casper, Wyoming, where he learned the importance of hard work and looking out for your neighbors. Those values continue to define him today. Hard work is essential in any profession, but nowhere is it more important than the legal profession. Sometimes just having a lawyer that will go the extra mile or spend that extra hour focused on your case is what makes the difference in the outcome. Hard work, in turn, comes from passion. Kevin passionately believes that every injured victim deserves the opportunity to seek justice. He also believes that no person should have to face the might of the government alone.

Kevin attended law school at the University of Colorado, serving as Vice President of his class. At CU Law, Kevin took every opportunity to get hands on litigation experience. He was active in the mock trial and moot court programs and won numerous tournaments throughout his law school career including the prestigious Carrigan Cup and Rothgerber Moot Court Competition. While still in law school, Kevin won his first "not guilty" verdict in a DUI trial. In another case, he successfully argued that the City of Boulder's "Use of Fighting Words Statute" violated the First Amendment. The law was struck down, and the City changed the law a short time later.

Since law school, Kevin has served as Managing Partner for Cheney Galluzzi & Howard, LLC. He has represented hundreds of clients and tried numerous cases to verdict. He has recovered millions for injured clients and helped those accused of driving under the influence and other crimes protect their constitutional rights.

Kevin is also active in his community. He is a regular teacher for Learn Your Rights in Colorado ("LYRIC"), going into local middle and high schools to teach young people about their constitutional rights. He serves on the Board, Executive Committee, and Legislative Committee for the Colorado Trial Lawyers Association, regularly testifying at the Capitol and helping laws get changed to protect consumers. He also serves on the Board of Governors and Executive Committee for the Colorado Bar Association. He serves on the Executive Council for the Colorado Bar Association's Young Lawyers Division. Finally, he is the host of the CBA YLD's Podcast "Getting' Legal With It," where he has interviewed everyone from law students to federal judges.

When Kevin is not helping clients, he enjoys talking politics, playing poker, rooting for the Buffs, Nuggets, and Broncos, and listening to electronic music. He also loves cuddling his giant Newfoundland, Pancake, and spending time with his fiancé, Reena Ramanuj.

At CGH, Kevin continues to devote himself to helping others and to the passionate practice of law. When life happens to his clients, Kevin is there to help.

Whether it was debating his bedtime or helping his brother negotiate for extra dessert, Kevin always advocated for positions he believed in. As Kevin grew up, those positions included social justice and fighting for the little guy. Now, he fights for the injured and the accused.

Kevin was born and raised in Casper, Wyoming, where he learned the importance of hard work and looking out for your neighbors. Those values continue to define him today. Hard work is essential in any profession, but nowhere is it more important than the legal profession. Sometimes just having a lawyer that will go the extra mile or spend that extra hour focused on your case is what makes the difference in the outcome. Hard work, in turn, comes from passion. Kevin passionately believes that every injured victim deserves the opportunity to seek justice. He also believes that no person should have to face the might of the government alone.

Kevin attended law school at the University of Colorado, serving as Vice President of his class. At CU Law, Kevin took every opportunity to get hands on litigation experience. He was active in the mock trial and moot court programs and won numerous tournaments throughout his law school career including the prestigious Carrigan Cup and Rothgerber Moot Court Competition. While still in law school, Kevin won his first "not guilty" verdict in a DUI trial. In another case, he successfully argued that the City of Boulder's "Use of Fighting Words Statute" violated the First Amendment. The law was struck down, and the City changed the law a short time later.

Since law school, Kevin has served as Managing Partner for Cheney Galluzzi & Howard, LLC. He has represented hundreds of clients and tried numerous cases to verdict. He has recovered millions for injured clients and helped those accused of driving under the influence and other crimes protect their constitutional rights.

Kevin is also active in his community. He is a regular teacher for Learn Your Rights in Colorado ("LYRIC"), going into local middle and high schools to teach young people about their constitutional rights. He serves on the Board, Executive Committee, and Legislative Committee for the Colorado Trial Lawyers Association, regularly testifying at the Capitol and helping laws get changed to protect consumers. He also serves on the Board of Governors and Executive Committee for the Colorado Bar Association. He serves on the Executive Council for the Colorado Bar Association's Young Lawyers Division. Finally, he is the host of the CBA YLD's Podcast "Getting' Legal With It," where he has interviewed everyone from law students to federal judges.

When Kevin is not helping clients, he enjoys talking politics, playing poker, rooting for the Buffs, Nuggets, and Broncos, and listening to electronic music. He also loves cuddling his giant Newfoundland, Pancake, and spending time with his fiancé, Reena Ramanuj.

At CGH, Kevin continues to devote himself to helping others and to the passionate practice of law. When life happens to his clients, Kevin is there to help.

attorneys.bio:
Cynthia L. Ciancio is a founding shareholder of Ciancio Ciancio Brown, P.C. She also heads up the firm’s Family Law Group. Ms. Ciancio’s practice specializes in high asset divorces and complex child custody disputes. She is also a certified mediator conducting both mediations and arbitrations for parties with or without lawyers. With over 20 years of experience exclusively in family law, and another four years prior as a Deputy District Attorney in Adams County, Ms. Ciancio has top-notch litigation experience making her stand out among her peers as a highly skilled negotiator and litigator who is able to reach favorable results for her clients both in and out of the courtroom.

Cynthia has represented hundreds of people with a wide range of issues. She is a vigorous advocate for her clients’ interests, staying highly involved with every aspect of their case. She prides herself in knowing how to move a family matter forward, whether by reaching an agreement or litigating the matter. Cynthia has appeared in all of the Denver Metro Courts and several outlying counties such as Boulder County, Weld, Summit, Lincoln, Larimer, Grand, Mesa, and Archuleta.

Cynthia is dedicated to the practice of family law and currently serves on a number of boards including, the Executive Counsel of the Colorado Bar Association’s Family Law Section, American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers, and Association of Family and Conciliation Courts. She has ten times been selected by her peers as a Super Lawyer and honored as one of Colorado’s Top 50 Women Attorneys and one of Colorado’s Top 100 Attorneys from 2012 – 2020.

attorneys.name: Denise Cook
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
Denise Cook is an Attorney at Ciancio Ciancio Brown, P.C. and is a member of the distinguished Family Law Team. Denise has represented clients with Family Law issues throughout Colorado since 1996. During that time she has been recognized by peers and was selected as a Colorado Rising Star. She is one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Rising Stars having earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in Colorado.

Denise Cook chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies at St. Mary’s College in Moraga, CA. She attended Gonzaga University School of Law, graduating with honors, and was admitted to legal practice in 1996.

While divorce and family law matters can be some of the most difficult times in a person’s life. Denise is here to help with the expertise and compassion to help clients through the process. She has specialized in all areas of family law, including but not limited to divorce, custody/allocation of parental responsibilities, parenting time, child support, division of property, grandparent visitation, paternity, and civil protection orders.

The legal process can be overwhelming, and it is the philosophy of Denise to help client’s reach a successful conclusion that will allow them to move on with their lives. Denise lives in the belief that clients need an attorney they can trust and who will help in every aspect whether it is through settlement or litigation. She understands that every case is different, and every family is unique. Denise provides personal attention to each client and case, giving each client a high level of family law expertise in order to achieve the best long-term outcome for a client. Denise understands this process can be overwhelming and works to ensure that her clients are informed and feel confident in their representation during this change in their life. Denise is known for her reasonable and realistic approach to cases in settling cases but is also a tenacious litigator should a case go before a judge.

Her clients have spoken to her high level of attention and understanding, “Denise is a top-notch lawyer. She gives you the truth – whether it’s what you want to hear or not. She does a great job of setting expectations, and she understands not only the law and people, but very importantly the judges.”

Additionally, “Denise handled my divorce with professionalism while remaining compassionate, patient, and understanding. She helped my ex and I remain amicable during the difficult process of divorcing after 20+ years.”

attorneys.bio:
Daniel R. Coombe is a partner at the law firm Coombe Curry Rich & Jarvis located in Denver, Colorado. He is a well-renowned litigator and takes on cases involving construction defects, product defects, personal injury, contractual disputes and commercial litigation. He is also a Certified Litigation Management Professional, certified by the Claims and Litigation Management Alliance.

Mr. Coombe has extensive experience representing property owners, developers, businesses and store owners with their cases. He is well known for his formulation of practical and achievable goals and is a zealous advocate for his clients. He communicates well and keeps his clients informed throughout the legal process.

With a bachelor's degree in political science and government from Knox College, Mr. Coombe obtained his doctorate in jurisprudence from the University of Denver - Sturm College of Law. While in law school, he interned at the Denver District Attorney's Office and clerked for a renowned Colorado chief district court judge.

Mr. Coombe is licensed to practice in Colorado and Illinois and before the Supreme Court Bar, the United States District Court for the District of Colorado and the United States Court of Appeals for the 10th Circuit.

An active affiliate with the legal community, Mr. Coombe has memberships in the Colorado Claims Association, the Denver Claims Association, the Claims and Litigation Management (CLM) Alliance and the Colorado Defense Lawyers Association.

Mr. Coombe has written extensively and has spoken on various topics, including resolution techniques, contractual indemnity, complex litigation and risk transfer, at many renowned legal associations and continuing legal education seminars.

Recognized for his legal work, Mr. Coombe was listed in the 10 Best Personal Injury Law Attorney (Defense) for Client Satisfaction in Colorado by the American Institute of Personal Injury Attorneys and named to the list of Top 40 Under 40 Litigation Lawyer in Colorado by the American Society of Legal Advocates. He has also received a 9.3 rating on Avvo.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
Daniel R. Coombe is a partner at the law firm Coombe Curry Rich & Jarvis located in Denver, Colorado. He is a well-renowned litigator and takes on cases involving construction defects, product defects, personal injury, contractual disputes and commercial litigation. He is also a Certified Litigation Management Professional, certified by the Claims and Litigation Management Alliance.

Mr. Coombe has extensive experience representing property owners, developers, businesses and store owners with their cases. He is well known for his formulation of practical and achievable goals and is a zealous advocate for his clients. He communicates well and keeps his clients informed throughout the legal process.

With a bachelor's degree in political science and government from Knox College, Mr. Coombe obtained his doctorate in jurisprudence from the University of Denver - Sturm College of Law. While in law school, he interned at the Denver District Attorney's Office and clerked for a renowned Colorado chief district court judge.

Mr. Coombe is licensed to practice in Colorado and Illinois and before the Supreme Court Bar, the United States District Court for the District of Colorado and the United States Court of Appeals for the 10th Circuit.

An active affiliate with the legal community, Mr. Coombe has memberships in the Colorado Claims Association, the Denver Claims Association, the Claims and Litigation Management (CLM) Alliance and the Colorado Defense Lawyers Association.

Mr. Coombe has written extensively and has spoken on various topics, including resolution techniques, contractual indemnity, complex litigation and risk transfer, at many renowned legal associations and continuing legal education seminars.

Recognized for his legal work, Mr. Coombe was listed in the 10 Best Personal Injury Law Attorney (Defense) for Client Satisfaction in Colorado by the American Institute of Personal Injury Attorneys and named to the list of Top 40 Under 40 Litigation Lawyer in Colorado by the American Society of Legal Advocates. Henry grew up in Denver and graduated from the University of Colorado School of Law. In his spare time, Henry is a coach for the Columbine High School Boys Basketball team and enjoys golf and the outdoors.

attorneys.name: Robert M. Cooper Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Broomfield, CO
attorneys.bio:
I graduated from the University of Denver, College of Law in 1983. During the first part of my law career, I worked for several small firms as a civil litigator handling a variety of business, real estate matters and lawsuits. I gained an understanding of how businesses operate and experience resolving business related disputes. I also gained courtroom experience working as a prosecutor for the City of Lakewood. In 1988, I started what is now known as Cooper & Tanis, P.C.

Over the years, I started limiting my practice. I knew that I preferred working with people with issues and disputes, rather than businesses. Fifteen years ago, I decided to limit my practice solely to divorce and family law related cases. With my business experience, I am able to deal with complex marital estates and enjoy working in cases with complex financial issues.

I believe divorces are often controlled by emotions, typically sadness, anger and loss. So that I could help my clients cope with the underlying emotional issues in divorce cases, I returned to school. In 2010, I obtained a Master's degree in Psychology Counseling from Regis University. With this training, I am better able to understand the difficult emotional world the parties and their children are experiencing. When children are involved in divorce cases, I regard them as the most important part of the case. Children's needs are paramount to the parties' needs. It is my goal to reduce conflict between parties and, thereby, reduce harm to the children caused by their parents' disputes.

I often tell clients that the legal system is an inefficient, expensive and ineffective way to resolve family disputes. I therefore try to settle every case. When parties settle cases, they understand what they are getting. This lays the groundwork to resolve future issues. However, a small number of cases cannot be resolved out of court. When clients are forced to have a judge resolve their case, I spend a lot of time with them preparing for trial. Although I seek to avoid the courtroom, I enjoy trying cases. When settlement between the parties is not possible, going to court is the way disputes are resolved.

As a lawyer, I view myself as a guide to the legal system. Over the years, I have gained experience and maturity to handle almost any family law case. Even after 30 years of being in the same business, I still really enjoy my work and being a lawyer.

attorneys.name: Nicholas Cortes
attorneys.firm_name: The Law Firm of Springer & Steinberg
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
Nicholas Cortes is a skilled attorney at Springer & Steinberg P.C. in Denver, Colorado, specializing in Criminal Defense, with additional expertise in Personal Injury and Immigration Law. Since obtaining his license in 2023, Nicholas has quickly established a strong reputation for his legal skills and dedication to justice, recognized by the 2024 Denver Bar Association and Access to Justice Pro Bono All-Star Award for his outstanding pro bono work.

Nicholas is distinguished by his commanding courtroom presence and profound understanding of evidence rules. His trials include acquittals for clients charged with misdemeanor and felony offenses. In April of 2023 Nicholas orchestrated and executed a legal strategy as the lead attorney in trial where his client was charged with serious felonies and facing 30+ years in prison. After a grueling five-day trial against two respected and formidable District Attorneys his client was found not guilty on all charges. Nicholas has built a robust network of professionals—including health experts, forensic accountants, and private investigators—to support his cases.

His journey to the practice of law is demonstrative of his resilience and leadership. Overcoming significant personal challenges and distinguished service in the Marine Corps, where he earned accolades for leadership and performance, Nicholas shifted his focus to law after an injury during his deployment to Afghanistan.

Outside of work, Nicholas coaches youth basketball for the City of Denver and enjoys spending time with his dog. For clients seeking a dedicated and proficient attorney, Nicholas Cortes offers a blend of strategic insight, controlled aggression and a deep commitment to achieving justice.

“I define my success by the impact I have on people’s lives. I’m honored to even be in this position where I get the privilege to fight for people in their darkest hours.”

attorneys.name: Megan E. Courtney
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
Megan E. Courtney is an Associate Attorney at Ciancio Ciancio Brown, P.C. and a member of the Family Law Team. A native of Michigan and a graduate of Michigan State College of Law, Megan has been a practicing since 2011. Her practice includes high asset divorce, high conflict divorce, divorce involving businesses and business valuation issues, drafting marital agreements, and resolving child custody disputes. Megan also has a background in small business civil cases, Chapter 7 & Chapter 13 bankruptcy cases, and as a financial advisor.

As the child of a high conflict divorce, Megan has first-hand experience from the minor child’s perspective, and she holds the physical, emotional, and psychological protection of children as her highest priority. Additionally, she has experienced firsthand the generational effects that a divorce can have on a family. Megan understands that, when handled correctly, a divorce can simply be a difficult chapter in a family’s life; if handled incorrectly, it can be a life altering event for all members of the family. Megan passionately represents her clients in a manner that consistently puts the wellbeing of the client and their children in the forefront of her practice.

Clients who have worked with Megan speak to her understanding of their wants and needs and her ability to bring those wants and needs to fruition, her ability to teach her clients complicated legal concepts, and her compassion such that each client feels empowered and in control of their case. Regardless of the situation, rest assured that Megan can handle your case with a high-level of skill and deep empathy.

Megan strives to make the attorney-client relationship one that is positive and long lasting, rather than a necessary evil.

attorneys.firm_name: The Law Office of Stephen Vertucci, LLC
attorneys.practice_type: Divorce & Separation Lawyers in Fort Collins, CO
attorneys.bio:
Joanne C. Crebassa, an almost lifelong Coloradoan from Loveland, began her collegiate studies at Boston University. Returning to Colorado, Joanne successfully balanced the rigors of academic life and family life, graduating summa cum laude with a Bachelor of Arts Degree from the University of Northern Colorado in 1993.

In addition to her studies at UNC, Joanne participated in a program called Project Self-Sufficiency, a non-profit organization dedicated to helping single parents overcome financial barriers and challenging life circumstances. Inspired by the program and its participants, many of whom faced complicated legal issues related to parenting and child support, Joanne was determined to achieve her goal of becoming a lawyer. In 1994, Joanne was accepted to The School of Law at the University of California, Davis, a top-tier law school, nationally and internationally recognized for its commitment to social responsibility, professional excellence, high ethical standards, and public service. While at UC-Davis, Joanne had the extraordinary opportunity to study under nationally renowned professor and author, Edward Imwinklereid, whose publications on evidence and trial practice are widely used at law schools across the United States. While under his tutelage, Joanne developed a deeper interest in trial advocacy. Joanne earned her Juris Doctorate degree from UC-Davis in 1997.

attorneys.name: Thomas Crowley JD
attorneys.practice_type: Workers’ Compensation Lawyers in Northglenn, CO
attorneys.bio:
Hello, my name is Tom Crowley. I am part of the Workers' Compensation team at the Ramos Law Firm. I joined Ramos Law in 2022 because of the fantastic culture of the firm. I am originally from Green Bay, Wisconsin. I practiced in the Chicago, IL area for over 15 years before moving to Colorado in late 2017. The bulk of my legal career was spent representing insurance companies and defending workers' compensation and liability claims.

The best career decision I have ever made was to stop representing insurance companies and start representing injured workers. My experience and knowledge of the insurance defense industry allows me to effectively represent injured workers, and counter the tactics of insurance companies when they delay or deny claims.

The most important lesson that I have learned throughout my career is that every client and their case is unique, and every client and their case require individual attention, and a personal style of communication. There are no "cookie-cutter" cases or clients. I am happy to be a part of the Ramos Law family because of the firm's focus on personal service to every client, regardless of the value of their case.

When I am not working, my twin teenage daughters and I enjoy the many outdoor activities Colorado has to offer, including camping, hiking, and paddleboarding. We also love watching NFL football, especially the Green Bay Packers.

Ramos Law is always here to help. If there is ever anything you need, please do not hesitate to reach out.

attorneys.name: Rodger Daley
attorneys.firm_name: The Law Offices of Rodger C. Daley and Associates
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law and Divorce Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
Rodger Daley earned his Bachelor of Science Degree at Upsala College in East Orange, New Jersey, in 1974. He received his Master's Degree from the University of Colorado in 1979 and his Juris Doctorate from the University of Denver in 1982. His outstanding scholarly achievements in law school led to his induction into the Order of Saint Ives Honor Society.

After acquiring years of experience in handling family law cases, Mr. Daley formed his law firm, the Law Offices of Rodger C. Daley, in 1991. At all times thereafter Mr. Daley's firm has focused the vast majority of its practice on representing individuals who are involved in a myriad of family law problems and issues.

The issues attendant to the dissolution of a marriage or to any dispute between parents typically involve child custody (now known as parental responsibility) and visitation (now known as parenting time). These very important issues need to be handled with a great deal of care and sensitivity to the needs of the children.

Other matters which Mr. Daley and other members of his firm have a great deal of experience and expertise in resolving include the financial issues of child support, maintenance (also known as alimony), and property division, the resolution of which may require a thorough investigation of the financial circumstances of the other party and a corresponding aggressive pursuit of the desired result.

As Mr. Daley's past and present clients attest, Mr. Daley is known for his high quality legal performance and his relentless drive to obtain the best possible results for his clients. These characteristics are evidenced by Mr. Daley's Martindale-Hubbell Peer Review Rating. Mr. Daley's legal ability is rated A (Very High to Preeminent), and his ethical standard rating is rated V (Very High).

Perhaps most importantly, Mr. Daley is genuinely concerned for the welfare of his clients and for the welfare of their children. This concern motivates him to achieve the best results possible for each of his clients.

attorneys.name: Matthew Dall
attorneys.practice_type: Credit Disputes and Credit Repair Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
Matthew Dall is a third generation attorney. Before he attended law school in Lansing, Michigan he graduated from the University of Wisconsin - Madison. While attending school, he volunteered his time to help others in the ER Operating Room as an Operation Room Aid at a local hospital. In addition, Matthew was an activist for Aids Awareness throughout his undergraduate career. Upon graduation, Matthew became a private and group ski instructor in Breckenridge, Colorado. Throughout Matthew's experiences leading to law school, Matthew learned that he wanted to live a life of helping others in difficult times of need.

While attending law school, he gained a wealth of experience in family law and domestic relations. He clerked for a well established Michigan based family and criminal law practice. There he was able to hone his skills in litigation argumentation development and difficult legal research. He has worked on complex family law matters and also criminal law matters. He has been able to use his extensive research skills to develop legal based arguments that often aid in the success of difficult cases. After graduating law school, Matthew moved to Colorado and began working for a small family law firm. There, he gained the necessary experience to guide clients through the often difficult process of a family law matter.

Whether teaching individuals how to ski or working as a legal advocate, Matthew serves to represent his client's best interests by way of providing compassionate, caring and capable representation. Matthew is an attorney who understands your case, your concerns and knows how to fight for your rights.

As an attorney with Gantenbein Law, Mr. Dall focuses his extensive knowledge on Credit Disputes and Credit Repair, Family Law, Business Formation Documentation and Trademark Documentation, Homeowners' Association Defense, Foreclosure Defense, Real Estate Law and Landlord/ Tenant Issues.

Nicole C. Daniels is a Broomfield personal injury attorney who has been representing injured clients since 2006. While Mrs. Daniels is not representing clients, she enjoys spending time with her husband and two daughters. She enjoys the Colorado lifestyle, especially hiking, skiing, golfing, water sports, and horseback riding. Mrs. Daniels also devotes her time to mentoring and coaching youth sports.

attorneys.name: Frank J Danzo III
attorneys.practice_type: Estate Planning Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
As a 10 year old, Frank witnessed firsthand the legal consequences a catastrophic injury can cause to a family. When his aunt, at the age of only 36, was severely injured in a head-on car accident, his entire family was overwhelmed for the next 12 years as she lay in a nursing home in a coma, before finally passing away. After experiencing the terrible complications such a situation causes spouses, children, parents and siblings, he made it his goal to develop the legal skills to assist clients to plan appropriately to minimize the emotional turmoil should the worst happen.

Frank focuses his practice in the areas of Estate Planning, Special Needs Planning, Asset Protection Planning, Charitable Planning, Legacy Planning, Medicaid and Public Benefits Planning, Business Planning (including entity formation and succession planning), Estate and Gift Tax Planning, and Estate and Trust Administration and Litigation. He also helps existing clients with Real Estate transactions (including construction law) and Consumer Advocacy issues. He has prepared over 5000 estate plans as an attorney, as well as handling over 975 estate and trust administrations.

Frank has achieved the highest rating for both legal and ethical standards (AV) by the most prestigious lawyer rating firm, Martindale Hubbell for the past four years in a row. He has also been named a prestigious Five Star Wealth Advisor in the top 4% of Estate Planning Attorneys for 2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014 and 2015 by 5280 magazine and ColoradoBiz magazine. Frank was also named a SuperLawyer for 2014, 2015 and 2016. For the past four years he has co-authored a book titled, "How to Protect Your Family's Assets From Devastating Nursing Home Costs--Medicaid Secrets", as well as co-authoring the "Planning for Special Needs Children" Chapter in the Colorado Bar Association's Colorado Handbook of Elder Law for the past five years.

Frank has lectured extensively on estate planning to various groups around Colorado, including those associated with Colorado Jumpstart, Great West Life, Denver Community Credit Union, Senior Planning Services, Kaiser Permanente, US West/Qwest, Capital Management Group, the Colorado association of Public Employees, Senior Tax Advisory, AG Edwards, Edward Jones, Wells Fargo, The National Association of Retired Federal Employees, Coors, and numerous churches, temples and labor unions throughout the state. Frank is often asked to speak on television and radio given his broad experience in estate planning. He has taught classes on Estate Planning and Estate/Trust Administration for the Colorado Bar Association, National Business Institute, Front Range Community College and Colorado Mountain College.

Frank is a Colorado native who graduated from Regis Jesuit High School and enjoys spending time with his wife Melissa and young children Zachary, Taylor and Jaden. Frank graduated from the University of Colorado with a B.S. degree in Political Science, receiving his Juris Doctor from the University of Colorado School of Law. Frank is admitted to the Colorado Bar and is a member of the Denver and Colorado Bar Associations, where he belongs to the Trust and Estate, and Elder Law Sections. He is also a member of the Denver Estate Planning Council and the National Academy of Elder Law Attorneys.

attorneys.name: Kyle W. Davenport
attorneys.practice_type: Commercial Litigation Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
Kyle Davenport has broad litigation experience emphasizing the automotive industry, oil & gas, and general business litigation. He also advises a wide variety of businesses in compliance with federal, state and local laws and regulations.

Kyle represents national, regional and local automobile dealers throughout Colorado. His automotive practice covers all manner of disputes with manufacturers, disputes with suppliers and service providers, consumer protection disputes, disputes with employees including sexual harassment and discrimination claims, and other business litigation. Kyle also advises his dealer clients on compliance with the many applicable federal, state and local laws and regulations.

In the areas of oil & gas and natural resources, Kyle has represented individuals and businesses in virtually every phase of the production and sale of oil & gas, including royalty owners, producers, land men and leaseholders. Kyle also advises clients on compliance with federal and state laws and regulations. He has experience representing clients in Colorado, Wyoming, New Mexico, Utah, Nevada, Kansas, and Texas.

Prior to his career in law, Kyle was an environmental consultant in Denver. He performed field research in oil & gas projects and timber projects in southwestern Colorado and in the Powder River Basin. He prepared NEPA reports for oil & gas projects and timber projects in the western United States and Canada. He also monitored compliance with FERC regulations on pipeline projects in Illinois.

Kyle is experienced in representing creditors in bankruptcy. He has represented individuals and businesses in all forms of bankruptcy and is experienced in adversarial actions on automatic stay violations, trustee avoidance actions, and actions to declare debts nondischargable.

Finally, Kyle has a broad range of experience in business litigation. He has represented clients in a variety of business torts (such as intentional interference with contract), employment and discrimination suits, noncompete agreement disputes, personal injury defense suits, and construction disputes.

Damon then moved back to Grand Junction where he took a position as an associate attorney at the precursory to Killian, Davis & Richter, P.C., before working his way to a shareholder position. attorneys.name: Christopher "Kit" Davlin
attorneys.practice_type: Litigation Lawyers in Colorado Springs, CO
attorneys.bio:
Robinson & Henry Partner Christopher “Kit” Davlin is a savvy, seasoned litigator with a long track record of success. While Kit aims to resolve his clients’ issues through pre-litigation strategies, he is effective in the courtroom if out-of-court solutions prove elusive.

He leverages his diverse background in business, communication, and the entertainment industry to tailor solutions for the complex issues that often affect business ventures and partnerships.

Kit has successfully litigated cases in Colorado’s local, district, and appeals courts, as well as the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit.

Representative matters

Retrieved rent abatement - Recovered substantial rent abatement funds and additional expenses for a tenant whose apartment became uninhabitable

Eliminated liens - Successfully removed multiple mechanics' liens from the client's property, shifting liability back to the general contractor who misallocated payments intended for subcontractors.

Negotiated large settlement - Secured a judgment against a fraudulent auto mechanic, securing five times the initial repair quote for the client, including treble damages and attorney fees

Lawsuit defense - Defended an HOA against a frivolous lawsuit and obtained a court ruling that deemed the complaint groundless and vexatious

attorneys.name: Daniel N. Deasy
attorneys.practice_type: Child Support Lawyers in Greenwood Village, CO
attorneys.bio:
I am now in my 30th year practicing law in the wonderful State of Colorado. I have spent all those years in our courtrooms, traveling across the state to fight for clients in family law (divorce and postdivorce), personal injury, and minor criminal defense matters. While courtroom work is something I love, working toward just resolutions in cases always comes first. At Ammarell Deasy, we pride ourselves in our ability to fashion resolutions that give our clients control of outcomes - outside of courtrooms. As for me, there is very little that I have not encountered in the legal world, so if you need help dealing with anything, feel free to track me down to see if I can either give you the full service of our firm or steer you in the right direction.

When seeking legal counsel, "fit" matters. You need to make sure you have comfort and security working with your lawyer. I know that when people need attorneys, the circumstances usually aren't the best. We work hard to meet your needs and give you timely guidance in challenging times. While we can never guarantee you a result, we can promise to do everything we can to deliver the outcome you seek!

We have dealt with everything from multi-million-dollar estates to horribly abusive relationships in the family law arena. What we value even more than the "work," however, are the relationships we build with clients. When Laura and I started Ammarell Deasy, we decided that our firm would be different from the places we had left behind - focused on commitments to customer service and superior representation. As the proud son of a retired Denver Police Officer, I learned the value of service at a very young age. I also learned through various legal mentors over the years that effort never takes a day off. Put a service motive and effort together and you have a family law attorney ready to help no matter how difficult the circumstances.

When not in the office, I spend a great deal of time teaching. I travel around the nation teaching advocates how to stand up before judges and juries and "do it" the right way for the National Institute for Trial Advocacy (NITA). I have been selected to serve as faculty for the American Bar Association's Family Law Trial Advocacy Institute in Boulder, Colorado. I have taught at the Colorado District Attorney's Council, for the Colorado Defense Lawyers' Association, the Denver City Attorney's Office, the Colorado County Attorneys Association and for the Colorado Bar Association on multiple occasions. I think I have lectured on every aspect of courtroom work over the last ten years for both state and federal litigators. I have worked as an adjunct law professor at the University of Denver Sturm College of Law for two decades and I am proud to see many of my former law students working hard in Colorado's courtrooms and law firms, with a few having taken the bench. I am also a past President of the Douglas/Elbert Bar Association and a past Regional Vice-President for the Colorado Bar Association.

After all these years, I am humbled to know that my colleagues think I bring something positive to the profession, as the links below show. I can't help but remember what my mom and dad told me many years ago: "You won't get any place in this world unless the people you work with want you around."

These days, if I am not doing something in the legal world, I am probably cycling down some roadway or path in Colorado or trying to lift weights, wondering why I'm not as strong as I was at 25 years old!! With two degrees from the University of Colorado, you can imagine how much I love my Buffaloes on fall Saturdays. Of course, that love is matched only by my passion for the Broncos on Sundays!

And of course, ultimately, the balance I try to keep in my life is tethered by my wife. I told her ten years ago that when the angels ask what I loved most about life, the answer will be "you." That never changes.

Many attorneys have discovered reputations matter in our world of social media and on-line reviews.

When a pair of judges were asked to evaluate co-founding partner Daniel Deasy in the areas of legal knowledge, analytical capabilities, judgment, communication ability and legal experience, they offered the following:

Tremendous litigator - able to quickly analyze a case and prepare persuasive arguments. Knows the law extremely well. Has a rare gift of being able to connect with jurors and witnesses in a friendly, nonintimidating way to put them at ease. Incredibly hard worker- will go the extra mile (or ten) to adequately prepare and present his case. Has earned the unqualified trust, respect and admiration of this judicial officer. Highest possible recommendation.

Outstanding trial attorney. Ethics beyond reproach. One of the best litigators I've ever seen - persuasive, reasonable and knowledgeable. Would place the highest confidence in him and his abilities. Tremendous grasp of the rules of evidence and procedure. Highest recommendation.

Attorneys in Colorado offer the following comments about Mr. Deasy:

Grade "A", First Class, Outstanding Lawyer.

Dan is an excellent trial attorney.

Dan is an excellent lawyer who cares deeply about his clients. I have tried cases against him and hold him in the highest regard.

Daniel Deasy has quickly distinguished himself as one of the top Family Law practitioners in the State. I have referred clients to Dan and he has taken great care of them - enhancing his reputation in the process while protecting mine!

While it's nice to be recognized by colleagues and judges, clients have kind comments about Daniel Deasy as well: The words, kindness and guidance I have received from this practice, have been life changing for me. Everyone that is a part of this team, from the front desk all the way to the attorneys, have helped me regain my sanity and strength, something, that I had been missing for so long. Everyone I've interacted with at this office has been more than kind to me. There have been times, when I was a complete and utter mess or needed a lifeline, and with every interaction with Dan, or the wonderful people behind the scenes, they took their time to just help or listen to me. The moment I landed at the front steps of their office, the chaos began to finally stop and started fading away. I could finally see that there was a light at the end of the tunnel and what my path forward would be. To anyone wearing the shoes I was when I arrived at their door, there is help, and the office of Ammarell Deasy is it. I truly can't say enough amazing things about everyone at this practice! Thank you again for everything!

Finding words to express my gratitude to the Ammarell Deasy Law Office is hard because how do I put into words what family means to me? Dan and Shawn took my very difficult case by the horns and rode it like a bull ride at the National Rodeo Championships. They fought hard for me in pursuit of my greatest assets in life......my three precious children. They surrounded me every step of the way and pulled and pushed me through a nightmare I never expected to experience. If you are traversing the walk through the Hell that a conflicted divorce can create, Ammarell Deasy will guide you, protect you and advocate for you relentlessly with a safety first and no fear mindset until you make it out on the other side. I don't promise much but I promise you that you will be in the arms of valiant warriors fiercely committed to ensuring the right outcome for you and your family. And family is who they are and always will be to me. This law firm redefined gratitude for me. Thank you!

Mr Dan Deasy represented me through my very technical divorce and did an amazing job. I respect him very much as a lawyer and a friend. He ALWAYS had my family's best interest in mind. I highly recommend him and his firm to anyone seeking representation. I love you Dan! Thank you!

I began working with Dan more than six years ago in a very, very contentious custody battle. I have to say that, without a doubt, he is the finest courtroom attorney I have ever seen - and I have worked with several. Watching him fight for my girls was unbelievable. For anyone who asks about my experience and needs help, I just say, "you have to hire Dan Deasy." Dan just gets it. I can't imagine ever looking elsewhere for help in a custody case.

My entire experience with Mr. Deasy and his office has been amazing. Since my consultation I have felt completely confident that I could not have hired a better attorney. I was continually kept informed of everything involving my case, was prepared for my trial exceptionally well and very satisfied with the results. Mr. Deasy is an amazing attorney that is very knowledgeable and his courtroom demeanor is unsurpassed. He put me at ease with the situation even in the most stressful moments. His staff and fellow attorneys were exceptional as well, every communication I have had with them was handled professionally and promptly.

I have worked with Dan since 2009 and he is, simply put, a miracle worker. He understands the needs of his clients and makes sure that everything makes sense along the way. There is nothing he is not prepared to handle in the courtroom. Having looked back at some of the reviews on another website, judges use the words "excellent" and "outstanding" in describing his courtroom skills - they are more than right. I give Dan the highest recommendation possible.
