attorneys.name: Myles S. Johnson
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
Myles embarked on his legal journey with a clear vision, originally intending to specialize as a criminal defense attorney. Prior to law school, Myles engaged in prison ministry, where he deeply empathized with those incarcerated, recognizing the role of grace in his own life's trajectory. Motivated by a desire to effect positive change, he pursued legal studies, eventually joining Johnson Law Group. This decision not only aligned with his professional aspirations but also offered the unique opportunity to collaborate with his spouse, fostering a harmonious blend of work and personal fulfillment.

Education and Professional Experience: A graduate of the Monfort College of Business at the University of Northern Colorado, Myles earned the Academic Excellence Award for his outstanding scholastic achievements. Subsequently, he obtained his law degree from the University of Colorado at Boulder School of Law, where he honed his skills as a student attorney with the Family Law Clinical Program. Myles further enriched his legal acumen through diverse professional experiences, serving as a law clerk at a Boulder litigation firm and a legal intern at Centennial telecommunications company, Verio, Inc.

Contributions to the Legal Community: Prior to joining Johnson Law Group, Myles garnered valuable experience at both mid-sized and boutique law firms, where he practiced in areas ranging from probate, real estate, and business litigation to high-end family law and general civil litigation. His multifaceted background equips him with a comprehensive understanding of legal intricacies, enabling him to provide strategic and tailored solutions to clients.

Recognizing Excellence: Myles is an active participant in professional organizations, holding memberships in the Colorado Bar Association and the Sam Cary Bar Association. Recognized for his exceptional contributions to the legal field, Myles has received accolades such as the Sam Cary Bar Association's Billy Lewis Young Lawyer Award in 2016. He has also been honored as one of the American Institute of Family Law Attorneys' 10 Best Attorneys for Colorado in 2015 and as one of the Top 10 Attorneys Under 40 by the National Academy of Family Law Attorneys in 2016.

attorneys.name: Tracy J. Jones
attorneys.practice_type: Trust & Estate, Probate Lawyers in Evergreen, CO
attorneys.bio:
Many Estate Planning Law Firms in Colorado will sell you a trust template to serve as your Estate Plan. That type of firm is commonly referred to as a "Trust Mill". Our law firm is different, we never provide cookie cutter plans. We make sure that your estate plan is YOUR ESTATE PLAN and take the time to help you understand the many options available in Estate Planning. Your Estate Plan will be tailored specifically for you and your family's circumstances.

I have been practicing law for over 25 years. I practice almost exclusively in the areas of Estate Planning, Trusts, and Probate Matters. I serve as a Professional Fiduciary by serving as Trustee, Personal Representative or Power of Attorney for clients who do not wish to name family members in those positions.

A Professional Fiduciary is often in a better position to objectively carry out the roles of Trustee or Executor because they are not influenced by emotions, personal agendas or family conflicts. Naming an Attorney for these type of roles helps to avoid conflicts of interest (real or perceived) with the grantor or beneficiaries that can influence decision making or leave the fiduciary subject to conflict, criticism and potential legal action...all of which increase the time to complete the probate process and the costs incurred by the Estate. A Professional Fiduciary offers a range of services that serve to ensure a smooth administration and meet the objectives of the grantor of the Trust or testator.

Hiring Jones Law Office means you have experienced attorneys to assist with the Administration of your Estate or Trust. As financial circumstances become more complex, the value of professional guidance cannot be overemphasized. Jones Law Office is positioned to provide trusted experience in administration and oversight, whether it be in drafting your estate plan, establishing a long term relationship with your family and heirs, or serving as your Trustee or Agent. We are committed to maintaining the highest fiduciary standards and surpassing the expectations of the clients we serve.

In my spare time I enjoy staying active in our Evergreen community where I reside with my husband and four children. I can often be seen around town or in the mountains hiking and biking with my family and two golden doodles.

attorneys.bio:
Nick Jonson brings over 27 years of experience to the practice of law. Nick Jonson is recognized as a skillful and strong litigator who guides his clients through their toughest transition periods. Nick Jonson has the depth and breadth of experience that can only be gained through years of experience. Whether your case calls for practiced litigation skills or thoughtful and skillful negotiations, Nick Jonson has the know-how and the ability to protect and defend you, your assets, and your children in the divorce, custody, or criminal matter. Nick Jonson understands that if you are going through a divorce or other family law proceeding, that it is probably one of the most difficult times of your life and he therefore strives to achieve the best results possible.

Nick Jonson has also maintained a criminal defense practice throughout his entire career. If you or your loved ones have been charged with a crime, you want someone who is experienced, knowledgeable of the law, and is accessible. Nick Jonson's criminal defense practice includes representing clients charged with misdemeanors, felonies, and DUIs. Nick Jonson has also frequently defended those accused of domestic violence. Nick Jonson's single-minded focus is to protect the rights of his client and he will work hard to achieve the best possible outcome.

Nick began practicing law in January 1995 and provides legal services in all Denver metro area courts including Jefferson, Douglas, Adams, Denver, and Arapahoe Counties.

attorneys.name: Keith Karnes
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Colorado Springs, CO
attorneys.bio:
Keith Karnes is an experienced litigator who leverages his background in criminal law to zealously represent his family law clients.

Keith began his legal career as a Deputy District Attorney for Colorado’s 11th Judicial District, where he notably prosecuted assault cases between inmates within the Department of Corrections in Canon City. He also served as a prosecutor for the People of Pueblo County, where he earned a reputation for resolving cases through alternative means, such as inpatient treatment and diversion programs. Keith completed approximately 50 criminal jury trials and hundreds of evidentiary hearings during his tenure.

Keith entered private practice in 2021, honing his criminal defense and family law experience. He has defended clients against a diverse range of criminal charges, demonstrating his capability to provide comprehensive representation in domestic relations matters. As a family law attorney, his practice spans contested and uncontested divorces, parenting time and decision-making disputes, parental abductions, contempt actions, child support, and post-decree modifications.

Clients working with Keith can expect to receive a passionate legal representative who will work tirelessly to ensure each client receives a just and favorable outcome.

Representative matters:

Motion to restrict parenting time – Convinced court to change parental responsibilities, recognize client as custodial parent, and reduce opposing party’s parenting time to supervised visitation.

Motion for contempt of court – Obtained make-up parenting time and attorney fees by filing contempt of court action against parent for withholding parenting time.

Allocation of parental responsibilities – Obtained joint decision-making and split parenting time schedule for client despite aggressive legal challenges from the opposing party

The attorney you choose to represent you in state or municipal criminal court should be hardworking, dedicated, knowledgeable, creative and aggressive in protecting your rights.

I am exactly that kind of lawyer and have been for 20 years in the Colorado mountains area. I am J.B. Katz, founder of the law offices of J.B. Katz, P.C. in Breckenridge.

Clients from all walks of life have come to trust my legal guidance, consistent commitment and reputation for results. I have represented businesspersons and juveniles, local residents and vacationing tourists, illegal and nonresident aliens.

I urge you to contact me immediately if a felony or misdemeanor arrest is jeopardizing your freedoms and future. My convenient phone number is listed below.

My law offices of J.B. Katz, P.C. serves criminal defense clients in Eagle County, Clear Creek County, Lake County, Park County and Summit County of Colorado.

Fast Response, Personal Attention to Your Legal Problems

As an experienced solo practitioner in criminal law, I can devote the entirety of my time and energy to safeguarding your interests in these practice areas:

Criminal defense: including assault, domestic violence, drug offenses, DUI, theft, sex crimes and probation violations

DUI: challenging drunk driving charges in court for first time and repeat offenders, alleged involvement in DUI accidents, DUID (DUI with drugs) charges and for DMV hearings or driver's license revocation

Juvenile charges: representation of minor children and their families in municipal court for cases of disorderly conduct, vandalism, marijuana possession and underage consumption

My law practice is focused exclusively on criminal defense; to hold prosecutors to their burden of proof and reveal any fact, any testimony, any piece of evidence that can help you avoid a conviction and harsh penalties. As your lawyer, I research and investigate each case as if it is going to trial.

The selection process for Colorado Super Lawyers Rising Stars is rigorous and the result of third-party validation of professional accomplishments. attorneys.name: Katie Kellett
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense and Litigation Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
I have dedicated my career to advocating for those charged with crimes and fighting for a result that aligns with their goals. I know those goals are different for every person and I am committed to a client centered approach throughout my representation.

Meet Criminal Defense Attorney Katie Kellett

I have spent the entirety of my career in the courtroom representing clients who have been accused of various crimes. I understand it is incredibly intimidating to have the full force of the government breathing down your neck, and I have a passion for coming alongside you and guiding you through the process. As a public defender for 3.5 years, I represented clients charged at every level from DUIs and misdemeanors to first degree murder. I have appeared in multiple courtrooms and jurisdictions representing adults and juveniles.

I have worked tirelessly to ensure that clients get the best outcome possible. I understand those goals are different for each person. I am a zealous advocate willing to fight for the wrongly accused. I have also proven to be an effective negotiator in presenting extensive mitigation to DAs and judges to show my clients are so much more than what they are accused of.

Katie's Approach

I aim to thoughtfully listen to your concerns, goals and questions about the process from the beginning of the case until the end. I am dedicated to fighting for those goals while advising you of realistic outcomes. I am not intimidated by the government’s tactics and will carefully litigate your case through investigation, pretrial motions, and trial. Through this approach I have been able to get many cases dismissed before they ever made it to trial.

As a Christian attorney, I acknowledge the value in every individual and that people are worth so much more than the crime they are accused of. It is my honor to bring the story of every person to the district attorney and the judge by getting to know my clients personally and gaining their trust.

attorneys.name: John Kellner Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Greenwood Village, CO
attorneys.bio:
John Kellner most recently served as the elected District Attorney for Arapahoe, Douglas, Elbert and Lincoln counties, where he was responsible for seeking justice for over 1.1 million Coloradans. As a highly accomplished lawyer with unique trial experience and elite trial skills, he tried several of Colorado’s toughest and most prominent cold cases. Throughout his career John has been recognized as the top prosecutor in the state and by Mothers Against Drunk Drivers for holding reckless drivers accountable. John is passionate about fighting for those who have been harmed by others, including serious injury and wrongful death cases.

John is a U.S. Marine Corps and Afghanistan War veteran who served on active duty as a trial counsel, operational law attorney, and Special Assistant United States Attorney. He continues to serve as a Lieutenant Colonel in the Marine Corps Reserves, responding to natural disasters and homeland defense missions.

John is a graduate of the University of Colorado-Boulder School of Law. He and his wife Sarah are avid skiers and love to spend time with their children.

attorneys.name: Laura Kendrick
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
Laura Kendrick is a family law attorney at the Kendrick Family Legal Solutions, LLC, in Denver, Colorado.

Ms. Kendrick worked on a domestic relations caseload exclusively throughout her internship with the Honorable Judge Arkin (Retired). Soon after, she was accepted into the Civil Litigation Clinic at the University of Denver, where she was able to pursue her interest in family law.

Ms. Kendrick spent her final year of law school where she worked as a domestic relations law clerk at Litvak Litvak Mehrtens and Carlton, P.C. During her employment there, she was able to obtain valuable experience researching and briefing complex legal issues, as well as assisting in the writing of multiple appeals.

After clearing the bar exam, Ms. Kendrick worked as an associate attorney for over five years at the firm of Sharon D. Liko, P.C., again devoting her entire practice to family law matters. She collaborated closely with Ms. Liko on a wide range of complex issues relating to family life, with a particular focus on the rights of men.

Ms. Kendrick is the managing attorney and president at Kendrick Family Legal Solutions, LLC, a firm she founded in pursuit of her goals. When it comes to domestic relations, her strengths and personality shine most when the stakes are high and there is a lot at stake.

attorneys.name: Aaron S. Kennedy
attorneys.practice_type: Workers’ Compensation Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
Aaron S. Kennedy’s family moved to Colorado when he was a young child. He grew up in Pueblo West and studied at the University of Colorado Boulder before going to law school at Michigan State University. His father suggested law for the thoughtful young Aaron when he was still a little boy. “He really planted that seed in my head at a young age,” Kennedy said.

Studying the law challenged Aaron in all the right ways and he fell in love with it. “When I got out of law school, I really didn’t know what kind of law I wanted to practice,” he said. He found his way into protecting employees in Workers’ Compensation cases. “I found the work really rewarding,” he said. “And I’ve stuck with it.”

He likes to build relationships with each one of his clients. “Each case and each client is different,” Aaron said. “I like to get a feel for the person and the case so I can determine the best approach.”

Aaron chose the McDivitt Law Firm because of its size and resources. “We’re probably one of the largest, if not the largest, firms in Southern Colorado.” He said that makes McDivitt Law Firm a recognizable and formidable force against insurance companies.

attorneys.name: Mary Susan L. Kern
attorneys.firm_name: McDermott Law, LLC: Disability & ERISA Lawyers
attorneys.practice_type: Insurance Denials/ Bad Faith Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
MarySue has extensive experience in handling ERISA, PERA, and private disability insurance claims including internal insurance appeals and litigation. She is adept at answering client questions and explaining the procedures of these claims to alleviate client concerns about the appeals and litigation processes. MarySue strives to keep clients well-informed and up-to-date with all pertinent claim issues. She has helped implement firm-wide practices to ensure all client matters are managed in an organized and effective way to ensure clients achieve relief as efficiently as possible.

MarySue graduated from the University of Colorado at Boulder in 2003 with a Bachelor of Arts in political science. After joining McDermott Law, LLC: Disability & ERISA Lawyers, MarySue began her post-graduate education at the University of Denver Sturm College of Law. She achieved a Master of Science in Legal Administration in 2011 and a Juris Doctor with a Certificate in Constitutional Law in 2017. She ranked third in her law school graduating class.

MarySue is admitted to practice law in the State of Colorado and in her home State of Iowa. She is a member of the American Bar Association, Colorado Bar Association, Iowa Bar Association, Colorado Trial Lawyers Association, the Iowa Association for Justice, Colorado Women's Bar Association, and Iowa Organization of Women Attorneys, among others.

MarySue has shared her experience with other attorneys and disabled individuals through public speaking engagements. In 2018, she presented to the Inn of Courts and described the complex policy issues of handling disability insurance claims for individuals with mental health disorders. In 2019, she was a Survivor Series/Navigating the Benefits System panelist for the Brain Injury Hope Foundation. She provided information to the survivors concerning ERISA and PERA disability insurance claims.

Outside of the practice of law, MarySue can likely be found outdoors with her horses, dogs, family, and friends. She devotes as much time as possible to caring for her beloved Friesian Sporthorses. She enjoys trail riding, showing, and riding her horses in parades with her sister and nieces. MarySue also enjoys hiking with her Basset Hound and playing fetch with her English Cream Golden Retriever. She spends many weather-permitting nights relaxing around a campfire with her family and friends.

attorneys.name: Shazam Kianpour
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
Hiring a fearless and confident criminal defense attorney who has handled thousands of criminal and traffic cases creates an advantage for clients who have been charged with or are being investigated for a crime. Mr. Shazam Kianpour has tried a large variety of Traffic, Misdemeanor and Felony cases, including Burglary, Homicide, Felony Assault, Sex Assault, Child Sex Assault, Domestic Violence, Robbery, Menacing, Harassment, Violation of Restraining Orders, Driving Under Restraint, Habitual Traffic Offender, Careless Resulting in Death, and DUI's. The quality of work and experience that is brought to the table by a criminal defense attorney who has previously served as a Government State Defender can only be measured by the peace of mind that comes with knowing you have a fearless fighter in your corner.

Mr. Kianpour first began studying people in college where he received a degree in Cultural Anthropology with an emphasis in Human Genetics and Evolutionary Biology. After years spent as a leader in the public sector in management positions, Mr. Kianpour went on to find his calling in Law School where he graduated with honors and was top of his class in Criminal Law among over 100 other law students. With a keen understanding of criminal law, as well as superb negotiating and trial skills, Mr. Kianpour has assisted thousands of Colorado criminal defense clients in successfully resolving their criminal problems with law enforcement and many different District Attorneys all across Colorado and the Denver Front Range. When opening his own law firm, Mr. Kianpour wanted a cohesive team of professional competent attorneys who all worked well together, and also all specialized in different fields of criminal and traffic law in order to make the perfect and complete criminal defense team. This vision was realized when our outstanding team of attorneys came together to form Shazam Kianpour & Associates, P.C. Denver's premier criminal and traffic defense law firm.

In addition to the focused training that he received as a criminal defense lawyer while working for the government and also in private practice, Mr. Kianpour has also developed an extensive network of relationships in the Colorado Criminal Justice System. This network is a great asset for any client who needs a strong, confident, and tenacious criminal defense lawyer. Shazam Kianpour is a member of the Colorado Bar Association, the Denver Bar Association, the American Association for Justice, and the Colorado Criminal Defense Bar.

Whether you are facing criminal charges, are being investigated by the police, need representation for a probation violation, or just want your records sealed, call Shazam Kianpour & Associates when you need a fearless fighter in your corner.

attorneys.name: Kerri L. Klein
attorneys.practice_type: Estate Administration Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
Kerri L. Klein is a founding partner of POSKUS & KLEIN, P.C. Ms. Klein values close working relationships with her clients so that she can ensure their estate plans meet their unique personal and financial needs. Ms. Klein feels privileged to have worked with a diverse clientele and welcomes individuals from all walks of life.

Specifically, Ms. Klein assists individuals in the areas of estate planning, gifting, guardianships, conservatorships, health care advance directives, powers of attorney, probate, taxes, trusts and wills, and estate administration.

Ms. Klein is admitted to practice law in the State of Colorado and is a member of the Trust and Estate Section of the Colorado Bar Association, where she has served as the chair and co-chair of the Statutory Revisions Committee, chair of the Rules and Forms Committee and member of the Executive Council. She is also a member of the Denver Bar Association and the Real Property, Probate and Trust Section of the American Bar Association.

Ms. Klein’s experience and professionalism has been repeatedly noted by her peers and the community. In 2015, she was elected a Fellow of The American College of Trust and Estate Counsel. In 2019, she was recognized as one of the top 50 women attorneys in Colorado by the Denver Post. Additionally, Ms. Klein was selected as a Superlawyer’s Rising Star for the years 2009-2015 and Superlawyer for the years 2016-2024, and as one of the Best Lawyers of America for 2016-2024.

Ms. Klein is a member of the Children's Hospital Colorado Foundation Legacy Planning Advisory Council. She also welcomes the opportunity to educate the public through speaking. She has voluntarily spoken to many organizations in the past, including the Alzheimer’s Association of Colorado and Firefly Autism.

attorneys.bio:
Mr. Knight's practice focuses on civil litigation, transportation law, property matters and construction law. Chad represents national transportation companies in the railroad and trucking industries in Federal Employers´ Liability Act (FELA) cases, grade crossing accidents (initial response, investigation and litigation), highway traffic accident investigation and defense, contract litigation, property disputes, and quiet title actions. Chad applies his extensive construction and real estate experience in representing contractors and developers in construction defect litigation, premises liability defense, and contract negotiation and drafting.

Chad's trial experience has produced a successful record of defense verdicts in state and federal courts, and includes difficult wrongful-death jury trials. His appellate experience includes oral arguments before the United States Court of Appeals and five reported decisions.

Before joining Knight Nicastro MacKay, LLC, Chad was a partner in a 50-attorney firm based in Jackson, Mississippi, focusing on transportation law and products liability defense. Chad then operated a private practice representing individuals and business entities in real estate and financing transactions, litigation matters, and regulatory compliance.

attorneys.name: Kate Knowles
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Westminster, CO
attorneys.bio:
Attorney Kate Knowles brings more than a decade of courtroom experience to the firm’s Family Law practice. She is committed to helping her clients find a positive path forward from the complex legal matters affecting their family dynamics.

As a former senior deputy district attorney in Denver and Golden, Kate handled high-stakes criminal matters involving domestic violence, child abuse, and protection orders. She also spent time in the D.A.’s Family Violence Unit. During her tenure as a prosecutor, Kate brought more than 100 jury trials, including murder, to verdicts. Now she leverages that experience to help her clients facing high-conflict family law matters.

Kate approaches her clients’ needs with compassion and the understanding that their experience is likely to be one of the most difficult moments of their lives.

Representative matters:

Obtained Restitution Award for Domestic Violence Victim – Won court-ordered compensation for domestic violence and stalking victim, recouping expenses from the crime and its impacts.

Successfully Prosecuted Sexual Predator After Evasion Attempt – Successfully extradited and prosecuted a sexual predator who fled to South America after being charged

Convicted Domestic Violence Perpetrator to Protect Family – Successfully convicted a habitual domestic violence perpetrator, ensuring the safety of his victims and children until adulthood

attorneys.name: David Koppa
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Colorado Springs, CO
attorneys.bio:
David is a counselor and advocate. He focuses on communication in representing clients. He explains the procedure, so the client understands what needs to be done. He listens to the client but, he always has an eye towards developing the evidence that may be needed in an adversarial setting.

David has over 20 years of experience in family law. In addition to handling many custody cases, he has represented clients in the broad, complex reaches of family law, including military divorce, high asset cases, restraining orders, post-decree, pre-nuptial agreements, guardianships and many other issues. He is experienced in working with the experts that are often needed in family law, including parenting professionals, and financial and valuation experts. David puts much effort and preparation into negotiating a mediated solution to family law conflicts that is consistent with the client’s goals. However, when mediation fails, David is ready to prepare the client and tenaciously advocate for the client in the courtroom. When David is not advocating clients, he is often ballroom dancing with his wife. He enjoys the outdoors, often with his dogs. He has also been a volunteer legal counselor with the El Paso County Bar Association and a volunteer board member with local non-profits.

attorneys.name: Joel R. Kotler
attorneys.practice_type: Workers' Compensation Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
Joel R. Kotler is originally from Philadelphia. He received his Bachelor of Arts in business and real estate from Temple University. From there, he went on to law school at Western Michigan University Cooley Law School.

While working for a real estate management firm, Joel would attend court with the company’s lawyers for real estate issues. “I actually thought I could do a better job arguing on our behalf than they could, and that’s what led me to apply for law school,” Joel said.

After receiving his law degree, Joel began practicing workers’ compensation law on the plaintiff side. Then, a defense firm made him an offer. After spending a decade working on the defense side of workers’ compensation in Pennsylvania and New Jersey, Joel went back to his roots of representing injured workers. “Now that I know both sides, I can better help our clients here at McDivitt Law Firm,” Joel said.

Keeping clients informed throughout their claims is Joel’s top priority. “I want to bring my clients a sense of peace and explain to them what the process looks like in Colorado,” Joel said.

Joel was drawn to McDivitt Law Firm because of its unique approach to the client experience. “I believe that McDivitt Law Firm is set up to achieve our client’s goals with our team approach and open communication.” he said.

Joel Kotler has been selected as a Top 100 Civil Plaintiff Trial Lawyer in Colorado by The National Trial Lawyers.

Honors

attorneys.bio:
“Each of us is more than the worst thing we’ve ever done.” – Bryan Stevenson

Casey Krizman founded this firm to attract defense attorneys who are as committed as he is to the just and fair treatment of the criminally accused. He has developed a style of criminal defense that is caring, thorough, smart, and above all RELENTLESS in achieving the best results for our clients.

As a former public defender, Mr. Krizman brings insider knowledge about the criminal justice system. Having made his own mistakes, he brings compassion to each client’s situation. He fights for your rights from the first meeting until your case is finished. He combs through the evidence, attacks the prosecution’s case, and sees to the details before, during, and after the courtroom.

A Colorado native, Mr. Krizman graduated from the University of Denver Sturm College of Law, where he was a member of the school’s prestigious National Trial Team. He received his bachelor’s degree in Government and World Affairs from the University of Tampa.

When not in the office, Mr. Krizman competes as an Ironman triathlete. He has coached trial advocacy at the high school, undergraduate, and law school levels. He is married and the father of one son, Atticus.

Prior to being admitted to the Colorado Bar, Mr. Krizman clerked for renowned defense attorneys Michael S. Axt and Randy C. Canney.

attorneys.name: Beth L Krulewitch
attorneys.practice_type: Divorce Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
Building a compelling legal argument - one that is persuasive to juries and appellate courts alike - requires expert legal research, writing and presentation skills.

In practice since 1987, I have represented both civil and criminal clients at trial and on appeal for more than 20 years. I provide services as strategic co-counsel at trial and in state or federal appeals for your clients. I am passionate about my work and confident in my ability to deliver the quality services that can free you to focus on your strengths and give you a tactical advantage.

Whether you are seeking assistance for an appeal or a time constraint is preventing you from giving every part of a trial the attention it deserves, contact me to arrange a free consultation. With offices in Denver and Aspen, I can represent clients and co-counsel with attorneys throughout Colorado.

As a litigator, I have handled a substantial array of legal cases, from complex commercial litigation to plaintiffs' personal injury, products liability, domestic relations, and criminal defense. As an appellate lawyer, I have represented clients at every level, obtaining results in reported cases before the Colorado Court of Appeals, the Colorado Supreme Court, and the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 10th Circuit.

I provide expert legal research and writing skills for motions, proposed orders, discovery requests, appeals and writs. As strategic co-counsel, I can help you predict and respond to the significant legal issues that can make or break your case.

I believe what sets me apart is the combination of trial and appellate experience. At trial, I not only understand what it takes to build a persuasive case, but I think like an appellate lawyer, helping you create and perfect the record you need should your case end up on appeal. On appeal, I use my trial lawyer skills to tell your clients story, with arguments that are compelling, persuasive and backed up by legal analysis that is thoroughly researched and analytically sound.

Awards and Honors

Honors

Champion of Justice Award, National Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers, 2000

attorneys.name: DezaRae D. LaCrue
attorneys.firm_name: Frank Azar Car & Truck Accident Lawyers - Aurora, Colorado
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Aurora, CO
attorneys.bio:
"I do this work as an attorney because I love to help people"

DezaRae D. LaCrue grew up in Trinidad, Colorado where she was the valedictorian of her high school class and excelled in sports. Following high school, she received a full academic scholarship to attend the University of Denver from which she graduated with a B.A. in political science in 2004. Mrs. LaCrue also attended the University of Colorado at Denver and earned an MBA. She completed her education at the University of Denver Sturm College of Law, where she earned her law degree in 2008.

During law school, Mrs. LaCrue worked full time as a paralegal at a medical malpractice firm while attending law school at night. She was hired by that firm as an associate after passing the Colorado Bar in 2008. For seven year, she practiced as a medical malpractice attorney before joining Franklin D. Azar & Associates, P.C. in 2015. She litigated and tried complicated multi-million dollar malpractice cases throughout the state of Colorado.

Mrs. LaCrue is admitted to practice in State and Federal courts in Colorado. She is on the Board of Directors for the Colorado Trial Lawyers Association and a member of the American Association for Justice. She was selected as a Rising Star by Super Lawyers for 2017, 2018 and 2019. She was also designated Top 10 under 40 by the National Academy of Personal Injury Litigation in 2017. Her practice focuses on personal injury and insurance bad faith litigation.

DezaRae enjoys spending time with her husband, Daniel, whom she met in high school. They currently live in Aurora, Colorado with their pets.

attorneys.name: Steven Lambert
attorneys.firm_name: The Law Firm of Springer & Steinberg
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
At Springer & Steinberg in Denver, Colorado, Attorney Steven Lambert is a distinguished member of the Law Team, leveraging his legal prowess and passion for navigating the intricate landscape of the nation’s governmental, bureaucratic, and judicial institutions. His journey into law school was propelled by a desire to comprehend and master the complexities of these systems.

With a multifaceted legal background encompassing civil litigation, criminal law, government relations, corporate, and commercial law, Steven discovered his true calling in family law—a domain he finds inherently connected to real-life human experiences. As a seasoned attorney, he has adeptly handled a spectrum of family law cases, from high-asset to low-asset, high-conflict to amicable, bringing a wealth of expertise to each case.

In his legal practice, Steven adopts a comprehensive approach, meticulously immersing himself in the facts of each case to become the most informed professional, aside from the involved parties. Simultaneously, he remains at the forefront of legal developments, ensuring a thorough understanding of applicable laws, even in nuanced or rarely litigated areas.

Steven’s proactive stance extends to educating the court on unique factual elements in cases involving novel legal aspects. His commitment to being well-versed and informed equips him to strategically navigate courtrooms and settlement conferences, aiming for optimal outcomes for his clients and their families.

On a personal level, Steven prioritizes accessibility, recognizing the profound stress clients often face during challenging times. He remains readily available, ensuring all case information is at his fingertips, and endeavors to provide unwavering support and guidance throughout the legal process. As a dedicated lawyer, Steven Lambert combines legal expertise with a human touch to advocate effectively for his clients in the realm of family law.

attorneys.name: Heather M. Landauer
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
Heather Landauer is a Partner at GEM Family Law. Heather is an experienced attorney, having practiced almost exclusively in family law since her admission to the Colorado State Bar in 2013.

Heather is creative and insightful, assisting her clients to identify their goals such that she begins working with them on a strategy to achieve their desired outcome at the outset of her representation of them. Heather encourages her clients to keep the "big picture" in mind, and to reduce the impact of emotions during their family law proceedings, in order to help them maintain focus and direction. She is compassionate, as she understands family law matters can be fraught with anger, frustration, and fear. Heather is patient with her clients while directing them to take action that will help them make the best decisions for their case and achieve their best results.

Heather is an experienced litigator who has tried hundreds of cases and is skilled in bringing matters before the Judge. However, she also recognizes the benefits of settlement, which is, quite often, the better option. The facts of each case, as well as the client's goals, will determine which route to take. Heather provides her family law clients with strategic advice every step of the way.

Heather is also a Child and Family Investigator. Her extensive experience with families in Colorado, as well as her specialized training as a CFI, enables her to provide thorough, creative, and child-focused advice to her clients. Additionally, her experience as a litigator gives her a unique perspective when she serves as a child expert and neutral in family law matters.

Heather's skills have been recognized by Avvo, where Heather has received a 10/10 rating based on her experience, involvement in the family law community, and peer reviews. Heather has authored numerous publications, to include publications on lawyer ethics. Heather supports the community through pro bono services with Metro Volunteer Lawyer's Family Law Unbundled Program, providing legal advice with LawLine 9, and promotes animal adoption through her foster work with 4 Paws 4 Life.

Heather received her Juris Doctor from the University of Denver Sturm College of Law and, during law school, was a judicial intern for the Honorable Judge Jack Berryhill in the 1st Judicial District. Heather additionally demonstrated her commitment to children's issues as a certified student attorney through the University of Denver Child Advocacy Practicum and the Rocky Mountain Children's Law Center. Also during law school, Heather interned with Metro Volunteer Lawyers, assisting clients in the Family Law Court Program, where she first developed her commitment to family law.

In addition to representing clients in Domestic Relations matters, Heather is also a trained Parenting Coordinator/Decision-Maker.

attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
Alexandra (Alex) Lanzetta is an Associate Attorney at GEM Family Law, practicing in all areas of family law. Alex began her legal career as a Law Clerk at GEM, honing her skills in parenting and property disputes early on. She is dedicated to helping clients navigate the challenges of family law with clarity, empathy, and thoughtful advocacy.

Alex earned her Juris Doctor from the University of Denver Sturm College of Law, where she received a Certificate in Civil Rights and Remedies. Alex represented clients in civil protection order matters through the Civil Litigation Clinic, and understands the dynamics of domestic violence and abuse in family law matters.

Originally from Connecticut, Alex moved to Colorado to attend the University of Colorado Boulder, where she graduated summa cum laude with a double major in History and Psychology and a minor in Business. Alex was admitted to Phi Beta Kappa, the oldest and most prestigious academic honors society. This educational background is particularly well-suited to complex family law matters, that involve mental health complexities, closely held businesses, accounting issues, and the like.

Prior to attending law school, Alex was a paralegal in general practice firm, where she discovered her passion for family law, inspired by the opportunity to combine analytical problem-solving with meaningful client relationships.

attorneys.name: Banafsheh Lari
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
Banafsheh Lari is an associate attorney with Ciancio Ciancio Brown, P.C. and a member of the Family Law Team. Banafsheh earned her Bachelor of Arts in Political Science and International Affairs with an emphasis on the Middle East from the University of Colorado at Boulder in 2012. She earned her Juris Doctor from the University of Denver Sturm College of Law in 2015.

Banafsheh began her legal career as a law clerk in Adams County District Court primarily for the Honorable Jaclyn Brown. She served on the domestic and civil dockets drafting hundreds of orders in a wide variety of cases including dissolutions of marriage, allocation of parental responsibilities, and post-decree modifications.

While attending law school, Banafsheh was the recipient of the Dean’s Scholarship. She was a member of Moot Court Board, served as chair of the Dean’s Excellence Committee, and was elected representative to the Student Bar Association by her peers. During law school, Banafsheh was an intern for the Honorable Christopher Cross in Arapahoe County District Court and interned at a prominent private family law firm in Denver. She also served as a fellow with the Honorable David Goldberg in Denver County District Court where she focused solely on family law matters. During her internship in Arapahoe County and fellowship in Denver County, Banafsheh quickly realized she had a passion for family law issues and helping families through the most difficult times they may face.

For the past five years, Banafsheh has volunteered her time coaching students competing in the statewide Colorado Bar Association High School Mock Trial program. While she was born and raised in Colorado, Banafsheh is an avid world traveler. Most recently, she traveled throughout Iceland and cannot wait to plan her next trip. Banafsheh is fluent in Farsi.

attorneys.name: Austin Leighty
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Highlands Ranch, CO
attorneys.bio:
Austin Leighty is a seasoned litigator, bringing over a decade of high-stakes prosecutorial experience to Robinson & Henry’s Family Law Team. Austin specializes in complex criminal cases involving domestic disputes, effectively fighting for just outcomes for his clients.

Austin has built a career on tireless advocacy for victims while ensuring fair case dispositions that respect the rights of criminal defendants. As lead trial attorney in the Denver District Attorney’s Office, he prosecuted more than 60 jury trials, covering serious offenses such as murder and attempted murder, sexual assault, vehicular homicide, and kidnapping.

During his tenure at the Denver District Attorney’s Office, Austin oversaw and managed the city’s innovative Sobriety Court and the county’s RESTART Court—programs dedicated to reducing recidivism among repeat DUI offenders. In 2023, Austin was awarded the Mothers Against Drunk Driving (MADD) Outstanding Prosecutor of the Year award for Colorado.

Committed to ethical and constitutional practice, Austin meticulously scrutinizes search and arrest warrants to ensure that law enforcement adheres to the law. He also consistently collaborates with opposing counsel to achieve appropriate case resolutions.

Representative matters:

Family Protection - Successfully prosecuted a habitual domestic violence offender and obtained sole custody for the parent, and ensured victim safety by entering the family into witness protection.

Vehicular Plea - Successfully negotiated a resolution in a high-profile vehicular homicide case, ensuring the final plea disposition addressed the victims’ needs.

Arson Conviction - Secured a successful verdict in a high-profile arson case involving a near-fatal explosion by navigating extensive motions and litigating a weeks-long trial.

Awards and Honors

Honors

2023 Mothers Against Drunk Driving (MADD) Outstanding Prosecutor of the Year, 2023 - Present

attorneys.name: Kent Leier
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Fort Collins, CO
attorneys.bio:
Kent J. Leier founded The Leier Law Office with the goal of providing experienced and compassionate legal representation. He prides himself on his trial experience and courtroom presence and he is ready and willing to go to trial when justice demands it.

Mr. Leier began his legal career as an attorney for Colorado Legal Services. During his tenure with Colorado Legal Services, he represented citizens throughout all of Northern Colorado in divorce cases, highly contentious child custody disputes, and all other areas pertaining solely to family law.

After working for Colorado Legal Services, Mr. Leier served as a prosecutor for the Weld County District Attorney’s Office. As a County Court prosecutor, he successfully handled thousands of DUI cases, Driving Under Revocation cases, assaults, domestic violence cases, and traffic violations. As a District Court prosecutor, he handled thousands of drug cases; ranging from simple possession to distribution. Mr. Leier has also had the honor of serving as a member on the Weld County Drug Court treatment team. Over the course of his career, he has handled every type of criminal case from speeding to 1st Degree Murder. He believes his experience as a prosecutor gives his clients an edge because he can communicate effectively with the prosecution to get the best possible outcome for his clients.

Mr. Leier believes that the outcome of your case is a direct result of how hard your attorney is working for you, that is why he proudly offers 24 hour a day assistance to his clients. He understands that his clients don't just have questions between the hours of 8 and 5 and that law enforcement officers work around the clock. He believes that if law enforcement officers are working 24 hours a day to build a case against you then your lawyer should be working just as hard to protect your freedom.

Awards and Honors

Honors

American Society of Legal Advocates One of Colorado's Top 40 Criminal Defense Attorneys Under the Age of 40

Recipient of Martindale Hubbell AV Preeminent Rating. – Awarded to less than 5% of attorneys in the country.

attorneys.name: Daniel J. Levin
attorneys.practice_type: Businesses and Handling Partnership Disputes Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
Dan has been practicing law since 1986. He began his career with the District Attorney’s Office followed by a term with the Enforcement Division of the Securities and Exchange Commission. Later, he became in-house counsel for an OTC securities registered Broker / Dealer. Prior to the formation of Levin Jacobson Japha, P.C. he was in private practice for several years and then became a shareholder of Levin & Weiser, LLC. Dan has extensive experience in and focuses his practice on counseling businesses and handling partnership disputes; corporate law; private placement financing; regulatory compliance; business succession matters; mergers, acquisitions; employment issues; corporate and regulatory compliance; health care provider law; wills, estate and probate administration matters; divorce, custody family law and domestic partnership issues; personal injury accidents; and administrative law matters.

He holds a B.A. from the University of Colorado and a J.D. from the University of Denver College of Law. Dan is a member of the Trust and Estate, Family Law and Business Law sections of the Denver, Colorado, and American Bar Associations, has been admitted to the U.S. District Court, U.S. Court of Appeals, and the United States Supreme Court. He has written numerous articles on business law matters and has served on the boards of several non-profit organizations, and represents a wide range of companies, commercial enterprises, medical providers, business owners and individual clients.

Accomplishments over his 30 year career include obtaining a multimillion dollar jury verdict against a major telecommunications company; obtaining a million dollar business saving verdict on behalf of a family-owned metal fabricating company; achieving a six-figure settlement in a restaurant personal injury case involving dangerously hot coffee spilling on a customer; negotiating numerous multimillion dollar private placement financings, mergers and acquisitions; negotiating and litigating numerous company partnership disputes and settlements, and negotiating purchase, product and supply contracts on behalf of many prodigious businesses.

Million Dollar Business Saving Verdict on Behalf of a Family-Owned Metal Fabricating Company

attorneys.name: Jordan S. Levine
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury - Plantiff Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
Jordan S. Levine is the founder of Levine Law, a Denver accident law firm

Mr. Levine has devoted his career to representing the rights of injured victims and has more than 20 years of experience representing clients in personal injury and workers’ compensation cases. Jordan Levine has obtained multi-million dollar settlements and verdicts on behalf of clients. In his years of vigorous legal practice, he has handled hundreds of injury cases throughout the Denver area, including motor vehicle accidents, nursing home claims, work injury, product liability, premises liability and claims against individuals, businesses, and insurance companies.

In Crowel v. ICAO, Jordan Levine made history, shaping the law that penalizes insurance companies for improperly handling injury claims

He has been invited to speak on legal ethics at the Denver Bar Association’s annual meeting, and he has served as a board member for the Workers’ Compensation Education Association and the Board of the American Association for Justice. Mr. Levine also shares his extensive legal knowledge with his peers at continuing legal education seminars.

Mr. Levine’s commitment to public service and legal education is unparalleled, but it is his reputation as a strong, skilled, and dedicated advocate for his clients that has helped him earn his reputation as a top litigator

Mr. Levine has been recognized by his peers and clients as a consummate legal professional and was selected as a 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015 and 2016 Super Lawyer. He also has the highest AV rating from Martindale-Hubbell from 2011 through 2016 and has been named among the Top 100 Trial Lawyers from 2007 through 2016 by the American Trial Lawyers Association.

Mr. Levine is licensed to practice law in Florida and Colorado

He is a current member of the Colorado Trial Lawyers Association, the Denver Bar Association, the Colorado Bar Association and the Workers’ Compensation Education Association. He focuses his career on representing plaintiffs in injury cases and has a track record of settling cases for millions and winning large jury verdicts.

attorneys.name: Antonio Linares
attorneys.firm_name: Frank Azar Car & Truck Accident Lawyers - Aurora, Colorado
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Aurora, CO
attorneys.bio:
Antonio Jose Linares de la Fuente is an attorney dedicated to pursuing justice for those who are most in need of the legal system's assistance. Mr. Linares started his career of helping those in need through the legal system after he graduated from the University of Miami in 2017, when he began to work as a Guardian ad Litem in Florida. As a Guardian ad Litem, Mr. Linares was responsible for monitoring the safety of children in Florida's child dependency system. Mr. Linares actively steered children to achieve their permanent placement goals and move on with their lives, as well as advocate for their interests in court.

After serving as a Guardian ad Litem, Mr. Linares attended Harvard Law School where he continued his service to those most in need. For a time, he acted as the Vice President of the Child and Youth Advocates student group, promoting awareness of children's status and interests in the law. Mr. Linares also spent some time working at the Suffolk County District Attorney's Office on the Human Trafficking and Child Protection Unit, where he investigated and litigated on behalf of victims of human trafficking and children who had been abused.

Mr. Linares started his career in personal injury in his second year of law school, working for a mid-sized personal injury firm in Boston. Mr. Linares is currently admitted to practice law in Colorado in state and federal court. attorneys.name: Cajardo Lindsey Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Greenwood Village, CO
attorneys.bio:
Cajardo Lindsey is a passionate advocate for justice who truly believes in the power of giving a voice to his clients. With a wealth of courtroom experience, having participated in over 75 trials to verdict, Cajardo brings a seasoned understanding of the legal system to every case. His background as a retired District Court judge from Colorado’s 18th Judicial District has given him unique insights that enhance his perspective and practice as a litigator. Cajardo Lindsey’s dedication to excellence shines through in everything he does, making him a trusted ally for those he represents.

Cajardo’s journey in the legal field began with a focus on insurance defense. However, it took only a short time for him to find resonating service as a prosecutor at the Denver District Attorney’s Office. Over the course of eight impactful years, he worked his way up to becoming a senior deputy district attorney, where he fought for justice in a wide range of cases, from first-degree murder to assaults and DUIs.

In recognition of his dedication and expertise, Cajardo was honored to be cross-deputized as a Special U.S. Attorney for the Front Range Drug Task Force. In this role, he collaborated closely with agents from the Drug Enforcement Administration and multiple Colorado law enforcement agencies, all united in the mission to tackle organized drug-related crimes in the community. His commitment to justice and public safety has made a lasting impact on the lives of many.

Cajardo’s experience as a prosecutor broadened when he served as an Assistant City Attorney for the City of Denver. Throughout his tenure, he earned the respect of his colleagues, the courts, and even opposing counsel for his masterful oratory skills, deft negotiation, and, most notably, his unwavering integrity.

Cajardo shifted his justice and public safety mission from criminal prosecution to a civil personal injury practice where he and his partner routinely won six and seven-figure excess verdicts.

Before reentering the private sector, Governor Polis appointed Cajardo Lindsey to the bench, where Cajardo presided over civil matters, including domestic relations, protection orders, and contempt of court.

Cajardo graduated from Miami University in Oxford, Ohio, with a Bachelor of Arts in Public Administration before earning his Doctor of Jurisprudence degree from The Indiana University Maurer School of Law in Bloomington, Indiana. While attending law school, Cajardo was selected to clerk for the British Inns of Court in London, England, and later as a law clerk for the National Football League Management Council in New York City.

Above all, Cajardo Lindsey is committed to providing a voice for what he believes is right. Therefore, he fervently works on behalf of his clients to ensure their stories are heard and justice is served.

attorneys.name: Samuel G. Livingston
attorneys.firm_name: The Law Office of Samuel G. Livingston, P.C.
attorneys.practice_type: Bad Faith Insurance Lawyers in Golden, CO
attorneys.bio:
Samuel G. Livingston, P.C. has obtained multiple record bad faith jury verdicts in the State of Colorado starting in 2000.

In Roach v. American Family Insurance Company a Denver District Court jury awarded $2 million against American Family Insurance for denying an $800 property claim under circumstances where American Family altered underwriting records and undertook its denial knowing that its actions were contrary to Insurance Commission regulations after hiding a memorandum showing knowledge of those circumstances throughout most of the case. In 2007, Samuel G. Livingston, P.C. obtained a second record Colorado verdict, again involving bad faith by American Family Insurance, in the matter of Peressini v. American Family Mutual Insurance Co wherein the insurer denied a claim of approximately $125,000 resulting in a $3 million verdict. The evidence involved a Colorado State Business Plan wherein company employees were instructed to reduce claims payouts to stay in line with other insurance companies, and ignore the needs of the insureds. The case was highly publicized by Channel 7 News, and nationally, surrounding evidence that American Family employees only paid claims "when pigs fly." Samuel G. Livingston, P.C. has obtained numerous multimillion dollar settlements, both confidential and of public record, including a $2 million settlement in the matter of (Meat Market) v. American Family, a $2 million settlement in the matter of (A Carbondale Family) v. American Family, and a $3.75 million settlement in the matter of Kay Watts v. State Farm.

Mr. Livingston has presented multiple lectures on behalf of the Colorado Trial Lawyers Association and the National Business Institute surrounding bad faith and particularly discovery in bad faith matters. Mr. Livingston has testified on multiple occasions before the Colorado Legislature surrounding insurance matters and has worked extensively with the Colorado Division of Insurance to promulgate regulatory reform to curb insurance abuses. Samuel G. Livingston, P.C. has successfully handled all types of insurance cases including coverage determinations, auto and homeowners claims, HOA claims and title insurance claims in both first and third-party litigation, and has obtained certification of a 17,500-member class action against American Family Insurance Company regarding coverage issues.

Attorney Samuel G. Livingston graduated from Heritage High School in Littleton, Colorado in 1978, the University of Northern Colorado in 1982, and Drake University Law School in 1985 where he received the American Jurisprudence Award in Evidence. His initial experience involved working in private practice for insurance companies defending bad faith insurance and personal injury claims and ultimately started his own practice in 1990. Starting in 1996, Mr. Livingston has worked exclusively for consumers against insurance carriers presenting cases involving bad faith breach of insurance contract and personal injury claims.

attorneys.name: Kim Lord
attorneys.practice_type: Real Estate Lawyers in Boulder, CO
attorneys.bio:
Kim Lord's practice focuses on real estate transactions, including purchase and sale, leasing, construction, formation of common interest communities and the land use approval process. Kim also represents clients in general business matters, including entity formation, contract preparation, acquisitions and sales and employment issues. Kim has practiced law in Colorado since 1989 and over the years has represented numerous developers, contractors, architects, landlords, tenants, homeowner associations, brokers, property owners and business owners.

Kim moved to Boulder in 1981 to attend undergraduate school at the University of Colorado and has never left. She obtained her undergraduate degree from CU in 1985 and then graduated with honors from the University of Colorado School of Law in 1989. Following law school, Kim practiced with the national law firm of Morrison & Foerster for five years and then for six years with the Denver law firm of Silver & DeBoskey. Prior to joining PackardDierking, Kim was a partner with the Boulder law firm of Johnson & Repucci with an emphasis in business litigation and real estate and business transactions. Kim is an adjunct lecturer at the CU Leeds School of Business where she teaches Real Estate Law.

Kim is recognized by Best Lawyers in America in Land Use, Colorado SuperLawyer in Business Litigation and as the Individual of the Year by the Colorado Lawyer's Committee for pro bono work. Kim currently serves on the Board of Directors of Colorado Legal Services and is a Commissioner with Boulder Housing Partners. Kim is a past president of the Colorado Lawyers Trust Account Foundation (COLTAF) and served for several years on the Colorado Women's Bar Association Board. She is also a past Chair of the Boulder Bar Association Real Estate Committee.

Kim lives in Boulder with her husband, daughter and dog. Kim loves running with her dog and skiing, hiking and biking with her family and friends. Kim also teaches and practices both Pilates and Yoga

attorneys.name: Joseph P. LoRusso
attorneys.practice_type: Aviation Law Lawyers in Northglenn, CO
attorneys.bio:
Joseph P. LoRusso holds the position of Director of Aviation at Ramos Law, which has offices in Arizona and Colorado Springs, Denver and Grand Junction, in Colorado. Joining Ramos Law in 2021, he brings to the table a remarkable career that spans over two decades.

The passion Mr. LoRusso holds for aviation and, thereby, the protection of its people’s rights define him as a resolute advocate for his clients. He has experience representing professionals in actions before the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) or the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB); and injured parties or their families in matters of aircraft crashes. Other areas of his concentration include pilot certificate defense, appeals, administrative actions and more.

Graduating from the U.S. Air Force Academy in 2006, Mr. LoRusso enrolled at the Metropolitan State University of Denver, where he completed a bachelor’s degree in business management in 2009. His journey into the legal profession took flight after a significant tenure of five years as a professional flight instructor, during which he recognized a pressing need for dedicated and passionate legal representation for pilots.

With an ignited desire to serve the aviation community, Mr. LoRusso joined the Washburn University School of Law and obtained his Juris Doctor with a concentration on aviation law and complex civil plaintiff litigation. There, he engaged fervently in the activities of the ABA Forum on Air & Space Law and was the co-founder of the Committee on Air and Space Law.

As an individual who has been working in the aviation industry almost all his life, Mr. LoRusso considers it a profound honor to advocate for its members, combining his in-depth knowledge of the field with his acquired cognizance of law. Beyond his legal practice, he remains an active contract pilot, adding a practical dimension to his legal work.

attorneys.name: Daniel J. Lowenberg
attorneys.practice_type: Bankruptcy Lawyers in Avon, CO
attorneys.bio:
Daniel J. Lowenberg is an attorney admitted to practice in both Colorado and Texas. Born in Dallas, Texas, Daniel received his B.A. in English from Lake Forest College in Lake Forest, Illinois, in 1991 and his Juris Doctor from St. Mary's University in San Antonio, Texas, in 2005, where he served on the Law Journal. After two years of general civil practice, Daniel opened his own firm specializing in bankruptcy law and litigation and debtor and creditor rights for over three years. Daniel represents both debtors and creditors in Chapter 7 liquidations and Chapter 11, Chapter 12, and Chapter 13 reorganizations, and in prebankruptcy creditor rights proceedings, including: Cram-down litigation; relief from stay proceedings; automatic stay litigation; involuntary petitions; adversary litigation in bankruptcy court; and bankruptcy appeals. Additional practice areas include agricultural law, conservatorships and guardianships, consumer rights, and civil litigation.

Prior to the practice of law, Daniel's work included a stint as a high school teacher and coach and six years as an Exhibitor Services Representative for Freeman Decorating Company, one of the largest trade show contractors in the country.

Daniel enjoys Crossfit (the principal strength and conditioning program for police academies, military units, and first responders), climbing, downhill skiing, and hiking with his growing family and two dogs Barnum and Bailey.

Member: National Association of Consumer Bankruptcy Attorneys; Texas Bar Association (inactive); Colorado Bar Association; 7th Judicial District Bar Association; District of Colorado; U.S. Court of Appeals, 10th Circuit.

Publications:

The Texas Cave Bug and the California Arroyo Toad Take on the Constitution's Commerce Clause, 36 St. Mary's Law Journal 149 (2004).

Kelo v. City of New London, Tulare Lake Water Basin District v. United States, and Washoe County v. United States: A Fifth Amendment Takings Primer, 36 St. Mary's Law Journal 669 (2005).

Review of Legal Resources: The Electronic Evidence and Discovery Handbook: Forms, Checklists, and Guidelines, The Colorado Lawyer, January 2007.

attorneys.bio:
Cameron Lucke was born in Ft. Lewis, Washington. As his father was in the Army, Cameron moved around frequently while growing up. Cameron eventually went to Michigan State University to complete his Bachelor’s degree. Over the summers, while not in school, Cameron would come back to Colorado to either work or intern. Though he had never lived in Colorado full time, he quickly fell in love with it and decided he wanted to make Colorado his permanent home.

After graduating, Cameron attended the University of Denver Sturm College of Law. While there, he found his passion for trial work. He was a member of the National Trial Team, where he travelled and competed in various national trial events, winning awards such as “Best Orator” and “Best Closing.” While in school, Cameron interned with the Colorado Public Defender, where he was able to get intensive in-court experience and training which helps him in his practice today. After graduation, Cameron started work at a personal injury firm in Colorado Springs. While there, he continued to be a fierce advocate for his clients.

When not at work, Cameron can be seen (or heard) cheering on his beloved Spartans, playing and watching sports (especially soccer), cooking, and spending time with his dog.

attorneys.name: Haley Macha
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Greenwood Village, CO
attorneys.bio:
I have always been passionate about criminal justice, and my goal has always been to become a criminal defense attorney because I saw the injustices that plague our system. I saw that our system can truly treat people accused with crimes with distain and I believe that every person, regardless of their background, financial status, or allegations, deserves an advocate who will fight for their rights. I am honored to fight for my clients.

I bring compassion and dedication to every case that I handle, and I pride myself on creating strong, trusting relationships with my clients. It is important to me that each client I work with feels confident that I will guide them through their case.

I grew up in McKinney, Texas and moved to Stillwater, Oklahoma where I earned my Bachelor of Science Degree in Applied Sociology with an emphasis in Law, Crime, and Social Justice. After graduation, I fulfilled my lifelong dream of moving to Colorado to begin law school at the University of Denver's Sturm College of Law . I earned my Juris Doctor with the Public Good Distinction and a Certificate in Constitutional Rights and Remedies.

Honors

attorneys.name: Joe Maher
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Lawyers in Colorado Springs, CO
attorneys.bio:
Joe Maher stands ready to help good people in difficult times. Mr. Maher has been voted by his peers as one of the top attorneys in Colorado Springs for DUI defense; he knows exactly what you are up against. Standing up to criminal or DUI charges will be one of the most trying times you will face in life. You must have a team standing next to you prepared to fight with the skill and determination to win. Maher & Maher Law PC is that team.

Joe served as a prosecutor in El Paso County Colorado for five years prior to starting his own defense practice. In this role, Joe served as a front-line supervisor for Deputy DA’s prosecuting DUI cases. He also served on the DA’s Vehicular Homicide team. There is no replacement for a lawyer’s ability to analyze a case as both a prosecutor and a defense attorney. Joe has soundly developed these analytical capabilities having tried more than 60 jury trials to verdict as a deputy district attorney and private defense counsel. Not only is Joe an accomplished trial lawyer but he has worked intentionally to develop specific DUI defense capabilities that are rare within his field:

Joe has successfully completed the Standardized Field Sobriety Testing (SFST) and Detection course that DUI officers must complete.

Joe has successfully completed the SFST Instructor Development course that the most experienced DUI officers complete.

Joe has successfully completed the Advanced Roadside Impaired Driving Enforcement (ARIDE) course that advanced DUI officers must complete.

Joe has successfully completed the Axion Laboratories Forensic Chromatography course in Chicago, IL. Gas Chromatography is the testing method Colorado forensic laboratories use to test a driver’s blood specimens for blood alcohol content (BAC).

Joe was voted by his peers as one of Colorado Springs’ top DUI attorneys in Colorado Springs Magazine’s 2023 Top Attorney voting.

Prior to earning the title Attorney, Joe earned the title Marine Officer. Joe attained the rank of Captain, commanding two platoons and a company of Marines during three deployments to Iraq. He was awarded the Marine Corps Association’s Chambers award for leadership following his company command tour. Joe also served on the staff of U.S. Senator Chuck Hagel as a deputy legislative assistant for military and veteran’s issues.

Joe’s experiences as a trial attorney, military officer, legislative staff member, and combat veteran have forged an unapologetic and unwavering respect for the U.S. Constitution and an ardent belief that the rights enshrined within it must be defended at the level of the individual citizen.

Joe is thankful for his wife and sons. He and Kimberly are the proud parents of FOUR boys. Joe is an avid hockey player and youth hockey coach.

attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Cases Lawyers in Colorado Springs, CO
attorneys.bio:
Kimberly Maher has lived and worked in Colorado Springs for more than 13 years. She graduated from Purdue University with a B.A. in Political Science. Kimberly then moved to Washington D.C. where she served as a legislative assistant for a Florida congressman. She worked on the House Education and Labor Committee and aided in the reauthorization of the Higher Education Act.

Kimberly then returned to Colorado and graduated from the University of Denver Sturm College of Law. While in law school, Kimberly served as President of the Student Trial Lawyers Association.

Kimberly worked for five years in two different Colorado jurisdictions as a deputy district attorney. During her tenure as a Deputy D.A. she was a member of the vehicular homicide team and prosecuted a wide range of criminal cases including but not limited to DUIs, traffic offenses, domestic violence, kidnapping, stalking, burglary, fraud and murder. As a former prosecutor, Kimberly understands what you are up against and will passionately advocate on your behalf to protect your rights and your future. Kimberly currently resides with her husband Joe and their sons in Colorado Springs.

attorneys.name: Bailey W. Mahoney
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
Bailey W. Mahoney is an experienced domestic relations attorney and partner with Harrington Brewster Mahoney Smits, P.C., who specializes in assisting families throughout the state of Colorado that are going through dissolution of marriage and child-related cases.

Prior to beginning her legal career, Bailey received both her MBA and undergraduate degrees in business administration from Oklahoma State University, during which, Bailey completed extensive coursework in finance and accounting. With this unique educational background, Bailey is exceptionally well suited to handle the financially complex issues that frequently arise in divorce and child-related cases, such as determination of income when a party is self-employed, business valuation, executive compensation, child support and equitable distribution in marital settlement agreements.

Additionally, during law school, Bailey interned for the Honorable Angela R. Arkin in Douglas County District Court, where she acquired perspective on how judges handle the complexities of domestic relations cases. Bailey also clerked for the Honorable Dana Wakefield, a retired judge and then court-appointed Child and Family Investigator (CFI), where Bailey assisted in making recommendations to the Court regarding children involved in high conflict cases.

While Bailey excels in the area of written advocacy and is an experienced family law litigator who has successfully tried numerous complex and highly contentious disputes in a courtroom setting, Bailey is dedicated to helping parties resolve their divorce and family law disputes whenever possible outside of court via the negotiation of amicable settlement agreements. In addition to the traditional representation of clients in family law cases, Bailey offers unbundled representation services and is trained to represent clients in Collaborative Law cases (cases in which both parties commit up front to resolving their family law disputes outside of court in a cooperative manner). Bailey also regularly serves in a neutral capacity as a privately retained family law mediator where Bailey draws upon her years of experience to help parties resolve their disputes in ways that are personalized and cost-effective.

Bailey is a passionate advocate with a dedication to assisting families and brings both practical experience and personal understanding to her practice, while prioritizing preparedness, attention to detail and professionalism. Bailey works diligently to obtain customized solutions for her clients and strongly believes in the importance of developing close professional attorney-client relationships. While Bailey has substantial experience with all family law related issues, Bailey is also experienced with premarital agreements; marital agreements; cohabitation agreements; contempt and collection-related proceedings; dependency and neglect cases; adoption; and Assisted Reproductive Technology (ART), including gestational surrogacy agreements and donor agreements.

attorneys.name: Andrea N. Mahoney
attorneys.practice_type: Estate and Trust Litigation Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
Andrea N. Mahoney is a partner at Mahoney Law LLC, who specializes in estate and trust litigation, fiduciary litigation, trust and estate administration, probate and estate planning. Andrea is the current Co-Chair of the Probate and Litigation Committee of the Trust and Estate Section of the Colorado Bar Association. While in law school, Mrs. Mahoney was the only student member of the National Academy of Elder Law Attorneys. Her studies emphasized issues concerning the elderly, estate and trust litigation, estate planning and tax matters. After law school, Mrs. Mahoney became employed with a top law firm focusing on these issues. Mrs. Mahoney then gained experience practicing complex commercial litigation for several years. She has successfully tried and arbitrated numerous cases and has successfully argued six cases to the Colorado Court of Appeals. Mrs. Mahoney’s extensive commercial litigation experience, coupled with her knowledge of the Colorado Rules of Civil Procedure and the law, have greatly enhanced her ability to litigate in this very specialized area of estate and trust litigation. Mrs. Mahoney has had many recent successes including defending the validity of a deed and claims for civil theft, breach of fiduciary duty, fraud and unjust enrichment; invalidating a trust, defending the validity of a will executed by an elderly woman with dementia who had recently been hospitalized, reforming a will, defending a beneficiary designation and resolution of actions seeking removal of a trustee. Mrs. Mahoney was one of only six attorneys in the state to be named as a Colorado Super Lawyer in 2026 in the category of Estate and Trust Litigation. She was also selected as a 5280 Top Lawyer (Probate Litigation) in 2026; less than 3% of the attorneys in the state are chosen as 5280 Top Lawyers.

Andrea is a frequent lecturer at continuing legal education conventions on topics related to estate and trust litigation.

Recent Presentations:

• Presenter at the 2024 Colorado Bar Association’s Estate Planning Retreat - Best Practices for Estate Planers in Preventing a Will or Trust Contest and the Role of an Estate Planning Attorney if a Contest if Filed
