attorneys.name: Kevin S. Mahoney
attorneys.practice_type: Estate and Trust Litigation Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
Kevin Mahoney specializes in estate and trust litigation. He has tried cases to judges, juries, and arbitrators, and he has taken and defended more than 1,000 depositions, the vast majority of which were medical or economic experts. He spent several years as a partner at a Denver law firm where he handled medical malpractice and mass tort cases. He obtained several multi-million dollar verdicts against physicians and dentists, including the largest verdict against a dentist in Colorado history [Dosien v. Dorsey]. Kevin now serves as personal counsel to physicians who are defendants in litigation. He has been practicing since 1995 and is licensed in both Colorado and Wyoming. He has been selected as a Colorado Super Lawyer every year since 2009 and has been named as a 5280 Top Lawyer every year since 2015.

Kevin attended college at Duke University where he was a four-year letterman on the varsity lacrosse team. He was chosen to the Atlantic Coast Conference Honor Roll during each of his four years of college. In 1991 he graduated magna cum laude from Duke with a double major in history and political science. He then attended Duke University School of Law, which is one of the top ten law schools in the country. He was a member of the law review at Duke and received the Note of the Year Award in 1994. In 1995, Kevin graduated in the top ten percent of his law school class.

Kevin has been a youth lacrosse coach for fifteen years. He was the head coach for all four of his children’s teams – two sons and two daughters. Kevin has coached dozens of players at the youth and high school level who went on to play Division I lacrosse in college, including more than 20 girls in the high school class of 2024.

attorneys.name: Sangeetha Mallavarapu
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Boulder, CO
attorneys.bio:
I grew up in Oklahoma but spent ten years living in Boston, where I graduated summa cum laude in 2001 with a B.A. in Psychology and a minor in Statistics from Boston University. After receiving my M.A. in Psychology, also from Boston University, I realized that my true desire was to attend law school after seeing how legal complications could have devastating effects on people's lives. I craved the mountains and everything else Colorado has to offer, so I decided to move across the country. I moved to Boulder and received my J.D. from the University of Colorado School of Law in 2010 and have been practicing law and enjoying Colorado since then.

In law school, I was fortunate enough to have the opportunity to participate in two clinics, the Family Law Clinic and the Criminal Defense Clinic. It was there that I realized I had a passion for helping people through very difficult times. I successfully represented indigent clients at hearings, mediations, and at trial.

After I graduated from law school, I worked at two prominent Denver law firms. My legal practice focused on complex commercial litigation at both the trial and appellate level.

After working for more than 3 years in civil litigation, I went through a painful divorce, and through that experience realized I wanted to go back to practicing family law and supporting people who are going through this emotionally difficult time. My background in psychology, my personal experience going through a divorce, the satisfaction I felt through my involvement with the family law clinic in law school, and my compassion for people draws me to this field of work.

I served as a magistrate (judicial officer) in Boulder County District Court in an exclusively family law docket. My ability to counsel clients away from unreasonable positions and work with the opposing counsel or opposing party collaboratively typically results in clients being able to settle disputed issues before they end up in court. However, should your case be forced into a contested hearing, I have the experience and knowledge to be your strongest advocate before the judge. Not only am I quick on my feet in the courtroom, but I understand the perspective of judicial officers and what they look for when making decisions. I will use my skills to put you in the best position to achieve an outcome that is in your best interests.

In addition to practicing law, I am also involved in the National Asian Pacific American Bar Association, the South Asian Bar Association, the Colorado Women's Bar Association, and the Colorado Bar Association.

In my spare time, I enjoy ballroom dancing, skiing, hiking, and spending time with my family.

attorneys.name: Joshua T. Mangiagli
attorneys.practice_type: Eminent Domain Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
People come to an attorney because they need help. Josh Mangiagli built his practice around a simple conviction: that help looks different for every client, and that the attorney's job is to figure out what it looks like for you.

Josh focuses on eminent domain and real estate litigation at Alderman Bernstein LLC, where he has practiced since 2020. His clients include individual landowners facing the loss of property they've owned for generations, businesses navigating the disruption of a government taking, and public entities and condemning authorities working to acquire land for critical infrastructure projects. The cases are rarely simple. The stakes — financial, personal, and practical — are almost always significant.

His first task in any matter is to understand that particular client's circumstances: their goals, their concerns, the strengths and weaknesses of their case. From there, his job is to help them chart the most effective path forward — not the most standard one. Law is not a one-size-fits-all practice, and Josh doesn't treat it that way.

When a case goes to trial, Josh draws on a skill he developed long before law school — as a middle school teacher in New Orleans, he learned how to take a complex story and present it in a way that truly lands with an audience. Eminent domain cases often turn on valuation disputes, technical appraisals, and contested legal standards. Making those things accessible and persuasive to a jury or commission is where preparation meets advocacy.

Josh grew up in Denver and graduated from the University of Denver Sturm College of Law, where he was a member of the National Trial Team, served as an Associate Editor of the Denver Law Review, and was inducted into the Order of the Coif. He earned his undergraduate degree with honors from the University of Vermont.

Outside the office, Josh coaches the mock trial team at Denver North High School, serves on the Executive Council of the Denver Bar Association's Young Lawyers Division, and dedicates time to pro bono work. He lives in Denver with his wife and family.

Mr. Manzer has tried cases before juries in Weld, Lincoln, Broomfield, Morgan and Yuma Counties from simple DUI's to complex 1st Degree Murder cases.

Today, Mr. Manzer focuses more on family law matters, including divorce, allocation of parental rights and responsibilities, post-decree issues and dependency/ neglect actions, adoptions, name changes.

Mr. Manzer is a strong proponent of community service. He assists vulnerable populations by volunteering his legal knowledge for Weld County Legal Services. He also has served on multiple community boards. He is currently the Co-Chair of the Board Salida Del Sol Academy.

In his spare time, Mr. Manzer dabbles in photography, learning to play guitar, camping with his wife and daughter.

attorneys.firm_name: Frank Azar Car & Truck Accident Lawyers - Littleton, Colorado
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Littleton, CO
attorneys.bio:
"Helping ordinary people with a difficult time in their lives is a gratifying way of practicing law."

Robert Markel is a very skilled attorney who has been with Franklin D. Azar & Associates, P.C. for over 25 years. Robert's practice area is primarily personal injury, including automobile accidents, premises liability, and nursing home neglect.

An alumni of Colorado College, where he received his undergraduate degree in 1979, Mr. Markel was also awarded "Best Student in Economics." He attended the University of Colorado's law school and received his law degree in 1982. It was that same year he obtained his license to practice law in Colorado and the U.S. District Court, District of Colorado. In 1989, Mr. Markel was admitted to the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 10th Circuit.

Before joining Frank Azar & Associates, Mr. Markel worked at two other law firms and handled commercial cases including bankruptcy, securities, real estate lending and transactions, lender liability, and malpractice defense. He was grateful for the experience those cases taught him, but he found the work not very satisfying and sought change to a different area of law. He joined Franklin D. Azar & Associates, P.C. and started to pursue the representation of individuals who had been injured or wronged and who were usually dealing with a difficult period in their lives.

In addition to cases arising out of motor vehicle accidents, at Frank Azar & Associates he has handled a wide variety of other cases including nursing home neglect, premises liability, the Fair Labor Standards Act, the Federal Torts Claim Act, the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act, and bankruptcy. He has obtained over $60 million in settlements and verdicts for his clients during his tenure at the firm, including a recovery with the assistance of co-counsel of over $4 million on behalf of a client who was seriously injured as a result of a defective seat belt following a collision caused by an inebriated driver.

Robert enjoys playing golf, bicycling and running in his spare time. As a true Coloradan, he loves skiing the beautiful landscapes the state offers. In addition, he relishes the company of his family, including his wife of over 30 years and three adult children.

Mr. Markel is a member of the Colorado Trial Lawyers Association and the American Association for Justice. He continually advocates for protecting victims' rights and embodying the true mission of the law firm.

Awards and Honors

Honors

John J. Sullivan Award, Best Student in Economics

attorneys.name: Bradley Martin
attorneys.practice_type: DUI/DWI Lawyers in Greeley, CO
attorneys.bio:
Bradley Martin is a northern Colorado lawyer specializing in criminal defense. Bradley is dedicated to serving his clients with excellence and achieving the best possible outcome for each individual case. Bradley has a proven record of success, whether that means trial or negotiation for his clients. He has extensive courtroom and trial experience. As a former public defender, Bradley has handled thousands of cases. He has defended everything from DUI to first-degree murder. His clients have been found not guilty of charges ranging from the lowest misdemeanors to the highest-level felonies. Bradley's jury trial experience even includes a jury trial that was nationally televised live on Court TV. Bradley also focuses on pretrial litigation. His litigation experience includes a record of successfully suppressing evidence before trial that was illegally obtained by police.

Bradley practices a "client- centered" philosophy when it comes to the representation of his clients. He believes the only way to achieve the results the client desires is to make respect, understanding, and open communication the foundation of the attorney-client relationship.

Bradley earned his law degree from Washburn University School of Law in Topeka, Kansas, in 2006. In 2005, he was awarded the Max Rowinski Award for Outstanding Student in Trial Advocacy. Prior to law school, Bradley worked as a counselor in a treatment facility for juvenile offenders. Through this experience, Bradley dedicated himself to the compassionate representation of those charged with crimes.

Bradley earned his Bachelor's degree in Sociology from the University of Northern Colorado. Bradley was born in Denver, but has lived much of his life in northern Colorado.

attorneys.practice_type: Estate Planning and Tax Practice Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
Mark's practice focuses on estate planning, tax planning, business planning, estate and trust administration and real estate, including planned charitable giving. Mark has been called a "natural born teacher," who spends about half of his time with his clients listening to their needs. He then details each estate planning option and helps his clients understand and plan the best course of action to achieve their goals. He believes that wealth should not be a wedge that drives family members apart.

Mark holds the Accredited Estate Planner designation from the National Association of Estate Planners & Councils, and an A-V (highest) peer rating from Martindale-Hubbell.

Mark loves the law and enjoys explaining how estate planning and administration work not only to clients, but to paralegals, lawyers and other professionals working in related fields such as insurance and investments.

Mark has been a continuing education lecturer and program planner for Colorado attorneys since 1992. He was awarded the Doyle Award of Excellence in 2008 by CLE, Inc. of the Colorado Bar Association for his contributions to continuing legal education and publications. Mark is an adjunct faculty member of the Paralegal Department of Arapahoe Community College and a Lab Instructor for the University of Denver College of Law. Since 2009, Mark has been recognized in 5280 and ColoradoBiz magazines for "Five Star" client satisfaction among Colorado estate planning attorneys, and is recognized in those publications as a "Colorado Superlawyer" since 2011.

attorneys.name: Andrew Maurin
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
Andrew Maurin is an Associate Attorney at GEM Family Law. He practices exclusively in family law and has extensive litigation experience in child custody, child relocation, child support, and dependency and neglect matters.

Andrew graduated from the University of Kentucky College of Law, and he served as a law clerk for the Children’s Law Center throughout his time in law school with a focus on education and civil rights law. Andrew practiced as a Senior Program Attorney for children in Dependency & Neglect proceedings and served as a statewide program expert for young adults in foster care and survivors of commercial sexual exploitation with the Florida Guardian ad Litem Program. During that time, Andrew also operated a legal aid program supporting young adults with foster care experience regarding a variety of issues, including child custody, child support, dependency and neglect, administrative appeals, landlord/tenant law and more.

Andrew led a nonprofit organization serving youth in foster care, tripling the organization’s revenue, launching a children’s clothing program in 5 retail-style locations, and partnering with the Annie E. Casey Foundation and United Way to fully fund a financial education program for young adults, providing a $3,000 savings match for each graduate.

Prior to joining GEM Family Law, Andrew served as a Policy Advisor for the State of Colorado’s Division of Child Support Services, serving as a key staff lead in developing, implementing, and maintaining Division policies, procedures, and regulations in child support enforcement, financial policy, and administrative reviews.

attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Northglenn, CO
attorneys.bio:
Hello, my name is Nick Mayle and I am the Managing Attorney of the Grand Junction Office of Ramos Law. I am a trial lawyer. I believe in standing up for the rights of my clients and accepting nothing less than justice. I devote 100 percent of my practice to representing the injured and those who have been wronged by others. My practice focuses on helping those who have been seriously injured or the families of those who have been killed by negligence, drunk drivers, defective products, and dangerous conditions. To me, clients are family and there is nothing more important than securing a positive outcome for them.

Over the years, I have recovered Tens of Millions of Dollars for my clients in settlements, verdicts, and judgments, including a judgment of over $1,000,000 through jury trial. I have had the pleasure of working on some very interesting and challenging cases that have been covered by the Associated Press, Dateline, the Denver Post, CBS Denver, ABC 7 Denver, NBC KUSA Denver, NBC KKCO Grand Junction, CBS KREX Grand Junction, the Grand Junction Daily Sentinel, and the Montrose Daily Press.

I grew up in a military family and spent my youth living around the country and around the world. I now love calling Western Colorado home. I am married to a wonderful wife who formerly worked as a news anchor for NBC in Grand Junction. We have a beautiful and intelligent daughter who is in elementary school. In addition, we have a very friendly, but mischievous Australian Shepard. I love spending time with family and enjoying all that Western Colorado has to offer, including mountain biking, hiking, and skiing.

I look forward to speaking with you and can be reached at (970) 363-8151 or nmayle@ramoslaw.com.

attorneys.name: Jordan McAdams
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
Jordan grew up in Tulsa, Oklahoma and attended The University of Oklahoma for his undergraduate degree. After receiving his bachelor’s degree in political science, he attended the University of Denver Sturm College of Law where he earned his Juris Doctorate.

Jordan’s inspiration to become an attorney comes mostly from his grandfather, who was the Deputy Investigator in Caddo County, Oklahoma. From an early age his grandfather’s involvement in solving high stakes cases and testifying at jury trials really inspired Jordan from a young age. “Inside of a court room has always been better than any movie or show,” says Jordan. “It is real life, as real as it gets.”

Jordan was particularly interested in personal injury law because he believes that corporations often profit by treating people poorly. Corporations like insurance companies take advantage of injured individuals when it comes time to pay for claims or assist in the aftermath of an accident. Jordan wanted to fight these corporations on behalf his clients who deserve to be fairly compensated after being injured.

When asked how he approaches his cases Jordan says, “I strive to get to know every one of my clients on a personal level. Knowing what they like to do in their free time is integral to representation. Often, these simple joys of life, are the very things that are taken away by the negligence of another person. Having a keen understanding of those things is the best way to explain a client’s injuries and the impact on the client’s life to the jury.”

Jordan believes that there is an overwhelming sense of pride within McDivitt Law Firm. “What sets us apart is not only reflected in the work we do, but the way we treat one another. There is tremendous support from the whole team, which allows us to provide an elevated client experience.”

Awards and Honors

Honors

Top 10 Under 40 – National Academy of Personal Injury Attorneys, 2019

attorneys.name: William McAdams
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Law Lawyers in Greeley, CO
attorneys.bio:
William T. McAdams, better known as Bill, is a former prosecutor who now manages a successful criminal defense practice. He formed the McAdams Law Office in 2006 and has represented clients in a variety of court matters including DUI, DWAI, assault, domestic violence, theft, burglary, juvenile matters, minor in possession (MIP), sexual assault, forgery, fraud, drugs, alcohol, animal matters, driving under suspension (DUS), driving under revocation (DUR), speeding, reckless driving and careless driving. Bill also has significant experience in handling DMV hearings for DUI suspensions, point suspensions and red licenses which permit limited driving privileges. In total, Bill has handled thousands of cases including more than 100 jury trials.

Bill also serves as Alternate Defense Counsel in certain courts in Weld County where he is occasionally appointed to represent clients with whom the Public Defender has a conflict. He is a member of the National College for DUI Defense (NCDD), DUI Defense Lawyers Association (DUIDLA), Colorado Criminal Defense Bar (CCDB), Colorado Bar Association (CBA) and the Weld County Bar Association (WCBA). Since 2009, Bill has either taught or participated in more than 250 hours of DUI trainings. He predominantly handles matters in Weld and Larimer counties and the cities of Greeley, Evans, Windsor, Loveland and Fort Collins.

Prior to beginning the McAdams Law Office, Bill served as a Deputy District Attorney for the 19th Judicial District of Colorado (Weld County) from early 2004 to mid 2006. While at the District Attorney’s Office, he handled felony and misdemeanor matters. This included DUI, domestic violence and traffic matters. He participated in approximately 40 jury trials while in this office, numerous court trials and hundreds of motions hearings.

Prior to being a Deputy District Attorney, Bill practiced in the Denver area. Initially, he was an associate at the law firm of Ledbetter and Associates and then was a sole practitioner. During this time, Bill handled a variety of matters including criminal defense, DUI, family law, civil litigation, probate and wills.

Bill is a native of Colorado and grew up in Denver and Boulder. He attended college at Baylor University in Waco, Texas where he earned a Bachelor of Arts degree with a double major in Political Science and History in 1994. He then attended Drake University in Des Moines, Iowa where he earned a Juris Doctorate law degree in 1999. He is an active member of his community where he serves in numerous volunteer positions in his church, on his homeowner’s association board of directors and serves on the Board of Governors for University Schools in Greeley, Colorado. His hobbies include softball, volleyball and travel.

attorneys.practice_type: Divorce Lawyers in Westminster, CO
attorneys.bio:
Litigation Experience

While the goal is settlement, I have extensive experience in Jefferson, Adams, Broomfield, Denver, Arapahoe, Boulder, Douglas, Larimer and Weld county courtrooms. I will aggressively and competently represent you should your case need to go to trial. I am detail oriented, organized and thorough in my trial preparation. I make sure my clients are well prepared and ready to participate in the litigation of their case, which dramatically reduces the anxiety and stress associated with going to court.

Ancillary Businesses

Mediation of Family Law Cases – I offer the low cost option of mediation to clients who do not want to litigate their case. My hourly rate for mediation is merely $200 per hour with each party paying one half of my rate for each hour of mediation. If an agreement is reached, I draft the agreement for you, which is then signed by the parties ready for you to file with the court. In all cases where mediation is court ordered, a Certificate of Mediation is provided to you.

attorneys.bio:
Janene McCabe has over two decades of experience as a trial litigator in criminal defense. She has been recognized for her advocacy skills and leadership abilities. Janene is known for tackling tough cases and finding creative solutions and winning trial strategies.

Janene was recognized as Attorney of the Year for the Office of the Public Defender, an honor reserved for those demonstrating outstanding service to the ideals of criminal defense. She was selected for the award out of hundreds of attorneys throughout the state of Colorado.

Janene grew up in a military family and moved from state to state and school to school. By the time she graduated from High School in Illinois she had attended 13 different schools. The experience taught her to be flexible, self-reliant and to learn the unique story of each individual. Her clients praise her frank and persuasive communication both in and out of the courtroom.

attorneys.name: Maddie M. McClain
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
Maddie McClain is a family law attorney with Ciancio Ciancio Brown, P.C. Maddie acknowledges the psychological, emotional, and financial stressors that can accompany family law issues and seeks to provide calm and empathetic guidance through these difficult situations. Maddie provides representation in a variety of areas, including dissolutions of marriage, allocation of parental responsibilities, child support and spousal support, protection orders, adoptions, and dependency and neglect.

Maddie’s prior experience as a resource worker in a domestic violence shelter affords her an intricate understanding of domestic violence and its impact on children. Maddie uses her experience to approach clients from a trauma-informed perspective and to help clients maintain focus on life after their family law matter is resolved.

Originally from Corpus Christi, Texas, Maddie attended law school at The George Washington University Law School in Washington, D.C. and graduated in 2022 with a concentration in Family Law and Estate Planning. Maddie’s previous work experience at the National Family Violence Law Center acquainted her with issues of parental alienation and co-parenting dynamics. Since law school, Maddie’s practice has focused exclusively on family law matters, as she is passionate about ensuring people of all races, ethnicities, sexual orientations, and socioeconomic statuses have equal access to justice.

Maddie strives to closely comprehend client goals and ensure that each client feels secure and dignified in resolving their family law matter. While these goals are often achieved through negotiating settlements, Maddie is always prepared to zealously advocate for her clients in the courtroom.

In her personal time, Maddie enjoys rockhounding and volunteering at animal shelters. Maddie and her wife love to cheer on the WNBA and spoil their two disabled rescue cats, Lily and Vixen.

attorneys.bio:
Adam M. McClure, Esq. is at the top of his game. Recently selected for membership in "The National Trial Lawyers: Top 40 Under 40" organization, Mr. McClure is one of only 40 Colorado lawyers to be awarded this honor. Also named a "Rising Star" by "Super Lawyers" in both 2010 and 2011, Mr. McClure is an exceptional litigator and has been a key member of The Frickey Law Firm since 2003. A graduate of The University of Denver College of Law, he specializes in Workers' Compensation and Personal Injury, expertly handling complex cases that serve the disabled and injured throughout the state of Colorado. He prioritizes the personal well being of his clients, working to ensure that each receives the maximum benefits allowed for their lost wages, medical expenses and disability. As a board member of the Workers' Compensation Education Association, Mr. McClure is dedicated to remaining current on the laws and issues that affect the state of Colorado, and safeguarding the rights of injured workers across the state of Colorado.

attorneys.name: Brian G. McConaty
attorneys.firm_name: John Astuno Jr. Attorney at Law
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
Brian G. McConaty specializes in civil trial practice with an emphasis on medical malpractice, health law and civil/commercial litigation. In 2008, he was elected Colorado's first Diplomate in the American Board of Trial Advocates and has tried over 100 jury trials to verdict. He is a Master Barrister with Doyle's American Inn of Court. He has been on the faculty at the University of Colorado School of Medicine for over 20 years and has been promoted from Clinical Instructor to Senior Clinical Instructor to Assistant Clinical Professor. He has lectured locally, nationally and internationally on medical-legal topics.

Mr. McConaty earned his B.A. and J.D. degrees from the University of Colorado Boulder. After law school, he served as a Deputy District Attorney in Aspen and Denver and assisted in the prosecution of Claudine Longet and Ted Bundy. He then served as an Assistant United States Attorney in charge of prosecution of organized crime/narcotics including the prosecution of the FBI's No.1 Most Wanted criminal at the time.

Mr. McConaty is admitted to the Supreme Court of the United States, United States District Court for the District of Colorado, Colorado Bar Association, Denver Bar Association and the Defense Research Institute.

attorneys.name: Mike McDivitt
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
Mike McDivitt often says he is in the accountability business. His primary goal in practicing law is to right the balance of wrongdoing, holding accountable those who have caused harm to his clients. Since 1974, his work as a trial lawyer has led him to focus on personal injury, where on a daily basis he is able to fight for his clients to get them the compensation needed to get their lives back on track after a terrible accident.

As a Colorado native, Mike is proud of his small-town roots. He grew up in La Junta, Colorado, where he was also an Eagle Scout. Mike attended the University of Denver for his undergraduate degree in Economics, with minors in Spanish and Political Science. Upon graduation, Mike entered the United States Army serving in the Criminal Investigation Division, stationed in Seoul, Korea. He attended the University of Colorado Law School after his Army service, receiving his law degree in 1974.

Upon passing the bar exam in 1974, Mike returned to his hometown of La Junta where he began his own general law practice. As a general practitioner, he represented clients with many different legal needs, such as family law, real estate matters, criminal defense, and personal injury cases. As his practice grew, Mike found great satisfaction in fighting to hold accountable those who were negligent or reckless in causing injuries and disruptions in the lives of his clients.

In 1989, Mike and his wife, Karen McDivitt, PhD, moved their family to Colorado Springs, Colorado, where he opened a firm focused exclusively on personal injury and workers’ compensation. He became one of the first attorneys in Colorado to advertise on TV, an important aspect to his business because he wanted everyone to know that he would represent them to get compensation for their injuries without any fee until he got money for them from the at-fault parties. This is called a “contingency fee.” Mike understands that most people don’t know an attorney, or who to call if they have a legal issue. Mike and Karen worked hard to get the message out that McDivitt Law Firm represents its clients only on this contingency fee basis.

Over the past several decades, McDivitt Law Firm has grown into one of the largest personal injury law firms in Colorado. Mike’s son, David McDivitt (an attorney), joined the practice in 2007, his wife, Karen, continues to work on the business side as the firm’s president and their daughter Lisa McDivitt Bush joined the firm as the marketing director in 2012. The family-run firm opened its fifth office in January 2017, and now has locations throughout Colorado.

attorneys.name: Shawn E. McDermott
attorneys.firm_name: McDermott Law, LLC: Disability & ERISA Lawyers
attorneys.practice_type: Group Disability and Life Insurance Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
Shawn E. McDermott is a disability and life insurance law litigator who primarily serves communities of Denver, Boulder, Aurora, Littleton, Ft. Collins, Greeley, Colorado Springs, Grand Junction, Durango, and other areas throughout Colorado and the Rocky Mountain West. The attorneys and staff at McDermott Law, LLC: Disability & ERISA Lawyers handle a wide variety of disputes with insurance companies involving injury, illness, and disease. He has practiced law in Denver since 1992 and has extensive experience litigating cases involving insurance coverage and bad faith, disability law and ERISA.

Shawn E. McDermott is the owner/manager of the firm, specializing in insurance recovery and bad faith, ERISA disability, Colorado PERA disability claims, physician and dentist disability claims, and accidental death and dismemberment claims.

Shawn is a 1992 graduate of the University of Colorado School of Law. Prior to law school, he received his Bachelor of Science degree in Architectural Engineering in 1988 from the University of Colorado.

While in law school, Shawn was a member of the Rothgerber Moot Court winning team and received the Austin W. Scott, Jr. Award for Excellence in Oral Argument.

Prior to forming McDermott Law, LLC: Disability & ERISA Lawyers in 1996, Shawn was an associate attorney at the law firm of Breit, Best Richman and Bosch representing individuals and insurance companies and their insureds in a variety of claims, including insurance coverage and bad faith, aviation cases, automobile crashworthiness, railroad crossing injury, professional (medical and legal) liability, products liability, skier and ski area liability, catastrophic injury and wrongful death. He now dedicates the bulk of his time and this firm's resources to representing individuals against insurance companies in the areas of disability, life, health and accidental death & dismemberment claims, ERISA-governed claims for employee benefits, PERA disability retirement claims, and serious personal injury matters.

Shawn has litigated hundreds of ERISA and non-ERISA disability and life insurance claims in the Colorado state courts, the United States District Court for the District of Colorado and courts in other states. Shawn's federal court experience is significant in the ERISA arena, likely having handled more of these claims than any other attorney in Colorado. He has also argued cases before the Colorado Court of Appeals and the United States Tenth Circuit Court of Appeals.

Shawn is a member of the Denver Bar Association and the Colorado Bar Association. He is active in the Colorado Trial Lawyers Association and has served on its Board of Directors as well as a two-year stint as the original Co-Chairperson of the Young Lawyers Committee (many years ago). He is also a member of the American Association for Justice (formerly Association of Trial Lawyers of America). Shawn is licensed to practice in all Colorado State and Federal courts, including the Tenth Circuit Court of Appeals.

When not in the office, Shawn enjoys spending time with his wife and two sons. He is an avid golfer and fly fisherman in the summer (when time permits). The winter months in Colorado are, of course, meant for skiing with family and friends.

attorneys.name: David McDivitt
attorneys.practice_type: Auto Accidents Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
David McDivitt, a nationally recognized trial lawyer, is the Executive Vice President and Chief Operating Officer of McDivitt Law Firm. In addition to managing the day-to-day operations of McDivitt Law Firm, David runs the firm’s litigation and trial group, where he is responsible for both trying and supervising jury trials through verdict. Before joining McDivitt Law Firm, David was formerly a Deputy Public Defender with the Office of the Colorado State Public Defender where he earned the reputation as a highly successful and experienced trial lawyer. A frequent legal analyst and contributor to local and national television news and radio, David has been named one of the National Trial Lawyer’s Association’s Top 40 Trial Lawyers under 40.

David devotes 100 percent of his time to representing those injured in auto accidents, victims of drunk drivers, victims of defective products and machinery, those who have been seriously or catastrophically injured due to the negligence of others, and those whose loved ones have been killed due to the negligence of others (wrongful death claims).

In addition to his work with McDivitt Law Firm, David sits on the Board of Directors of the Colorado Trial Lawyers Association, the state’s largest specialty legal bar association, and is also a multi-term member of its select Executive Committee. In these capacities, David is involved in decision making at the highest levels within Colorado’s trial lawyer community. David is also the Co-Chair of the Colorado Trial Lawyers Association’s EAGLE Committee, which works to ensure the laws of Colorado protect the rights of individuals and those hurt by someone else’s wrongdoing. In 2010, David was awarded the Colorado Trial Lawyers Association’s “Membership Volunteer of the Year Award” for his commitment to the membership of the organization.

David actively works to support legislation designed to protect the rights of injured victims, workers, and consumers. David frequently testifies before both the Colorado State Senate Judiciary Committee and the House Judiciary Committee as an expert on behalf of various legislation designed to protect the rights of those injured due to the negligence of others, including those injured by drunk drivers. In addition to his work at the State Capitol, David has been a featured speaker at the largest annual gathering of auto accident and wrongful death trial lawyers in Colorado, speaking about changes in the law designed to protect injured victims’ rights to pursue their claims against wrongdoers.

David received his Bachelor of Arts degree in economics from the University of Colorado at Boulder, where he graduated magna cum laude and was honored with admission into Phi Beta Kappa, the nation’s most prestigious academic honor society. He was also the recipient of the Dean’s Scholars Arts and Sciences Scholarship and the Alumni Association Scholarship, and was a member of the Golden Key National Honor Society. During his undergraduate years, David also studied economics, accounting, computer science, and archaeology at Washington and Lee University in Lexington, Virginia, and also attended the University of Paris, Sorbonne, where he earned a certification in the French language

After graduation, he worked for several years as an investment banker in London. David received his Juris Doctor from the University of Colorado School of Law. During his tenure at law school, he served as an editor of the University of Colorado Law Review, was the winner of the Carrigan Cup Mock Trial Competition, the William O. DeSouchet Award for “Best Individual Performance in Trial Advocacy,” and the “Colorado Trial Lawyer’s Association-Joel H. Greenstein Award for Best Performance in Advanced Trial Advocacy.” David has been admitted to the Colorado Bar, the U.S. District Court for the District of Colorado, and the U.S. Court of Appeals, 10th Circuit. His professional memberships include the American Association for Justice (also known as the Association of Trial Lawyers of America), the Colorado Trial Lawyer’s Association, the American Bar Association, the Colorado Bar Association, the Denver Bar Association, and the El Paso County Bar Association.

David is a proud father of two young children. He is active in his community, supporting a number of local and national charitable organizations.

David McDivitt has been recognized by the Colorado Super Lawyers publication as a 2018 Rising Star in the Personal Injury: Plaintiff category. Super Lawyers Rising Stars are selected through a formal nomination process and 12 categories of professional success and recognition from peers. Super Lawyers creates this list to provide a roster of exceptional attorneys for the public.

attorneys.firm_name: The Law Office of Monica S. McElyea, LLC
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Grand Junction, CO
attorneys.bio:
The Law Office of Monica S. McElyea, LLC provides experienced, reputable, and skilled legal representation from our office in the Grand Junction area of Colorado. We are honored and humbled each time a client entrusts us to handle their legal matter, because we know the outcome will affect their lives for years to come.

Her practice areas include criminal defense, personal injury, DUI, divorce, juvenile matters, and family law. Monica S. McElyea is an established lawyer who provides legal services at competitive rates while maintaining the highest professional standards and continuing to evolve in order to meet the needs of the client. This firm tailors its services to respond to a client's particular need. Every client deserves clear communication, practical advice, and a cost effective outcome. The firm practices and believes in frequent client communication and participation in decision making in order to ensure the outcome meets a client's need.

Monica was born and raised in Pennington Gap, Virginia, until she moved to Georgia to attend law school. She graduated from the Walter F. George School of Law at Mercer University, in Macon, Georgia in 1991. After graduating from law school and practicing law for five years in Virginia, she and her husband moved to Summit County, Colorado in 1997. In 1997, she commenced practicing law in Frisco with David A. Helmer. She first worked as an associate and then as a partner in the law firm of Helmer & McElyea, LLC. They remained in Breckenridge, Summit County, until December 2023, when they relocated to Mesa County, Colorado.

Monica S. McElyea practices in the areas of criminal defense, domestic relations including divorce, personal injury, medical malpractice, civil and criminal litigation. Attorney Monica S. McElyea is a former Assistant Commonwealth's Attorney for Lee County, Virginia and a former Assistant Attorney General for the Commonwealth of Virginia. Monica has practiced law for over 30 years. She actively practices law only in Colorado, and is inactive in the Commonwealth of Virginia, Tennessee, and Georgia.

attorneys.practice_type: Divorce Lawyers in Greenwood Village, CO
attorneys.bio:
Frank McGuane is one of the most prominent and well-respected lawyers in Colorado. Frank and the firm's attorneys have outstanding knowledge of Colorado's statutes and cases involving family law -- because we wrote the book on it. Our partners at McGuane & Hogan, P.C, in Denver, Colorado, are the authors of the Colorado Family Law Practice Series, a detailed work containing an overview of the practice of family law, that is heavily relied upon by judges, lawyers, and others in the legal field.

At McGuane & Hogan, P.C, our Colorado family law attorneys know that family law matters can be stressful. We understand the dynamics of these situations and promise to do everything we can to meet your needs as a client. We are committed to offering emotional support, trust, and confidence in the development and maintenance of our successful attorney-client relationships.

If you are seeking proficient legal representation for a family law issue, trust your matter to the law firm that wrote the book on Colorado family law. With our continued memberships in national, state, and local bar associations, The American and International Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers, and other organizations, you can count on our extensive experience and a proven ability to produce results. When you contact our attorneys at McGuane & Hogan, P.C, to be your legal counsel, we promise to keep your interests in the forefront as we handle your family matter with confidentiality, tact, discretion, and efficiency.

attorneys.practice_type: Bankruptcy & Creditors' Rights Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
Mr. McGuinness is a partner in the firm's Gaming practice group. His practice focuses primarily on ‎commercial gaming matters in Nevada, Colorado, Iowa and Mississippi, as well tribal gaming matters. ‎He is also involved with Lewis Roca Rothgerber's Bankruptcy practice group in relation to gaming bankruptcy ‎matters.

Mr. McGuinness has represented clients with licensing and regulatory matters before the Nevada State ‎Gaming Control Board, the Nevada Gaming Commission, the Colorado Division of Gaming, the ‎Colorado Limited Gaming Control Commission, the Iowa Racing & Gaming Commission, the Mississippi ‎Gaming Commission and the National Indian Gaming Commission. He has also participated in gaming-‎related matters in other jurisdictions such as California, Canada, Hungary, Illinois, Kansas, Louisiana, ‎Maryland, Michigan, Missouri, New Mexico, North Dakota, Oklahoma, Switzerland and Washington. Mr. ‎McGuinness has represented clients in gaming bankruptcy matters, including the Herbst Gaming, Station ‎Casinos, Fitzgeralds Gaming Corporation, the Aladdin Hotel and Casino, and the Resort at Summerlin ‎proceedings.

Mr. McGuiness discussed the gaming industry and his practice in a Q&A with Vegas Inc. (formerly In Business Las Vegas).

Mr. McGuinness was previously with Beckley Singleton, which partnered with Lewis Roca Rothgerber in 2007. ‎Prior to joining the firm, he was Vice President and General Counsel for The Resort at Summerlin, which ‎was owned by Swiss Casinos (1997-2001), had a private gaming law practice in Mississippi (1994-1997) ‎and served as Compliance Director for the Mississippi Gaming Commission (1992-1993). He got his ‎start in the gaming industry as a law clerk for the Iowa Racing & Gaming Commission.‎

He has been named in ‎Nevada Business' 2013 Legal Elite in the "Northern Nevada Best" category, and to their "Top 75" list in ‎‎2010-2012. Mr. McGuinness is listed in the 2008-2014 editions of Best Lawyers in America in the category of Gaming Law, listed in the ‎‎2008-2013 editions of Chambers USA, and featured in the 2007-2013 editions of Mountain States Super ‎Lawyers and recognized in their 2013 "Top 100" attorneys list. He has also been recognized by In ‎Business Las Vegas' "Who's Who List."‎

Mr. McGuinness was recently recognized for his commitment to pro bono service at the firm's John P. Frank Pro Bono ‎Awards Luncheon.‎

attorneys.name: Bernadette C. McGuire Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Immigration & Naturalization Law Lawyers in Lakewood, CO
attorneys.bio:
Bernadette Ginger McGuire has experience in family based immigration, deportation/removal defense, consular processing, citizenship, and business based immigration. Her experience also includes strategic work with immigrant and non immigrant visas, to fit the needs of her clients.

She is a frequent speaker on family-based visa issues, such as adjustment of status, fiance(e) visas, and removal of conditions, on a national and local level. She is also a citizenship and naturalization instructor for the Denver Public Libraries.

Ms. McGuire has successfully represented clients in front of the Executive Office for Immigration Review and the Board of Immigration Appeals in removal/deportation proceedings. To that end, she has developed her removal practice around clients who have complex criminal issues, previous immigration violations and appeals.

Her experience also includes detailed analysis of business compliance with the Form I-9 as well as providing an ongoing maintenance program for her business clients.

She is an elected officer of the American Immigration Lawyers Association Colorado Chapter and served as Chapter President in 2009-2010. She is also an elected officer of the New Members Division of the American Immigration Lawyers Association which supports all newer members to the national bar association.

attorneys.name: Dylan McGurk Esq.
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Greenwood Village, CO
attorneys.bio:
Dylan R.F. McGurk is a trial lawyer who joined Dan Caplis Law after working for the last ten years in the state of Arizona. However, born and raised in the great state of Colorado, Dylan grew up Alpine Ski Racing where his competitive nature developed. This allowed him the opportunity to race on the same “stage” with such all-time greats such as Lindsey Vonn and compete in the Junior Olympics.

Dylan’s competitive nature coupled with having been in several significant motor vehicle crashes over his lifetime has translated to an unrivaled passion for his work in personal injury. Providing a voice for those who don’t necessarily have one is Dylan’s ultimate motivation.

Dylan’s journey to his career in law began at Fort Lewis College in Durango, CO where he graduated on the Dean’s list with his undergraduate degree in Psychology. From there Dylan went on to obtain his law degree in Arizona. His academic achievements are notable, including being selected as an Honor Court Student Defense Counselor, and receiving a CALI Award for earning the highest grade in the class.

Dylan is a member of the Colorado Trial Lawyers Association, Arizona Trial Lawyers Association, and has been named by Super Lawyers as a Southwest Rising Star since 2020. When he’s not at the office or in the courtroom, Dylan enjoys spending time with his wife and son, and camping or seeing live music.

attorneys.name: Ruth A. McLeod
attorneys.practice_type: Discrimination Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
Ms. McLeod is a dedicated attorney at The Litigation Boutique, licensed to practice law in Colorado. She has experience in employment law, including representing clients in cases of discrimination, harassment, and retaliation in violation of Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964, as amended (“Title VII”); the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, as amended by the ADA Amendments Act of 2008 (together, the “ADA”); the Age Discrimination in Employment Act of 1967, as amended, 29 U.S.C. § 621 et seq. (“ADEA”); and the Colorado Anti-Discrimination Act, Colo. Rev. Stat. § 24-34-401 et seq. (“CADA”), as well as claims based on the Colorado Wage Claim Act and wrongful discharge in violation of public policy. Ms. McLeod also successfully assists individuals in obtaining unemployment benefits and defends employers against wrongfully claimed benefits.

During law school, she actively participated in the Environmental Law Clinic’s Oil and Gas team, aiding marginalized communities in disputes against oil and gas companies and the Colorado Oil and Gas Commission (“COGCC”). attorneys.name: Jessica Meeder
attorneys.practice_type: Toxics and Environmental Litigation Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
"Jessica H. Meeder is a lead attorney in Morgan & Morgan's Toxics and Environmental Group and has been litigating complex class action, multi-district, and multi-plaintiff cases in state and federal courts for nearly 20 years. She has a unique breadth of substantive experience that includes toxic torts class actions, consumer and medical monitoring class actions, pharmaceutical and medical device mass torts, civil rights class actions, sexual assault class and individual cases, and individual catastrophic personal injury cases-all of which she brings to bear in her current practice.

Jessica is particularly skilled at effectively developing, briefing, and arguing creative legal theories and approaches to help secure the best possible outcomes for her clients, and she brings a high degree of depth, nuance, dedication, and collaboration to every aspect of her work. Her passionate advocacy has resulted in numerous favorable judicial opinions, at both the trial court and appellate court levels, thus ensuring her clients a path to justice.

For example, Jessica helped secure reversal in Boler, et al. v. Earley, et al., 865 F.3d 391 (6th Cir. 2017), cert. denied. 138 S.Ct. 1294 (2018), the second class action filed on behalf of Flint, Michigan residents for their toxic and valueless water, allowing them to pursue their claims under 42 U.S.C. § 1983, the Contracts Clause, and state tort law. She also obtained reversal in M.S., et al. v. Hamilton County Department of Education, et al., 756 Fed.Appx. 510 (6th Cir. 2018), ensuring that dozens of schoolchildren injured and killed in a school bus crash could seek uncapped compensation under 42 U.S.C. § 1983 and the Fourteenth Amendment.

Jessica's advocacy also led to the courts' denial of defendants' motions to dismiss consumer class and medical monitoring claims in both In re: Zantac (Ranitidine) Prod. Liab. Litig., MDL No. 2924 (S.D. Fla.) and In re: Allergan BIOCELL Textured Breast Implant Prod. Liab. Litig., MDL No. 2921 (D.N.J.), multi-district litigations involving defective pharmaceuticals and medical devices, respectively. Her work in Manassa et al. v. NCAA, Case No. 1:20-cv-03172 (S.D. Ind.), helped ensure that Black student-athletes at Historically Black Colleges and Universities can proceed with their discrimination claims against the NCAA. And In In re Behr Dayton Thermal Products, LLC, Dkt. 274, Case No. 3:08-cv-326 (S.D. Ohio March 20, 2017), aff'd 896 F.3d 405 (6th Cir. 2018), cert. denied, 139 S.Ct. 1319 (2019), the district court granted issues class certification, allowing hundreds of property owners to proceed in their suit against the defendants who had contaminated their land with toxic chemicals. The opinion was upheld on appeal.

Prior to joining Morgan and Morgan's Complex Litigation Group, Jessica opened the Washington, D.C. office of a national class action boutique firm and was a partner at a preeminent Baltimore-based law firm, where she spearheaded its national class action and mass torts practices. She previously worked for several nationally prominent defense firms, where she practiced environmental regulation and permitting, pharmaceutical defense, and general insurance defense. Her experience representing insurance companies and defending businesses across multiple practice areas has made her an especially effective advocate for her injured clients.

Jessica earned her juris doctor and a Certificate of Concentration in Environmental Law from the University of Maryland School of Law, where she was an editor for the University of Maryland Law Journal of Race, Religion, Gender and Class. During law school, Jessica interned with the U.S. Department of Justice in its Environmental Torts and Environmental Enforcement sections. She subsequently clerked for the Honorable Robert M. Bell, Chief Judge of the Maryland Court of Appeals, Maryland's highest court. Jessica earned her bachelor's degree in Comparative History of Ideas from the University of Washington in Seattle and is a member of the Phi Beta Kappa honors society.

Jessica has been active in the American Association for Justice, including its Women's Trial Lawyers Caucus, and Women En Mass, a group devoted to women mass torts practitioners. She served as Chair of the American Association for Justice's Section on Toxic, Environmental, and Pharmaceutical Torts from 2019-2020.

Jessica is an invitation-only participant in the Duke Law Judicial Studies Center's Diversity Conference, which develops the Guidelines and Best Practices Addressing Chronic Failure to Diversity Leadership Positions in the Practice of Law, and the Duke Law Conference entitled Evaluating the 2015 Discovery-Proportionality Amendments and Bolch-Duke Guidelines and Best Practices. She was named to The National Trial Lawyer's Top 40 Under 40 for many years and was recently honored as one of the Top 100 Civil Plaintiff Lawyers in Washington, D.C.

After spending most of her life in Maryland, Jessica and her family recently relocated to Colorado. She's an avid skier and mountain biker, is trying to convince herself to do more hiking, and enjoys spending time with her family and traveling."

attorneys.name: Jeanne Melberg
attorneys.practice_type: Estate Planning Lawyers in Parker, CO
attorneys.bio:
Jeanne Melberg is an Attorney at Patricia Jo Stone, P.C. who provides insight-driven representation to clients in our Parker office.

Keenly observant and analytical at a young age, Jeanne has an innate passion for examining people and situations to arrive at the truth. She was born in Princeton, New Jersey and raised in the San Francisco Bay Area and Oklahoma City, Oklahoma.

After earning her undergraduate degree in Psychology, Jeanne went on to earn a Master of Arts in English. Her love of analytical reading and writing led her to the University of Oklahoma College of Law where she earned her Juris Doctor. While in law school, Jeanne put her empathetic tendencies and advocacy skills to good use as a Court Appointed Special Advocate representing the interests of abused and neglected children. She is a strong proponent of trauma-informed education for attorneys and judicial officers.

As an Attorney at Patricia Jo Stone, P.C., Jeanne is passionate about advocating for clients with difficult family law and probate matters. She understands the grief and overwhelm in which clients may find themselves during these times of transition and makes listening, guidance and problem-solving a priority.

In her practice, Jeanne leverages her psychology background, litigation experience and fine-tuned scrutinization skills to provide personalized and pragmatic representation. She believes in being open and realistic to minimize surprises and works diligently to identify appropriate solutions based on each client’s particular needs.

Outside of practicing law, Jeanne is dedicated to her family. She enjoys oil painting, photography and all things from nature.

attorneys.name: Tonya L. Melnichenko
attorneys.firm_name: Frank Azar Car & Truck Accident Lawyers - Aurora, Colorado
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Aurora, CO
attorneys.bio:
"I know up on top you are seeing great things, but those down here on the bottom, we too should have rights." - Dr. Seuss

As a personal injury lawyer, my job is to handle each claim the same. I have made it a practice not to treat a client with a wrongful death case any different than one with a soft tissue injury case. Both were injured in a car crash and both deserve compensation for their injuries and losses. Every client has a story to tell and I want to hear it.

Growing up in rural update New York, I was the youngest daughter of an immigrant who came to the United States to find a better life for his family back in Venezuela. My dad worked long hours doing manual labor which instilled in me an appreciation of hard work and the value of getting an education. He made work a priority but when he was home, he was present with his family enjoying back yard barbeques, badminton and bike rides. My mom made sure she showed us how to plant a garden and thread a needle. Some skills cannot be found in a book.

I graduated from college and decided to take on law school. I went to Albany Law School and two weeks after I took the bar in New York, I moved to Colorado with my husband. We packed up a U-Haul, with our animals and a little cash to head out west.

As I approach twenty years with the firm, I look back on where it all started. My first love was the law and I fell in love reading about the nuts and bolts of how the justice system began even before I went to law school. Sitting in Supreme Court class in undergrad made me realize that the concept of justice has a different meaning to each person. As a plaintiff's lawyer, I am the voice for my clients. I am their advocate and I take that role very seriously. This is not just a job or a career, it is my life. Years ago, I represented a young girl who was killed in an accident at sixteen; and to this day, that case sticks with me. The case doesn't stick with me because of the graphic and horrible facts, it is that she could have been my daughter. Someone else's negligence can take someone away in just a split second.

I am a wife and mother. I have three kids and take on the role of taxi driver, tutor and entertainer when I am not at work. I enjoy making memories with my family and taking time to make sure my kids become good humans who add to our world.

attorneys.name: Joseph Merkel
attorneys.practice_type: Workers’ Compensation Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
Joseph (Jody) Merkel has been representing injured workers in Colorado exclusively during his career. He has never represented an insurance company and works hard to protect the rights of injured workers!

Jody earned his Juris Doctoral degree from Florida Coastal School of Law in Jacksonville, Florida. His undergraduate work was completed at the University of Colorado, Denver campus, where he received a Bachelor of Science degree, summa cum laude (highest honors), in Business Administration.

Jody is a proud member of the Workers' Compensation Education Association (WCEA). The Workers Compensation Education Association is a nonprofit association of attorneys who represent Colorado employees who are injured on the job. Since 1984 the WCEA has been dedicated to providing a voice for injured workers both in and out of the courtroom. The group supports attorneys who represent injured workers through education, research, and sharing information. Members receive up-to-date legal education through an offering of accredited courses throughout each year and have access to other critical proprietary resources to help in their representation of injured workers.

The WCEA advocates for injured workers by working with the Division of Workers Compensation to improve the process for securing benefits. The WCEA also lobbies at the State Capitol each year by initiating legislation and securing sponsors for bills to improve benefits available to injured workers and to improve the process of securing benefits. -cowcea.org

Jody is also a member of the Colorado Bar Association, Denver Bar Association, and Workers Compensation Section of the Colorado Bar.

Jody is an owner of The Merkel Law Firm, LLC. He is highly regarded by his peers for ethical standards and professional achievements

Jody came to Colorado from the Midwest in 1988. Like his wife and business partner, Penny, he was mentored by Colorado Workers' Compensation legend, Barbara Furutani. When he's not fighting on behalf of injured workers, Jody enjoys spending time with his family. He also enjoys hunting, fishing, and camping.

attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury -- Plaintiff Lawyers in Fort Collins, CO
attorneys.bio:
T. Thomas Metier has represented seriously injured adults and children throughout the U.S. for over 30 years. His national trial practice focuses on victims suffering from brain injuries, paralysis, serious burns, amputations, wrongful death, and nursing home abuse and neglect. Nationally known for innovative trial work, he continues to win multimillion-dollar verdicts and settlements for victims of insurance bad faith, oil field accidents, products liability, mining accidents, medical negligence and vehicle accidents including trucking, motorcycle, automobile, airplane and bicycle. A native of Iowa, Tom graduated Cum Laude from Coe College and received his Juris Doctorate from the University of Iowa. In 1981, he moved to Colorado and began fine-tuning his skills as a trial specialist and master storyteller. Today, he teaches trial skills at the Trial Lawyer’s College in Wyoming and at numerous speaking engagements across the country. He is often called upon by other trial attorneys to assist in the development and trial of their cases. Named to The Best Lawyers in America, Tom serves on the faculty of the Trial Lawyers' College and the Executive Board of the Colorado Trial Lawyers Association. He is Board Certified in Civil Trial Law by the National Board of Trial Advocacy, Board Certified in Civil Pretrial Practice by the National Board of Civil Pretrial Practice Advocacy, a member of the American Association for Justice’s President’s club, the Wyoming Trial Lawyers Association, The Association of Trial Lawyers of America, The Motor Vehicle Trial Lawyers Association, The Million Dollar Advocates Forum, The Multi-Million Dollar Advocates Forum and the Larimer County Bar Association. He has been listed as a Colorado Super Lawyer each year from 2006 to 2012 and has received a Martindale Hubbell AV rating from his peers, the highest rating available.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
T. Thomas Metier has represented seriously injured adults and children throughout the U.S. for over 30 years. His national trial practice focuses on victims suffering from brain injuries, paralysis, serious burns, amputations, wrongful death, and nursing home abuse and neglect. Nationally known for innovative trial work, he continues to win multimillion-dollar verdicts and settlements for victims of insurance bad faith, oil field accidents, products liability, mining accidents, medical negligence and vehicle accidents including trucking, motorcycle, automobile, airplane and bicycle. A native of Iowa, Tom graduated Cum Laude from Coe College and received his Juris Doctorate from the University of Iowa. In 1981, he moved to Colorado and began fine-tuning his skills as a trial specialist and master storyteller. Today, he teaches trial skills at the Trial Lawyer’s College in Wyoming and at numerous speaking engagements across the country. He is often called upon by other trial attorneys to assist in the development and trial of their cases. Named to The Best Lawyers in America, Tom serves on the faculty of the Trial Lawyers' College and the Executive Board of the Colorado Trial Lawyers Association. He is Board Certified in Civil Trial Law by the National Board of Trial Advocacy, Board Certified in Civil Pretrial Practice by the National Board of Civil Pretrial Practice Advocacy, a member of the American Association for Justice’s President’s club, the Wyoming Trial Lawyers Association, The Association of Trial Lawyers of America, The Motor Vehicle Trial Lawyers Association, The Million Dollar Advocates Forum, The Multi-Million Dollar Advocates Forum and the Larimer County Bar Association. He has been listed as a Colorado Super Lawyer each year from 2006 to 2012 and has received a Martindale Hubbell AV rating from his peers, the highest rating available.

Mark Miller has over 27 years of experience representing Consumer Bankruptcy Debtors. Mark has over 5;000 past and current consumer bankruptcy clients, and has devoted individualized and personal attention to each and every one of these clients without exception.

Experienced Bankruptcy Attorney Serving Colorado

Welcome to The Law Offices of Mark L. Miller, a premier bankruptcy law firm located in the heart of Colorado. Our mission is to provide compassionate, expert legal assistance to individuals and businesses facing financial challenges. With years and years of dedicated experience in bankruptcy law; and with thousands and thousands of bankruptcy clients and cases our firm has become a trusted name for effective debt relief solutions in Colorado.

Our Founder: Mark L. Miller

Mark L. Miller, the founding attorney of our law firm, is a distinguished bankruptcy lawyer with an unwavering commitment to helping clients navigate the complexities of bankruptcy. A member of the Colorado Bar and with extensive experience in both Chapter 7 and Chapter 13 bankruptcy cases, Mark's expertise is unparalleled. His approach combines deep legal knowledge with a personal touch, ensuring that every client receives tailored, individualized advice and representation.

Our Expertise

Specializing in bankruptcy law, our firm offers comprehensive legal services including:

Chapter 7 Bankruptcy Filing

Chapter 13 Debt Reorganization

Personalized Financial Assessment

Asset Protection Strategies

Creditor Negotiations

Post-Bankruptcy Financial Planning

Our in-depth understanding of the bankruptcy process and Colorado's specific legal landscape enables us to provide superior guidance to our clients. Whether you are an individual seeking a fresh financial start or a business looking to reorganize debts, our team is equipped to handle your case with the utmost professionalism and care.

Commitment to Client Success

At The Law Offices of Mark L. Miller, we believe in a client-centered approach. Recognizing the stress and uncertainty that accompanies financial difficulties, we dedicate ourselves to providing a supportive, confidential, and respectful service. Our goal is to empower our clients, helping them achieve financial stability and peace of mind.Bankruptcy Abuse Prevention and Consumer Protection Act of 2005 (S. 256) signed by President Bush on April 20, 2005 recognizes the value of Board Certification. The American Board of Certification is the only national organization that certifies attorneys who have demonstrated their skills in these specialties.

For expert legal advice on bankruptcy, contact The Law Offices of Mark L. Miller. We are committed to helping you regain control of your financial future. Schedule a consultation today to explore your options and start your journey to financial recovery.

Book Appointment

The Crucial Role of a Qualified Bankruptcy Attorney in Your Journey to Financial Recovery

Embarking on the path to financial recovery through bankruptcy can be one of the most significant decisions in an individual's life. It is a journey fraught with legal complexities and pivotal choices that can profoundly impact one's future. At The Law Offices of Mark L. Miller, we understand the weight of this decision and emphasize the crucial role of a qualified, competent, and experienced bankruptcy attorney in navigating this challenging process.

Why Expert Legal Representation Matters in Bankruptcy

Navigating Complex Legal Waters: Bankruptcy law is intricate and varies from state to state. A qualified bankruptcy attorney brings a deep understanding of these laws, especially as they apply in Colorado, ensuring that your case adheres to all legal requirements and protocols.

Personalized Legal Strategy: Each bankruptcy case is unique. A competent attorney doesn't just provide standard advice; they offer personalized legal strategies tailored to your specific financial situation, goals, and needs.

Maximizing Financial Outcomes: Experienced bankruptcy attorneys have a profound understanding of how to protect your assets, reduce debts, and utilize exemptions effectively. Their expertise can make a significant difference in the outcome of your bankruptcy, often leading to better protection of your assets and a more favorable debt discharge.

Avoiding Costly Mistakes: The bankruptcy process is filled with potential pitfalls. Simple errors in paperwork, failure to meet deadlines, or misrepresentation of assets and debts can lead to case dismissal or even legal consequences. A skilled bankruptcy lawyer ensures that such mistakes are avoided.

Stress Reduction and Support: Filing for bankruptcy can be a stressful and emotional process. A dedicated attorney provides not only legal support but also peace of mind, guiding you through each step and answering all your questions with empathy and understanding.

The Law Offices of Mark L. Miller: A Commitment to Excellence

At The Law Offices of Mark L. Miller, our commitment to our clients is unwavering. Founding attorney Mark L. Miller brings years of experience, a deep knowledge of bankruptcy law, and a passionate commitment to helping individuals achieve financial freedom.

Our Approach:

Thorough Case Evaluation: We start with a detailed analysis of your financial situation to determine the best course of action.

Customized Legal Solutions: Our strategies are tailored to your unique circumstances, always aiming to achieve the most beneficial outcome.

Comprehensive Asset Protection: We employ sophisticated strategies to protect your property and assets to the fullest extent allowed by law.

Transparent and Open Communication: We believe in keeping our clients informed and involved throughout the bankruptcy process.

Conclusion

Choosing the right bankruptcy attorney is a critical step in your journey to a fresh financial start. At The Law Offices of Mark L. Miller, we pride ourselves on providing qualified, competent, and empathetic legal assistance to guide you through this challenging time. If you are considering bankruptcy, let our expertise and dedication be your guide to achieving the financial stability and peace of mind you deserve.

attorneys.name: Thomas C. "Doc" Miller
attorneys.practice_type: Appeals Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
Doc Miller brings Investigation and Truth to Find Justice in the Courtroom.

Thomas C. "Doc" Miller is not just a lawyer. Doc wore a blue collar building oil rigs in the Gulf of Mexico. Doc worked as a journalist for 10 years in Colorado, Wyoming and Texas. For another 10 years, Doc owned and operated a successful private investigation firm in Colorado. He has been a lawyer now for over 20 years. He is also a court qualified forensic document examiner.

Doc Miller investigated and published the truth of the murder of John Benet Ramsey. Since then he has investigated, tried cases and successfully built a criminal defense practice. Doc Miller has defended citizens from traffic tickets to Child Abuse Resulting in Death. Doc communicated the Community heartbeat as a journalist in small towns and big cities. As a private investigator, Doc investigated the gritty details of Corporate, Government and Personal Greed. It is in the Criminal Courtroom where Doc Miller ferrets out personal greed, government arrogance and immorality in the corporate boardroom. When it comes to trial, Doc Miller will have the facts and there's no deal until the facts are in, or the jury decides.

Contact Doc's Denver Law Office Today!

Who will tell your story when you're charged with Domestic Violence, a DUI or Murder?

Doc Miller won an acquittal on a Not-Guilty-by-Reason-of-Insanity in Jefferson County District Court. He has won civil judgements in county courts as well as district courts. He defends for Burglary, Criminal Mischief and Criminal Trespass as well as Crimes against persons both At-Risk-Adults and Children. He defends Concealed Weapons and firearms offenses. If it's drugs or traffic, prostitution, harassment or disturbing the peace Doc will tell your story. If it is County, State or Federal Court, from Jay Walking to Murder Doc Miller stands up for the accused.

Contact Doc's Denver Law Office Today!

attorneys.name: Laura Schmitt Moore
attorneys.practice_type: Estate Planning (Wills, Trusts, Powers of Attorney, Advanced Directives) Lawyers in Niwot, CO
attorneys.bio:
Laura Moore joined the firm in October of 2011, and has practiced law in Colorado since October of 1993. Raised in Aberdeen, South Dakota, she appreciates the friendly, small town law firm. A proud CU Buff, she graduated from the University of Colorado in Boulder with a Bachelor of Arts Degree in English in May of 1987. Ms. Moore received her law degree from the Willamette University College of Law in Salem, Oregon in May of 1993. Ms. Moore is a published member of the Willamette Law Review. Ms. Moore is a member of the Colorado and Boulder County Bar Associations.

Past community activities included volunteer work at Niwot Elementary, and service on the board of directors and executive committee of the Niwot High School Education Foundation. Ms. Moore volunteers as a scoring judge for the State High School Mock Trial Competitions. Ms. Moore also served as a mentor and judge for the Brighton Teen Court program. Ms. Moore volunteers for senior law events including Boulder County’s Senior Law Day. Ms. Moore has been a guest speaker at Google on the topic of Special Needs Trusts for adults with disabilities.

Ms. Moore enjoys choral singing. She is a past singing member of the CU Collegiate Chorale and the Boulder Chorale, where she served on their board of directors, grant writing and executive committees, and chaired the Diversity, Equity & Inclusion committee. Currently, Ms. Moore sings with the Coal Creek Community Chorus.

Ms. Moore and her husband Tom are the adoptive parents of Teddy, an English Cream Golden Retriever, rescued from a breeding farm in Ohio.

attorneys.name: Joe Morales
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
Joe served as the Chief Deputy District Attorney of the Economic Crime Unit for over twenty of his twenty-eight-year career in the Denver District Attorney’s Office. In that capacity, Joe supervised and conducted hundreds of complex criminal investigations which involved organized crime, public corruption, securities fraud, and multi-million-dollar embezzlements from private and public entities. Joe worked extensively with state and federal agencies invarious forms of criminal and administrative complaints and fostered lasting relationships. Joe is a talented and aggressive litigator with over 250 trials to verdict, including forty-five homicides, organized crime, embezzlement, and various categories of fraud, including securities, mortgage, construction, election, and public corruption. Joe is widely regarded as one of the preeminent litigation attorneys in Colorado.

As Chief of the Economic Crime Unit, Joe was tasked with selecting, managing, and utilizing the grand juries in Denver County, becoming a foremost expert in grand jury practice, investigation, and prosecution in Colorado. During his career, he litigated some of the most complex criminal indictments in Denver.

Joe grew up in Granby, Colorado, and earned his Juris Doctor from the University of Colorado. He is an avid skier and hiker and enjoys spending time with his rescue dog, Archie.

attorneys.name: J. Michael Morgan
attorneys.practice_type: Airport Law Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
Mike Morgan practices in the areas of airport law, oil and gas, real estate and related litigation. He has been a shareholder of the Firm since 1988.

His oil and gas practice focuses on regulatory, land use and suface use matters, on behalf of both oil and gas companies and surface owners. His related real estate practice spans the acquisition, financing, development and operation of real property, and includes real estate title, and commercial landlord and tenant matters.

Mr. Morgan has represented commercial service and general aviation airports, and airport businesses, for over 20 years. This includes operational, leasing and contracting, airport development, noise control and federal regulatory issues. He is experienced in bringing and defending complaints before FAA under FAR Part 16.

He has significant litigation experience in real estate, airport and natural resources matters. He is admitted to practice law in Colorado, Wyoming, and related federal courts.

He has provided community and professional service as a director and chair of the Legal Committee of the Colorado Oil and Gas Association; chairman of the Natural Resources Committee of the Federal Bar Association; a member of the Colorado Airport Operators Association; and an officer and director of several other nonprofit organizations.
