attorneys.name: Brent Warkentine
attorneys.practice_type: Child Support Lawyers in Broomfield, CO
attorneys.bio:
Galvanized by family tradition, as well as an acute intellect, Brent Warkentine knew at an early age that his career goal was to practice law. While studying for his law degree at the University of Denver, Mr. Warkentine earned several honors, including an appointment as an editor of the University of Denver Law Review, a prestigious law journal published by the university's School of Law. After an initial clerkship with the Honorable Morris Sandstead of the Twentieth Judicial District, Mr. Warkentine joined the law firm of Warkentine Law Office and quickly developed an extensive knowledge and understanding of the complexities of family law.

Brent Warkentine has been in practice with his father, Lee Warkentine, since 1997. This father and son partnership presents an unparalleled legal environment for Brent Warkentine and his clients as the years of experience and depth of knowledge of the elder Warkentine are readily accessible. Further, the clients of Brent Warkentine also reap the additional benefit of a fee schedule which is commensurate with Brent Warkentine's experience, and yet on a par with the legal representation provided by more experienced attorneys such as Lee Warkentine.

Brent Warkentine stands apart from many other family law attorneys because of his extensive knowledge and expertise with regard to issues involving children, including such issues as parental responsibilities, or parental decision making and parenting time, primary residential care and out-of-state relocations. Brent Warkentine is a trained and certified Child and Family Investigator. With this specialized knowledge comes an in-depth understanding of the child and family investigative process, as well as a familiarity with the experts who are regularly retained to conduct such investigations. If this area of family law is of particular importance to you and the resolution of your dispute, the representation provided by Brent Warkentine may be the answer for you.

attorneys.name: Lee D. Warkentine
attorneys.practice_type: Child Support Lawyers in Broomfield, CO
attorneys.bio:
Retired - Lee Warkentine began his legal career with the Boulder law firm of Williams, Trine & Greenstein. At Williams, Trine & Greenstein, Mr. Warkentine honed his adroit legal skills working closely with the firm's esteemed partner, Charles E. Williams. Together, Mr. Warkentine and Mr. Williams successfully litigated the landmark case of In re the Marriage of Graham, 574 P.2d 75 (Colo. S. Ct. 1978), which established the legal principle that the contribution of one spouse in providing financial support while the other spouse acquires an education is a relevant factor to be considered by a trial court in determining the issues of property division and maintenance. During the appellate process, Mr. Warkentine argued the case before the Colorado Supreme Court.

Today, in keeping with the honored tradition of excellence which Mr. Warkentine fostered during the early years of his career, Mr. Warkentine continues to zealously advocate for the expansion of the legal rights of all parties to family law actions. Mr. Warkentine is ably assisted in this endeavor by an experienced and knowledgeable legal staff. As a result of the highly qualified team which Mr. Warkentine has brought together, client expenses remain much lower than many other firms in the area. Further, the assistance of this team permits Mr. Warkentine to devote greater attention to clients and the substantive legal issues of their cases.

For clients who may be interested in an affordable and efficient alternative to the traditional, judicial process, Lee Warkentine also offers mediation services. Mr. Warkentine is well versed in the art of alternative dispute resolution and welcomes the opportunity to assist clients in creating and implementing joint resolutions of family law disputes. As a neutral and impartial mediator, Mr. Warkentine provides a plain-language explanation of Colorado law and the legal ramifications of varying resolutions while encouraging constructive discussions between the parties. If you are looking for a comfortable, non-adversarial forum in which to address family law issues and explore your own solutions to those issues, the mediation services available at Lee D. Warkentine, P.C. may be the answer.

attorneys.name: Bruce W. "Biff" Warren
attorneys.practice_type: Wills, Trusts, & Estate Planning Lawyers in Niwot, CO
attorneys.bio:
Bruce “Biff” Warren has practiced law in the Niwot-Gunbarrel Community since 1975 after graduating from the University of Nebraska College of Law, with distinction. He earned a BA in political science at the University of Nebraska, with distinction, and also obtained a teaching certificate in political science. He opened a law office in Niwot in June, 1975, which later became Warren Moore Rutherford, LLP.

Mr. Warren is currently active in many community and civic organizations, including the Niwot Cultural Arts Association (President), the Niwot Business Association (past President), the Left Hand Valley Courier (Managing Editor), the Niwot Future League, the Tree Carving Committee, the Rock & Rails Summer Concert Series (Co-Manager) and Niwot Baseball, Inc. (Secretary).

Mr. Warren served on the Niwot Local Improvement District Advisory Committee (past Chair) for 14 years, the Boulder County Planning Commission for 7 years (past Vice-Chair), and served on the board of Niwot Youth Sports, Inc., (past president) for 25 years, which named the Biff Warren Baseball Complex in his honor in 2001. He has also served on the boards of the Niwot High School Education Foundation (past Secretary), the Niwot Community Association (past Secretary), and the Niwot United Methodist Church (Council Chair). He is a member of the Colorado and Boulder County Bar Associations, and received the first Public Service Award for Boulder County from the Colorado Bar Association in 1993, and the John Marshall Award in 2009. In addition, he is the founder and coordinator of the Niwot Community Semi-Marching Free Grange Band, and has served as an Assistant Baseball Coach at Niwot High School since 2002 after serving as an Assistant Softball Coach at Niwot High for 4 years.

attorneys.name: V. Kohl Watson
attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Fort Collins, CO
attorneys.bio:
V. Kohl Watson is a born fighter. Whether it is fighting on the battlefield, grappling in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, or battling in the courtroom, Kohl was built to fight as hard as possible.

Raised by a retired FBI agent and a former United States Attorney Kohl felt a strong obligation to serve his country after graduating high school. Kohl joined the United States Army at seventeen years old, deploying to Afghanistan as an infantryman. Kohl served as a machine-gunner, as well as dismounted security for twelve months in Afghanistan. Shortly after turning twenty-one, Kohl was promoted to the rank of Sergeant and was put in command of a group of soldiers. While thoroughly enjoying the Army, Kohl knew his talents lie elsewhere, namely: the Courtroom.

After retiring from the Army Kohl attended University of Colorado at Colorado Springs where he obtained a bachelors in Political Science and Philosophy. After completing his undergraduate degrees, he attended the University of Wyoming College of Law and graduated with honors.

After law school and passing the Wyoming and Colorado Bar Exam Kohl took a position as a Juvenile Attorney with the Albany County Attorney's office in Wyoming and then as a Deputy District Attorney at the 8th Judicial District Attorney’s Office – Fort Collins. In his time there, Kohl handled hundreds of criminal cases and took several cases to trial through verdict. After his time at the DA’s office Kohl joined Haltzman law firm as an associate attorney where he works tirelessly to protect the constitutional rights of those accused of crimes in Colorado and Wyoming.

Kohl is an active member of the Northern Colorado legal community. He was awarded a prestigious Alternative Defense Counsel (ADC) appointment in 2023 and proudly provides representation for indigent people in complex criminal prosecutions in which the Public Defender’s office determines that an ethical conflict of interest exists. Kohl is currently serving as the elected President to the Larimer County Bar Association - Young Lawyers Division.

Awards and Honors

Honors

Awarded a prestigious Alternative Defense Counsel (ADC) appointment in 2023

attorneys.name: Todd Weaver
attorneys.practice_type: Environmental Law Lawyers in Colorado Springs, CO
attorneys.bio:
Todd Weaver is an associate in the firm’s Environmental Practice Group. His practice encompasses all aspects of environmental law. Mr. Weaver advises clients regarding compliance with all major federal and state environmental laws and regulatory programs including the Clean Air Act, Clean Water Act, RCRA, CERLCA, and EPCRA. He also represents clients in environmental litigation in federal and state courts and in enforcement and administrative proceedings before state and federal environmental agencies. Mr. Weaver has substantial experience performing environmental due diligence for acquisitions, mergers and divestment of businesses, as well as advising real estate purchasers and sellers as to environmental issues relating to property transfers. He has assisted clients in the remediation of contaminated sites through various state voluntary clean-up programs. He has also been involved in rule making proceedings representing the oil and gas industry before the Colorado Air Quality Control Commission in the development and promulgation of standards to control emissions of nitrogen oxides and volatile organic compounds for inclusion in the federally enforceable ozone State Implementation Plan.

Prior to joining the firm, Mr. Weaver was an associate in the environmental practice group of a large Midwestern law firm. He previously served as a federal law clerk to Chief Judge William C. Lee and Magistrate Judge Roger Cosbey in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Indiana and as a state law clerk to Judge Paul Widick in the Seventh Judicial District of Minnesota. Before his time as a law clerk, Mr. Weaver served as in-house counsel for a Colorado environmental consulting firm where he performed environmental compliance and due diligence audits for a number of industries and the federal government. He was also involved in the redevelopment of the former Stapleton International Airport and litigation surrounding the Summitville Mine Superfund Site.

Mr. Weaver draws upon his technical background and consulting experience to deliver both legal and practical solutions to his client’s environmental issues.

Mr. Weaver received his J.D. from the University of Denver Sturm College of Law where he served as Vice-President and then President, of the Natural Resources and Environmental Law Society. He was also a law clerk with U.S. EPA Region 8, Legal Division. Mr. Weaver received his M.S. in Environmental Science from Indiana University and his B.S. in Natural Resources and Environmental Science from Purdue University.

Mr. Weaver is admitted to practice in Colorado, Indiana, the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Indiana, the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of Indiana and the Seventh Circuit Court of Appeals.

sections.content:
Todd Weaver is an associate in the firm’s Environmental Practice Group. His practice encompasses all aspects of environmental law. Mr. Weaver advises clients regarding compliance with all major federal and state environmental laws and regulatory programs including the Clean Air Act, Clean Water Act, RCRA, CERLCA, and EPCRA. He also represents clients in environmental litigation in federal and state courts and in enforcement and administrative proceedings before state and federal environmental agencies. Mr. Weaver has substantial experience performing environmental due diligence for acquisitions, mergers and divestment of businesses, as well as advising real estate purchasers and sellers as to environmental issues relating to property transfers. He has assisted clients in the remediation of contaminated sites through various state voluntary clean-up programs. He has also been involved in rule making proceedings representing the oil and gas industry before the Colorado Air Quality Control Commission in the development and promulgation of standards to control emissions of nitrogen oxides and volatile organic compounds for inclusion in the federally enforceable ozone State Implementation Plan.

Prior to joining the firm, Mr. Weaver was an associate in the environmental practice group of a large Midwestern law firm. He previously served as a federal law clerk to Chief Judge William C. Lee and Magistrate Judge Roger Cosbey in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Indiana and as a state law clerk to Judge Paul Widick in the Seventh Judicial District of Minnesota. Before his time as a law clerk, Mr. Weaver served as in-house counsel for a Colorado environmental consulting firm where he performed environmental compliance and due diligence audits for a number of industries and the federal government. He was also involved in the redevelopment of the former Stapleton International Airport and litigation surrounding the Summitville Mine Superfund Site.

Mr. Weaver draws upon his technical background and consulting experience to deliver both legal and practical solutions to his client’s environmental issues.

Mr. Weaver received his J.D. from the University of Denver Sturm College of Law where he served as Vice-President and then President, of the Natural Resources and Environmental Law Society. He was also a law clerk with U.S. EPA Region 8, Legal Division. Mr. Weaver received his M.S. in Environmental Science from Indiana University and his B.S. in Natural Resources and Environmental Science from Purdue University.

Mr. Weaver is admitted to practice in Colorado, Indiana, the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Indiana, the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of Indiana and the Seventh Circuit Court of Appeals.

attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Fort Collins, CO
attorneys.bio:
Heidi is a senior attorney at Johnson Law Group. With a distinguished career in litigation and a robust background in family law, business litigation, and estate planning, Heidi brings a wealth of expertise to our firm.

Academic Achievements: Heidi earned her Juris Doctorate from Texas Wesleyan University School of Law (now Texas A&M), where she ranked in the top 12% of her class and consistently made the Dean’s List. She holds a B.S.B.A. in Accounting and Management Information Systems from the University of Arizona, further enhancing her strategic and financial insight in legal matters.

Master of Family Law: Admitted to practice law in Colorado, Texas, and Wyoming, and before the U.S. Supreme Court, Heidi is a certified mediator and holds an AVVO Excellent Rated Attorney distinction. She practices a variety of family law areas including child custody, divorce, high net worth divorce, modifications, orders of protection, property division, spousal maintenance, estate planning, and mediation.

Past Experience: Prior to joining Johnson Law Group, Heidi’s general civil litigation practice focused on domestic relations/child support and custody, business litigation, and consumer litigation. Throughout the years, Heidi has secured favorable outcomes for clients, including establishing defined visitation schedules for grandparents and negotiating advantageous pre-trial settlements in business and consumer disputes. Additionally, she has tried over twenty-one cases to bench and jury verdicts as the first chair, which often surpassed expected results.

Community Leadership and Service: Dedicated to both professional excellence and community service, Heidi continues to be a formidable advocate for her clients and a respected leader in the legal community. She has served as President, Vice President, Treasurer, and Secretary of the Larimer County Bar Association, and as President of the Larimer County Women’s Bar Association. Heidi has also been a board member for Denton County Friends of the Family, CLE Chairperson for the Denton County Bench Bar, and President and Vice President of the Flower Mound Bar Association.

attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Lakewood, CO
attorneys.bio:
Travis Whitson is an associate attorney at the Whitson Family Law in Lakewood, Colorado. He is a Colorado native, raised on the Western Slope of Colorado, and moved to the Front Range in 2000. Travis is a Boettcher Scholarship Award recipient and graduated with honors from The Colorado College, obtaining bachelor degrees in both psychology and philosophy. Travis received his Juris Doctorate degree from The University of Denver Sturm College of Law in 2008, where he was staff editor of The University of Denver Sturm College of Law Sports and Entertainment Law Journal. Throughout his education, Travis has worked with organizations that focus on diverse family structures, youth at-risk, and children that have been the victim of severe abuse and neglect.

Travis continues a family tradition of volunteership to support local organizations that center on youth and building healthy families. He was a founding member of the Mount Saint Vincent Home at-risk child mentorship program, volunteer teacher at Third-Way of Denver, and has worked numerous adoption events for children in need of loving parents. Travis brings this experience into his practice with the goal of nurturing diverse solutions that work for individual family situations.

Travis is licensed to practice law in the State of Colorado. His practice centers on Family Law, including divorce and child custody, but also all legal matters that affect the family unit, from adoption to divorce.

attorneys.name: Clara Wilbrandt
attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Golden, CO
attorneys.bio:
Clara is a graduate of both the University of Colorado's School of Arts and Sciences and its Law School. Clara was admitted to the Colorado Bar in 2009 and has focused her practice in the area of family law for the past four years.

Clara's road to the law was a long and circuitous one. Following stints as a ski instructor, cooking teacher, caterer and bed and breakfast proprietor, Clara returned to finish college in the wake of a difficult divorce. With her children in tow, Clara received a Bachelor of Arts summa cum laude with distinction from the University of Colorado in May 2004 and enrolled in law school the next year. Clara notes that her crowning achievement as a first year law student was her receipt of the much coveted grand prize in the law school chili cook-off for her "Habeus Porkus" green chili with pork and posole. During her second year of law school, still heady from her chili cook-off victory, Clara began to focus on the study of family law. To expand her knowledge beyond the law school classroom, Clara interned with two Denver District Court judges both of whom had a domestic relations docket. Clara graduated from law school with a Juvenile and Family Law Certificate with honors.

Clara has three children, not surprisingly all good cooks and great skiers. Between her family obligations and her law practice, Clara does not have any spare time. If she did, she likes to think that she would spend it listening to opera while napping on a beach, however, she realizes that she would probably fritter it away trying to get caught up on the laundry.

Awards and Honors

Honors

Jacob Van Eyk Award

attorneys.name: Melissa J. Winthers
attorneys.practice_type: Personal Injury Lawyers in Greenwood Village, CO
attorneys.bio:
Melissa Winthers is a trial lawyer who has specialized in personal injury law for twenty-four years. She understands that an injury affects not just you but your entire family. Melissa dedicates herself to helping you get your life back.

Melissa knows that having a deep understanding of the medicine is key to presenting your injury case. She has received numerous million dollar plus jury verdicts, judgments, and resolutions for her clients. She has spoken to health care provider associations about trial presentation of traumatic brain injuries and spine injuries. Melissa is the author of the book Colorado Personal Injury, a comprehensive guide for practitioners on the ins and outs of Colorado Personal Injury Law for Lexis Nexis, one of the largest publishers of legal reference, which was published in May 2024. Melissa has been active in the community, helping organizations that assist people who have been injured as they work toward recovery. She has served as the President of the Brain Injury Alliance of Colorado, as a board member of the Chanda Plan Foundation, and as a board member of the Colorado Trial Lawyers’ Association.

Melissa is recognized for her excellence in the practice of law. She has been ranked in the top 50 women attorneys in Colorado by Super Lawyers and has been recognized in the Best Lawyers in America. Melissa received Martindale-Hubbell’s AV preeminent rating, the highest rating for ethical standards and legal ability.

attorneys.practice_type: Lawyers in Aurora, CO
attorneys.bio:
"It is rewarding to get the best possible results for my clients"

Business Litigation Attorney

Paul Wood is a third generation Colorado native. He is part of the Class Action/Mass Torts Group at Franklin D. Azar & Associates, P.C. Mr. Wood joined the law firm in May 2017 and focuses his practice on helping 401(k) plan participants protect their retirement by holding plan sponsors accountable for losses caused by plan mismanagement. Mr. Wood received his undergraduate degree from the University of Colorado (Boulder) in 1978. He received his law degree in 1982 from the University of Denver Sturm College of Law.

Mr. Wood currently focuses his practice on representing 401(k) plan participants. Before Joining Franklin D. Azar & Associates, P.C. in May 2017, , Mr. Wood was a partner in several regional and national law firms, where he represented financial services companies in high-stakes securities and other litigation. Mr. Wood's commercial litigation background has helped him understand how financial institutions and other large companies operate. He has tried 20 cases to verdict before juries and courts and an equal number before arbitrators representing both plaintiffs and defendants. Mr. Wood is also a trained mediator and has mediated 20 cases as a volunteer mediator for Jefferson County Colorado Mediation Services.

Mr. Wood is rated AV by Martindale-Hubbell (the highest rating available) and has been named a Colorado "Super Lawyer" numerous years, including 2019. He is licensed to practice in Colorado and admitted before the United States District Court for the District of Colorado and the United States Tenth Circuit Court of Appeals.

Paul loves to hike, watch the Bronco's and read. He is proud of his six children who all are alums of the University of Colorado.

attorneys.name: Daniel B. Zarnowski
attorneys.practice_type: Divorce and Family Law Lawyers in Littleton, CO
attorneys.bio:
I am excited to fulfill all of your family law needs! Our firm is comprised of highly competent professionals and I look forward to serving you and your child's interests.

Born in Chicago and raised in Connecticut, Daniel Zarnowski moved to the Denver metro area after graduating magna cum laude from St. Thomas University School of Law in Miami.

Prior to entering law school Daniel was an aviation structural mechanic in the U.S. Navy, serving for five years and through three combat deployments aboard the Dwight D. Eisenhower CVN 69. This experience taught Daniel the value of service to others and how to work with people from diverse backgrounds.

Daniel is also an avid golfer and likes to spend weekends hiking in beautiful Colorado with his wife and dog. When at home Daniel enjoys cooking and there are very few things he will not eat!

In law school, Daniel became interested in family matters as a volunteer guardian ad litem. The impact of parenting time and decision making on the children was apparent working with children in dependency cases.

Daniel completed over 100 hours of pro-bono work during law school, not only working with children but also engaging with other underserved communities. This work included time spent with Feeding South Florida, and the Miami River Cleanup Commission.

Academically, Daniel graduated from law school in the top 5% of his class, ranking 8th out of 223 students. Daniel was a research assistant for a distinguished professor, helping her publish a forthcoming article, and was also a student instructor during his second year of law school.

Daniel interned for a federal district court judge and was employed by a civil litigation firm as a law clerk during law school, handling all aspects of litigation.

Throughout these experiences, Daniel has remained dedicated to helping others within his community through preparation and professionalism. He believes that working with families is rewarding and he is grateful for the opportunity to be involved with people on a personal level.

attorneys.name: Joanne Zboyan
attorneys.firm_name: The Law Firm of Springer & Steinberg
attorneys.practice_type: Insurance Law Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
JoAnne is an experienced and respected litigator with over three decades of experience in Colorado courts and the Denver legal and non-profit communities. She began her legal career as an appellate law clerk at the Colorado Court of Appeals, after which she practiced with and became a partner at a 50 plus attorney litigation firm in Greenwood Village. Her practice in the insurance group focused on a wide range of insurance coverage issues and claims, including general liability, disability (individual and group), health, automobile/significant personal injury and life. This initial work experience with and for insurers provided extensive background into the day-to-day operations of the insurance industry, its’ regulators and claims handling and remains a major focus of her continuing work

For the past 20 plus years JoAnne has focused her practice on representing insureds–assisting them in making and perfecting insurance claims and litigating claims after improper denial or delay by their insurer. She has also litigated hundreds of commercial, negligence (including legal malpractice), and education related claims in federal and state courts. Her knowledge of insurance law and bad faith, coupled with her extensive litigation experience has been pivotal in her representation as personal counsel of physicians, attorneys and other professionals and insureds, in assisting them in obtaining insurance benefits.

JoAnne appreciates that when making or pursuing a claim, clients often face multiple challenges beyond the insurance claim at issue. She is experienced in working cooperatively with other counsel, agencies and experts to maximize the potential success of each claim or case.

JoAnne is admitted to practice in Colorado, Wyoming, the United States District Court for the District of Colorado, the Tenth Circuit Court of Appeals and the United States Supreme Court. She is rated “AV” by Martindale-Hubble. She is a member of the Colorado and Arapahoe Bar Associations, including the Insurance and Health Care Sections. She has served on several Colorado non-profit boards including the Colorado Ballet (2010-present), Developmental Pathways (2012-2021) and Adam’s Camp ( 1999-2009); tutored and mentored at the University of Denver Bridge Project and Denver Public Schools truancy education and reduction program. She holds an MS in Special Education and Reading and a Type D Certificate in School Administration and previously taught in Littleton Public Schools.

attorneys.name: William Hadden Zimmerling
attorneys.firm_name: Law Office of William Hadden Zimmerling
attorneys.practice_type: Collections Lawyers in Denver, CO
attorneys.bio:
William Zimmerling has over fifteen years of lending and collections experience as an officer with major banks such as Chemical Bank (now part of JPMorgan Chase), First Interstate, and Wells Fargo. His practice focuses on collections, creditor rights, contract disputes, and civil litigation.

After leaving banking, he spent six years as an Executive Officer with facility based telecommunications and Internet companies. During that time he was the president for five years of a USA Swimming Team, Foothills Swim Team.

Over the next five years Mr. Zimmerling worked with major Broker Dealers and FDIC Insured Institutions to build and launch deposit programs and deposit facilities. These programs collectively totaled many billions of dollars including a $10 billion deposit program for A.G. Edwards & Sons, Inc. and a $2 billion deposit facility for Bank of America.

Mr. Zimmerling attended the United States Coast Guard Academy in New London, Connecticut and is a graduate of Trinity College in Hartford Connecticut and Rutgers School of Law in Newark New Jersey. At Trinity he was a member of the Alpha Delta Phi Fraternity and a member of the Trinity College Crew where he won a National Championship with an undefeated boat and later rowed in the Henley Royal Regatta. While at Rutgers Law School, Mr. Zimmerling spent two terms working for the Constitutional Litigation Clinic.

He is admitted to the Connecticut State Bar, the Colorado State Bar, and the U.S. District Court for Colorado. Mr. Zimmerling served as a law clerk to the Honorable John W. Madden IV in the Denver District Court.

attorneys.name: Jennifer Robin Zimmerman
attorneys.practice_type: Litigation Lawyers in Boulder, CO
attorneys.bio:
My clients are whole people.

My representation doesn't stop with the case itself - I also help my clients with collateral consequences of both civil and criminal matters, ranging from consequences at school, housing issues, professional licensing, and with ongoing issues in civil cases. I take particular pride in approaching each case in a creative and unique way.

There is no one size fits all. My background in civil litigation gives me a unique perspective in criminal cases: I do not slide into the rut of "take the plea offer or go to trial." I craft creative solutions for each individual case. The same is true in civil cases. I do not adhere to standard approaches to settlement, and instead work to create a resolution that fits my clients' needs.

I am passionate about the law.

More specifically, I am passionate about advocating for my clients, and helping them achieve the best outcome in their case. Because my background includes both civil and criminal litigation, I have the ability to combine the high-level research-driven strategies employed in civil cases with the quick thinking courtroom work developed through representing clients in criminal matters. The result is a better approach to both civil and criminal litigation.

During my time in law school, I was an associate editor on the University of Colorado Law Review. In that capacity, I wrote extensive research-based articles for publication, and also edited the work of professional authors and law professors who were chosen to publish in the University of Colorado Law Review. I had the pleasure of working with the best and brightest law students and to work on cutting-edge legal issues and analysis.

I also represented people charged with crimes through the CU criminal defense clinic. This blend of research-based writing and analysis and hands-on practice at the trial court level has defined my practice throughout my career as a lawyer.
